text_en: The words of Nehemias the son of Helchias. And it came to pass in the month of Casleu, in the twentieth year, as I was in the castle of Susa ,
text_la: Verba Nehemiæ filii Helchiæ. Et factum est in mense Casleu, anno vigesimo, et ego eram in Susis castro.
text_pt: As palavras de Neemias, filho de Hacalias. E sucedeu no mês de Quislev, no ano vigésimo, estando eu em Susã, a fortaleza,
text_el: λόγοι Νεεμια υἱοῦ Αχαλια καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μηνὶ Χασεηλου ἔτους εἰκοστοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην ἐν Σουσαν αβιρα

text_en: that Hanani one of my brethren came, he and some men of Juda ; and I asked them concerning the Jews , that remained and were left of the captivity, and concerning Jerusalem .
text_la: Et venit Hanani, unus de fratribus meis, ipse et viri ex Juda : et interrogavi eos de Judæis qui remanserant, et supererant de captivitate, et Jerusalem.
text_pt: Que veio Hanani, um de meus irmãos, ele e alguns de Judá; e perguntei-lhes pelos judeus que escaparam, e que restaram do cativeiro, e acerca de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθεν Ανανι εἷς ἀπὸ ἀδελφῶν μου αὐτὸς καὶ ἄνδρες Ιουδα καὶ ἠρώτησα αὐτοὺς περὶ τῶν σωθέντων οἳ κατελείφθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας καὶ περὶ Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And they said to me: They that have remained, and are left of the captivity there in the province, are in great affliction, and reproach: and the wall of Jerusalem is broken down, and the gates thereof are burnt with fire.
text_la: Et dixerunt mihi : Qui remanserunt, et relicti sunt de captivitate ibi in provincia, in afflictione magna sunt, et in opprobrio : et murus Jerusalem dissipatus est, et portæ ejus combustæ sunt igni.
text_pt: E disseram-me: Os restantes, que ficaram do cativeiro, lá na província estão em grande miséria e desprezo; e o muro de Jerusalém fendido e as suas portas queimadas a fogo.
text_el: καὶ εἴποσαν πρός με οἱ καταλειπόμενοι οἱ καταλειφθέντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας ἐκεῖ ἐν τῇ χώρᾳ ἐν πονηρίᾳ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν ὀνειδισμῷ καὶ τείχη Ιερουσαλημ καθῃρημένα καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἐνεπρήσθησαν ἐν πυρί

text_en: And when I had heard these words, I sat down, and wept, and mourned for many days: and I fasted , and prayed before the face of the God of heaven .
text_la: Cumque audissem verba hujuscemodi, sedi, et flevi, et luxi diebus multis : jejunabam, et orabam ante faciem Dei cæli:
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo eu estas palavras, assentei-me e chorei, e lamentei por alguns dias; e estive jejuando e orando perante o Deus dos céus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ἀκοῦσαί με τοὺς λόγους τούτους ἐκάθισα καὶ ἔκλαυσα καὶ ἐπένθησα ἡμέρας καὶ ἤμην νηστεύων καὶ προσευχόμενος ἐνώπιον θεοῦ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: And I said: I beseech you, O Lord God of heaven , strong, great, and terrible, who keeps covenant and mercy with those that love you, and keep your commandments:
text_la: et dixi : Quæso, Domine Deus cæli fortis, magne atque terribilis, qui custodis pactum et misericordiam cum his qui te diligunt, et custodiunt mandata tua:
text_pt: E disse: Ah! Senhor Deus dos céus, Deus grande e terrível! Que guarda a aliança e a benignidade para com aqueles que o amam e guardam os seus mandamentos;
text_el: καὶ εἶπα μὴ δή κύριε ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ μέγας καὶ ὁ φοβερός φυλάσσων τὴν διαθήκην καὶ τὸ ἔλεος τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν αὐτὸν καὶ τοῖς φυλάσσουσιν τὰς ἐντολὰς αὐτοῦ

text_en: Let your ears be attentive, and your eyes open, to hear the prayer of your servant, which I pray before you now, night and day, for the children of Israel your servants: and I confess the sins of the children of Israel , by which they have sinned against you: I and my father's house have sinned .
text_la: fiant aures tuæ auscultantes, et oculi tui aperti, ut audias orationem servi tui, quam ego oro coram te hodie nocte et die pro filiis Israël servis tuis : et confiteor pro peccatis filiorum Israël, quibus peccaverunt tibi : ego et domus patris mei peccavimus,
text_pt: Estejam, pois, atentos os teus ouvidos e os teus olhos abertos, para ouvires a oração do teu servo, que eu hoje faço perante ti, dia e noite, pelos filhos de Israel, teus servos; e faço confissão pelos pecados dos filhos de Israel, que temos cometido contra ti; também eu e a casa de meu pai temos pecado.
text_el: ἔστω δὴ τὸ οὖς σου προσέχον καὶ οἱ ὀφθαλμοί σου ἀνεῳγμένοι τοῦ ἀκοῦσαι προσευχὴν δούλου σου ἣν ἐγὼ προσεύχομαι ἐνώπιόν σου σήμερον ἡμέραν καὶ νύκτα περὶ υἱῶν Ισραηλ δούλων σου καὶ ἐξαγορεύω ἐπὶ ἁμαρτίαις υἱῶν Ισραηλ ἃς ἡμάρτομέν σοι καὶ ἐγὼ καὶ ὁ οἶκος πατρός μου ἡμάρτομεν

text_en: We have been seduced by vanity, and have not kept your commandments, and ceremonies and judgments, which you have commanded your servant Moses .
text_la: vanitate seducti sumus, et non custodivimus mandatum tuum, et cæremonias, et judicia quæ præcepisti Moysi famulo tuo.
text_pt: De todo nos corrompemos contra ti, e não guardamos os mandamentos, nem os estatutos, nem os juízos, que ordenaste a Moisés, teu servo.
text_el: διαλύσει διελύσαμεν πρὸς σὲ καὶ οὐκ ἐφυλάξαμεν τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὰ προστάγματα καὶ τὰ κρίματα ἃ ἐνετείλω τῷ Μωυσῇ παιδί σου

text_en: Remember the word that you commanded to Moses your servant, saying: If you shall transgress, I will scatter you abroad among the nations:
text_la: Memento verbi quod mandasti Moysi servo tuo, dicens : Cum transgressi fueritis, ego dispergam vos in populos:
text_pt: Lembra-te, pois, da palavra que ordenaste a Moisés, teu servo, dizendo: Vós transgredireis, e eu vos espalharei entre os povos.
text_el: μνήσθητι δὴ τὸν λόγον ὃν ἐνετείλω τῷ Μωυσῇ παιδί σου λέγων ὑμεῖς ἐὰν ἀσυνθετήσητε ἐγὼ διασκορπιῶ ὑμᾶς ἐν τοῖς λαοῖς

text_en: But if you return to me, and keep my commandments, and do them, though you should be led away to the uttermost parts of the world, I will gather you from thence, and bring you back to the place which I have chosen for my name to dwell there.
text_la: et si revertamini ad me, et custodiatis præcepta mea, et faciatis ea : etiamsi abducti fueritis ad extrema cæli, inde congregabo vos, et reducam in locum quem elegi ut habitaret nomen meum ibi.
text_pt: E vós vos convertereis a mim, e guardareis os meus mandamentos, e os cumprireis; então, ainda que os vossos rejeitados estejam na extremidade do céu, de lá os ajuntarei e os trarei ao lugar que tenho escolhido para ali fazer habitar o meu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἐὰν ἐπιστρέψητε πρός με καὶ φυλάξητε τὰς ἐντολάς μου καὶ ποιήσητε αὐτάς ἐὰν ᾖ ἡ διασπορὰ ὑμῶν ἀπ' ἄκρου τοῦ οὐρανοῦ ἐκεῖθεν συνάξω αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰσάξω αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν τόπον ὃν ἐξελεξάμην κατασκηνῶσαι τὸ ὄνομά μου ἐκεῖ

text_en: And these are your servants, and your people: whom you have redeemed by your great strength, and by your mighty hand.
text_la: Et ipsi servi tui, et populus tuus, quos redemisti in fortitudine tua magna, et in manu tua valida.
text_pt: Eles são teus servos e o teu povo que resgataste com a tua grande força e com a tua forte mão.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ παῖδές σου καὶ λαός σου οὓς ἐλυτρώσω ἐν δυνάμει σου τῇ μεγάλῃ καὶ ἐν τῇ χειρί σου τῇ κραταιᾷ

text_en: I beseech you, O Lord , let your ear be attentive to the prayer of your servant, and to the prayer of your servants who desire to fear your name : and direct your servant this day, and give him mercy before this man . For I was the king's cupbearer.
text_la: Obsecro, Domine, sit auris tua attendens ad orationem servi tui, et ad orationem servorum tuorum, qui volunt timere nomen tuum : et dirige servum tuum hodie, et da ei misericordiam ante virum hunc. Ego enim eram pincerna regis.
text_pt: Ah! Senhor, estejam, pois, atentos os teus ouvidos à oração do teu servo, e à oração dos teus servos que desejam temer o teu nome; e faze prosperar hoje o teu servo, e dá-lhe graça perante este homem. Então era eu copeiro do rei.
text_el: μὴ δή κύριε ἀλλ' ἔστω τὸ οὖς σου προσέχον εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν τοῦ δούλου σου καὶ εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν παίδων σου τῶν θελόντων φοβεῖσθαι τὸ ὄνομά σου καὶ εὐόδωσον δὴ τῷ παιδί σου σήμερον καὶ δὸς αὐτὸν εἰς οἰκτιρμοὺς ἐνώπιον τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τούτου καὶ ἐγὼ ἤμην οἰνοχόος τῷ βασιλεῖ

text_en: And it came to pass in the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of Artaxerxes the king: that wine was before him, and I took up the wine, and gave it to the king: and I was as one languishing away before his face.
text_la: Factum est autem in mense Nisan, anno vigesimo Artaxerxis regis : et vinum erat ante eum, et levavi vinum, et dedi regi : et eram quasi languidus ante faciem ejus.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, no mês de Nisã, no ano vigésimo do rei Artaxerxes, que estava posto vinho diante dele, e eu peguei o vinho e o dei ao rei; porém eu nunca estivera triste diante dele.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἐν μηνὶ Νισαν ἔτους εἰκοστοῦ Αρθασασθα βασιλεῖ καὶ ἦν ὁ οἶνος ἐνώπιον ἐμοῦ καὶ ἔλαβον τὸν οἶνον καὶ ἔδωκα τῷ βασιλεῖ καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἕτερος ἐνώπιον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the king said to me: Why is your countenance sad, seeing you do not appear to be sick? This is not without cause, but some evil , I know not what, is in your heart. And I was seized with an exceeding great fear:
text_la: Dixitque mihi rex : Quare vultus tuus tristis est, cum te ægrotum non videam? non est hoc frustra, sed malum nescio quod in corde tuo est. Et timui valde, ac nimis:
text_pt: E o rei me disse: Por que está triste o teu rosto, pois não estás doente? Não é isto senão tristeza de coração; então temi sobremaneira.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεύς διὰ τί τὸ πρόσωπόν σου πονηρὸν καὶ οὐκ εἶ μετριάζων οὐκ ἔστιν τοῦτο εἰ μὴ πονηρία καρδίας καὶ ἐφοβήθην πολὺ σφόδρα

text_en: And I said to the king: O king, live for ever: why should not my countenance be sorrowful, seeing the city of the place of the sepulchres of my fathers is desolate, and the gates thereof are burnt with fire?
text_la: et dixi regi : Rex, in æternum vive : quare non mœreat vultus meus, quia civitas domus sepulchrorum patris mei deserta est, et portæ ejus combustæ sunt igni?
text_pt: E disse ao rei: Viva o rei para sempre! Como não estaria triste o meu rosto, estando a cidade, o lugar dos sepulcros de meus pais, assolada, e tendo sido consumidas as suas portas a fogo?
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ ὁ βασιλεὺς εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα ζήτω διὰ τί οὐ μὴ γένηται πονηρὸν τὸ πρόσωπόν μου διότι ἡ πόλις οἶκος μνημείων πατέρων μου ἠρημώθη καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς κατεβρώθησαν ἐν πυρί

text_en: Then the king said to me: For what do you make request? And I prayed to the God of heaven ,
text_la: Et ait mihi rex : Pro qua re postulas? Et oravi Deum cæli,
text_pt: E o rei me disse: Que me pedes agora? Então orei ao Deus dos céus,
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεύς περὶ τίνος τοῦτο σὺ ζητεῖς καὶ προσηυξάμην πρὸς τὸν θεὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ

text_en: and I said to the king: If it seem good to the king, and if your servant has found favour in your sight, that you would send me into Judea to the city of the sepulchre of my father, and I will build it.
text_la: et dixi ad regem : Si videtur regi bonum, et si placet servus tuus ante faciem tuam, ut mittas me in Judæam ad civitatem sepulchri patris mei, et ædificabo eam.
text_pt: E disse ao rei: Se é do agrado do rei, e se o teu servo é aceito em tua presença, peço-te que me envies a Judá, à cidade dos sepulcros de meus pais, para que eu a reedifique.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθόν καὶ εἰ ἀγαθυνθήσεται ὁ παῖς σου ἐνώπιόν σου ὥστε πέμψαι αὐτὸν εἰς Ιουδα εἰς πόλιν μνημείων πατέρων μου καὶ ἀνοικοδομήσω αὐτήν

text_en: And the king said to me, and the queen that sat by him: For how long shall your journey be, and when will you return? And it pleased the king, and he sent me: and I fixed him a time.
text_la: Dixitque mihi rex, et regina quæ sedebat juxta eum : Usque ad quod tempus erit iter tuum, et quando reverteris? Et placuit ante vultum regis, et misit me : et constitui ei tempus.
text_pt: Então o rei me disse, estando a rainha assentada junto a ele: Quanto durará a tua viagem, e quando voltarás? E aprouve ao rei enviar-me, apontando-lhe eu um certo tempo.
text_el: καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ βασιλεὺς καὶ ἡ παλλακὴ ἡ καθημένη ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ ἕως πότε ἔσται ἡ πορεία σου καὶ πότε ἐπιστρέψεις καὶ ἠγαθύνθη ἐνώπιον τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἀπέστειλέν με καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτῷ ὅρον

text_en: And I said to the king: If it seem good to the king, let him give me letters to the governors of the country beyond the river, that they convey me over, till I come into Judea :
text_la: Et dixi regi : Si regi videtur bonum, epistolas det mihi ad duces regionis trans flumen, ut traducant me, donec veniam in Judæam:
text_pt: Disse mais ao rei: Se ao rei parece bem, dêem-se-me cartas para os governadores dalém do rio, para que me permitam passar até que chegue a Judá.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τῷ βασιλεῖ εἰ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ἀγαθόν δότω μοι ἐπιστολὰς πρὸς τοὺς ἐπάρχους πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ ὥστε παραγαγεῖν με ἕως ἔλθω ἐπὶ Ιουδαν

text_en: And a letter to Asaph the keeper of the king's forest, to give me timber that I may cover the gates of the tower of the house, and the walls of the city, and the house that I shall enter into. And the king gave me according to the good hand of my God with me.
text_la: et epistolam ad Asaph custodem saltus regis, ut det mihi ligna, ut tegere possim portas turris domus, et muros civitatis, et domum quam ingressus fuero. Et dedit mihi rex juxta manum Dei mei bonam mecum.
text_pt: Como também uma carta para Asafe, guarda da floresta do rei, para que me dê madeira para cobrir as portas do paço da casa, para o muro da cidade e para a casa em que eu houver de entrar. E o rei mas deu, segundo a boa mão de Deus sobre mim.
text_el: καὶ ἐπιστολὴν ἐπὶ Ασαφ φύλακα τοῦ παραδείσου ὅς ἐστιν τῷ βασιλεῖ ὥστε δοῦναί μοι ξύλα στεγάσαι τὰς πύλας καὶ εἰς τὸ τεῖχος τῆς πόλεως καὶ εἰς οἶκον ὃν εἰσελεύσομαι εἰς αὐτόν καὶ ἔδωκέν μοι ὁ βασιλεὺς ὡς χεὶρ θεοῦ ἡ ἀγαθή

text_en: And I came to the governors of the country beyond the river, and gave them the king's letters . And the king had sent with me captains of soldiers, and horsemen.
text_la: Et veni ad duces regionis trans flumen, dedique eis epistolas regis. Miserat autem rex mecum principes militum, et equites.
text_pt: Então fui aos governadores dalém do rio, e dei-lhes as cartas do rei; e o rei tinha enviado comigo capitàes do exército e cavaleiros.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τοὺς ἐπάρχους πέραν τοῦ ποταμοῦ καὶ ἔδωκα αὐτοῖς τὰς ἐπιστολὰς τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἀπέστειλεν μετ' ἐμοῦ ὁ βασιλεὺς ἀρχηγοὺς δυνάμεως καὶ ἱππεῖς

text_en: And Sanaballat the Horonite, and Tobias the servant, the Ammonite , heard it, and it grieved them exceedingly, that a man had come, who sought the prosperity of the children of Israel .
text_la: Et audierunt Sanaballat Horonites, et Tobias servus Ammanites : et contristati sunt afflictione magna, quod venisset homo qui quæreret prosperitatem filiorum Israël.
text_pt: O que ouvindo Sambalate, o horonita, e Tobias, o servo amonita, lhes desagradou extremamente que alguém viesse a procurar o bem dos filhos de Israel.
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλατ ὁ Αρωνι καὶ Τωβια ὁ δοῦλος ὁ Αμμωνι καὶ πονηρὸν αὐτοῖς ἐγένετο ὅτι ἥκει ἄνθρωπος ζητῆσαι ἀγαθὸν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ

text_en: And I came to Jerusalem , and was there three days.
text_la: Et veni Jerusalem, et eram ibi tribus diebus.
text_pt: E cheguei a Jerusalém, e estive ali três dias.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἤμην ἐκεῖ ἡμέρας τρεῖς

text_en: And I arose in the night, I and some few men with me, and I told not any man what God had put in my heart to do in Jerusalem , and there was no beast with me, but the beast that I rode upon.
text_la: Et surrexi nocte ego, et viri pauci mecum, et non indicavi cuiquam quid Deus dedisset in corde meo ut facerem in Jerusalem : et jumentum non erat mecum, nisi animal cui sedebam.
text_pt: E de noite me levantei, eu e poucos homens comigo, e não declarei a ninguém o que o meu Deus me pôs no coração para fazer em Jerusalém; e não havia comigo animal algum, senão aquele em que estava montado.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστην νυκτὸς ἐγὼ καὶ ἄνδρες ὀλίγοι μετ' ἐμοῦ καὶ οὐκ ἀπήγγειλα ἀνθρώπῳ τί ὁ θεὸς δίδωσιν εἰς καρδίαν μου τοῦ ποιῆσαι μετὰ τοῦ Ισραηλ καὶ κτῆνος οὐκ ἔστιν μετ' ἐμοῦ εἰ μὴ τὸ κτῆνος ᾧ ἐγὼ ἐπιβαίνω ἐπ' αὐτῷ

text_en: And I went out by night by the gate of the valley, and before the dragon fountain, and to the dung gate, and I viewed the wall of Jerusalem which was broken down, and the gates thereof which were consumed with fire.
text_la: Et egressus sum per portam vallis nocte, et ante fontem draconis, et ad portam stercoris, et considerabam murum Jerusalem dissipatum, et portas ejus consumptas igni.
text_pt: E de noite saí pela porta do vale, e para o lado da fonte do dragão, e para a porta do monturo, e contemplei os muros de Jerusalém, que estavam fendidos, e as suas portas, que tinham sido consumidas pelo fogo.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθον ἐν πύλῃ τοῦ γωληλα καὶ πρὸς στόμα πηγῆς τῶν συκῶν καὶ εἰς πύλην τῆς κοπρίας καὶ ἤμην συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει Ιερουσαλημ ὃ αὐτοὶ καθαιροῦσιν καὶ πύλαι αὐτῆς κατεβρώθησαν πυρί

text_en: And I passed to the gate of the fountain, and to the king's aqueduct, and there was no place for the beast on which I rode to pass.
text_la: Et transivi ad portam fontis, et ad aquæductum regis, et non erat locus jumento cui sedebam ut transiret.
text_pt: E passei à porta da fonte, e ao tanque do rei; e não havia lugar por onde pudesse passar o animal em que estava montado.
text_el: καὶ παρῆλθον ἐπὶ πύλην τοῦ Αιν καὶ εἰς κολυμβήθραν τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ οὐκ ἦν τόπος τῷ κτήνει παρελθεῖν ὑποκάτω μου

text_en: And I went up in the night by the torrent, and viewed the wall, and going back I came to the gate of the valley, and returned.
text_la: Et ascendi per torrentem nocte, et considerabam murum, et reversus veni ad portam vallis, et redii.
text_pt: Ainda, de noite subi pelo ribeiro e contemplei o muro; e, virando entrei pela porta do vale; assim voltei.
text_el: καὶ ἤμην ἀναβαίνων ἐν τῷ τείχει χειμάρρου νυκτὸς καὶ ἤμην συντρίβων ἐν τῷ τείχει καὶ ἤμην ἐν πύλῃ τῆς φάραγγος καὶ ἐπέστρεψα

text_en: But the magistrates knew not whither I went, or what I did: neither had I as yet told anything to the Jews , or to the priests , or to the nobles, or to the magistrates, or to the rest that did the work.
text_la: Magistratus autem nesciebant quo abiissem, aut quid ego facerem : sed et Judæis, et sacerdotibus, et optimatibus, et magistratibus, et reliquis qui faciebant opus, usque ad id loci nihil indicaveram.
text_pt: E não souberam os magistrados aonde eu fora nem o que eu fazia; porque ainda nem aos judeus, nem aos sacerdotes, nem aos nobres, nem aos magistrados, nem aos mais que faziam a obra, até então tinha declarado coisa alguma.
text_el: καὶ οἱ φυλάσσοντες οὐκ ἔγνωσαν τί ἐπορεύθην καὶ τί ἐγὼ ποιῶ καὶ τοῖς Ιουδαίοις καὶ τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς ἐντίμοις καὶ τοῖς στρατηγοῖς καὶ τοῖς καταλοίποις τοῖς ποιοῦσιν τὰ ἔργα ἕως τότε οὐκ ἀπήγγειλα

text_en: Then I said to them: You know the affliction wherein we are, because Jerusalem is desolate, and the gates thereof are consumed with fire: come, and let us build up the walls of Jerusalem , and let us be no longer a reproach.
text_la: Et dixi eis : Vos nostis afflictionem in qua sumus : quia Jerusalem deserta est, et portæ ejus consumptæ sunt igni : venite, et ædificemus muros Jerusalem, et non simus ultra opprobrium.
text_pt: Então lhes disse: Bem vedes vós a miséria em que estamos, que Jerusalém está assolada, e que as suas portas têm sido queimadas a fogo; vinde, pois, e reedifiquemos o muro de Jerusalém, e não sejamos mais um opróbrio.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς ὑμεῖς βλέπετε τὴν πονηρίαν ἐν ᾗ ἐσμεν ἐν αὐτῇ πῶς Ιερουσαλημ ἔρημος καὶ αἱ πύλαι αὐτῆς ἐδόθησαν πυρί δεῦτε καὶ διοικοδομήσωμεν τὸ τεῖχος Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οὐκ ἐσόμεθα ἔτι ὄνειδος

text_en: And I showed them how the hand of my God was good with me, and the king's words, which he had spoken to me, and I said: Let us rise up, and build. And their hands were strengthened in good .
text_la: Et indicavi eis manum Dei mei, quod esset bona mecum, et verba regis quæ locutus esset mihi, et aio : Surgamus, et ædificemus. Et confortatæ sunt manus eorum in bono.
text_pt: Então lhes declarei como a mão do meu Deus me fora favorável, como também as palavras do rei, que ele me tinha dito; então disseram: Levantemo-nos, e edifiquemos. E esforçaram as suas mãos para o bem.
text_el: καὶ ἀπήγγειλα αὐτοῖς τὴν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ ἥ ἐστιν ἀγαθὴ ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ τοὺς λόγους τοῦ βασιλέως οὓς εἶπέν μοι καὶ εἶπα ἀναστῶμεν καὶ οἰκοδομήσωμεν καὶ ἐκραταιώθησαν αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν εἰς ἀγαθόν

text_en: But Sanaballat the Horonite, and Tobias the servant, the Ammonite , and Gossem the Arabian heard of it, and they scoffed at us, and despised us, and said: What is this thing that you do? Are you going to rebel against the king?
text_la: Audierunt autem Sanaballat Horonites, et Tobias servus Ammanites, et Gosem Arabs, et subsannaverunt nos, et despexerunt, dixeruntque : Quæ est hæc res quam facitis? numquid contra regem vos rebellatis?
text_pt: O que ouvindo Sambalate, o horonita, e Tobias, o servo amonita, e Gesém, o árabe, zombaram de nós, e desprezaram-nos, e disseram: Que é isto que fazeis? Quereis rebelar-vos contra o rei?
text_el: καὶ ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλατ ὁ Αρωνι καὶ Τωβια ὁ δοῦλος ὁ Αμμωνι καὶ Γησαμ ὁ Αραβι καὶ ἐξεγέλασαν ἡμᾶς καὶ ἦλθον ἐφ' ἡμᾶς καὶ εἶπαν τί τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο ὃ ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε ἦ ἐπὶ τὸν βασιλέα ὑμεῖς ἀποστατεῖτε

text_en: And I answered them, and said to them: The God of heaven he helps us, and we are his servants: let us rise up and build: but you have no part, nor justice , nor remembrance in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et reddidi eis sermonem, dixique ad eos : Deus cæli ipse nos juvat, et nos servi ejus sumus : surgamus et ædificemus : vobis autem non est pars, et justitia, et memoria in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Então lhes respondi, e disse: O Deus dos céus é o que nos fará prosperar: e nós, seus servos, nos levantaremos e edificaremos; mas vós não tendes parte, nem justiça, nem memória em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέστρεψα αὐτοῖς λόγον καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς ὁ θεὸς τοῦ οὐρανοῦ αὐτὸς εὐοδώσει ἡμῖν καὶ ἡμεῖς δοῦλοι αὐτοῦ καθαροί καὶ οἰκοδομήσομεν καὶ ὑμῖν οὐκ ἔστιν μερὶς καὶ δικαιοσύνη καὶ μνημόσυνον ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: Then Eliasib the high priest arose, and his brethren the priests , and they built the flock gate: they sanctified it, and set up the doors thereof, even unto the tower of a hundred cubits they sanctified it unto the tower of Hananeel.
text_la: Et surrexit Eliasib sacerdos magnus, et fratres ejus sacerdotes, et ædificaverunt portam gregis : ipsi sanctificaverunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et usque ad turrim centum cubitorum sanctificaverunt eam, usque ad turrim Hananeel.
text_pt: E levantou-se Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, com os seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, e reedificaram a porta do gado, a qual consagraram; e levantaram as suas portas, e até à torre de Meá consagraram, e até à torre de Hananel.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέστη Ελισουβ ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ μέγας καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν τὴν πύλην τὴν προβατικήν αὐτοὶ ἡγίασαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ ἕως πύργου τῶν ἑκατὸν ἡγίασαν ἕως πύργου Ανανεηλ

text_en: And next to him the men of Jericho built: and next to them built Zachur the son of Amri.
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificaverunt viri Jericho : et juxta eum ædificavit Zachur filius Amri.
text_pt: E junto a ele edificaram os homens de Jericó; também ao seu lado edificou Zacur, filho de Imri.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρας υἱῶν ἀνδρῶν Ιεριχω καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρας υἱῶν Ζακχουρ υἱοῦ Αμαρι

text_en: But the fish gate the sons of Asnaa built: they covered it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars. And next to them built Marimuth the son of Urias the son of Accus.
text_la: Portam autem piscium ædificaverunt filii Asnaa : ipsi texerunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes. Et juxta eos ædificavit Marimuth filius Uriæ, filii Accus.
text_pt: E à porta do peixe edificaram os filhos de Hassenaá; a qual emadeiraram, e levantaram as suas portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.
text_el: καὶ τὴν πύλην τὴν ἰχθυηρὰν ᾠκοδόμησαν υἱοὶ Ασανα αὐτοὶ ἐστέγασαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχεν ἀπὸ Ραμωθ υἱὸς Ουρια υἱοῦ Ακως

text_en: And next to him built Mosollam the son of Barachias, the son of Merezebel, and next to them built Sadoc the son of Baana.
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ, filii Mesezebel : et juxta eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Baana.
text_pt: E ao seu lado reparou Meremote, filho de Urias, o filho de Coz; e ao seu lado reparou Mesulão, filho de Berequias, o filho de Mesezabeel; e ao seu lado reparou Zadoque, filho de Baana.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχεν Μοσολλαμ υἱὸς Βαραχιου υἱοῦ Μασεζεβηλ καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχεν Σαδωκ υἱὸς Βαανα

text_en: And next to them the Thecuites built: but their great men did not put their necks to the work of their Lord .
text_la: Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Thecueni : optimates autem eorum non supposuerunt colla sua in opere Domini sui.
text_pt: E ao seu lado repararam os tecoítas; porém os seus nobres não submeteram a cerviz ao serviço de seu Senhor.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν κατέσχοσαν οἱ Θεκωιν καὶ αδωρηεμ οὐκ εἰσήνεγκαν τράχηλον αὐτῶν εἰς δουλείαν αὐτῶν

text_en: And Joiada the son of Phasea, and Mosollam the son of Besodia built the old gate: they covered it and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars.
text_la: Et portam veterem ædificaverunt Jojada filius Phasea, et Mosollam filius Besodia : ipsi texerunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.
text_pt: E a porta velha repararam-na Joiada, filho de Paséia, e Mesulão, filho de Besodias; estes a emadeiraram, e levantaram as suas portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.
text_el: καὶ τὴν πύλην τοῦ Ισανα ἐκράτησαν Ιοϊδα υἱὸς Φασεκ καὶ Μεσουλαμ υἱὸς Βασωδια αὐτοὶ ἐστέγασαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: And next to them built Meltias the Gabaonite, and Jadon the Meronathite, the men of Gabaon and Maspha , for the governor that was in the country beyond the river.
text_la: Et juxta eos ædificaverunt Meltias Gabaonites, et Jadon Meronathites, viri de Gabaon et Maspha, pro duce qui erat in regione trans flumen.
text_pt: E ao seu lado repararam Melatias, o gibeonita, e Jadom, meronotita, homens de Gibeom e Mizpá, que pertenciam ao domínio do governador dalém do rio.

text_en: And next to him built Eziel the son of Araia the goldsmith: and next to him built Ananias the son of the perfumer: and they left Jerusalem unto the wall of the broad street.
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificavit Eziel filius Araia aurifex : et juxta eum ædificavit Ananias filius pigmentarii : et dimiserunt Jerusalem usque ad murum plateæ latioris.
text_pt: Ao seu lado reparou Uziel, filho de Haraías, um dos ourives; e ao seu lado reparou Hananias, filho de um dos boticários; e fortificaram a Jerusalém até ao muro largo.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ανανιας υἱὸς τοῦ Ρωκεϊμ καὶ κατέλιπον Ιερουσαλημ ἕως τοῦ τείχους τοῦ πλατέος

text_en: And next to him built Raphaia the son of Hur, lord of the street of Jerusalem .
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificavit Raphaia filius Hur, princeps vici Jerusalem.
text_pt: E ao seu lado reparou Refaías, filho de Hur, líder da metade de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ραφαια ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And next to him Jedaia the son of Haromaph over against his own house: and next to him built Hattus the son of Hasebonia.
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificavit Jedaia filius Haromaph contra domum suam : et juxta eum ædificavit Hattus filius Haseboniæ.
text_pt: E ao seu lado reparou Jedaías, filho de Harumafe, e defronte de sua casa e ao seu lado reparou Hatus, filho de Hasabnéias.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν ἐκράτησεν Ιεδαια υἱὸς Ερωμαφ καὶ κατέναντι οἰκίας αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Ατους υἱὸς Ασβανια

text_en: Melchias the son of Herem, and Hasub the son of Phahath Moab , built half the street, and the tower of the furnaces.
text_la: Mediam partem vici ædificavit Melchias filius Herem, et Hasub filius Phahath Moab, et turrim furnorum.
text_pt: A outra porção reparou Malquias, filho de Harim, e Hasube, filho de Paate-Moabe; como também a torre dos fornos.
text_el: καὶ δεύτερος ἐκράτησεν Μελχιας υἱὸς Ηραμ καὶ Ασουβ υἱὸς Φααθμωαβ καὶ ἕως πύργου τῶν θαννουριμ

text_en: And next to him built Sellum the son of Alohes, lord of half the street of Jerusalem , he and his daughters.
text_la: Et juxta eum ædificavit Sellum filius Alohes, princeps mediæ partis vici Jerusalem, ipse et filiæ ejus.
text_pt: E ao seu lado reparou Salum, filho de Haloés, líder da outra meia parte de Jerusalém, ele e suas filhas.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Σαλουμ υἱὸς Αλλωης ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Ιερουσαλημ αὐτὸς καὶ αἱ θυγατέρες αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the gate of the valley Hanun built, and the inhabitants of Zanoe: they built it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars, and a thousand cubits in the wall unto the gate of the dunghill.
text_la: Et portam vallis ædificavit Hanun, et habitatores Zanoë : ipsi ædificaverunt eam, et statuerunt valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes, et mille cubitos in muro usque ad portam sterquilinii.
text_pt: A porta do vale reparou-a Hanum e os moradores de Zanoa; estes a edificaram, e lhe levantaram as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos, como também mil côvados do muro, até a porta do monturo.
text_el: τὴν πύλην τῆς φάραγγος ἐκράτησαν Ανουν καὶ οἱ κατοικοῦντες Ζανω αὐτοὶ ᾠκοδόμησαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς καὶ χιλίους πήχεις ἐν τῷ τείχει ἕως πύλης τῆς κοπρίας

text_en: And the gate of the dunghill Melchias the son of Rechab built, lord of the street of Bethacharam: he built it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars.
text_la: Et portam sterquilinii ædificavit Melchias filius Rechab, princeps vici Bethacharam : ipse ædificavit eam, et statuit valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes.
text_pt: E a porta do monturo reparou-a Malquias, filho de Recabe, líder do distrito de Bete-Haquerém; este a edificou, e lhe levantou as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos.
text_el: καὶ τὴν πύλην τῆς κοπρίας ἐκράτησεν Μελχια υἱὸς Ρηχαβ ἄρχων περιχώρου Βηθαχαρμ αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐσκέπασαν αὐτὴν καὶ ἔστησαν θύρας αὐτῆς καὶ κλεῖθρα αὐτῆς καὶ μοχλοὺς αὐτῆς

text_en: And the gate of the fountain, Sellum, the son of Cholhoza, built, lord of the street of Maspha : he built it, and covered it, and set up the doors thereof, and the locks, and the bars, and the walls of the pool of Siloe unto the king's guard, and unto the steps that go down from the city of David.
text_la: Et portam fontis ædificavit Sellum filius Cholhoza, princeps pagi Maspha : ipse ædificavit eam, et texit, et statuit valvas ejus, et seras, et vectes, et muros piscinæ Siloë in hortum regis, et usque ad gradus qui descendunt de civitate David.
text_pt: E a porta da fonte reparou-a Salum, filho de Col-Hoze, líder do distrito de Mizpá; este a edificou, e a cobriu, e lhe levantou as portas com as suas fechaduras e os seus ferrolhos, como também o muro do tanque de Hasselá, ao pé do jardim do rei, e até aos degraus que descem da cidade de Davi.
text_el: καὶ τὸ τεῖχος κολυμβήθρας τῶν κωδίων τῇ κουρᾷ τοῦ βασιλέως καὶ ἕως τῶν κλιμάκων τῶν καταβαινουσῶν ἀπὸ πόλεως Δαυιδ

text_en: After him built Nehemias the son of Azboc, lord of half the street of Bethsur, as far as over against the sepulchre of David , and to the pool , that was built with great labour, and to the house of the mighty.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Nehemias filius Azboc, princeps dimidiæ partis vici Bethsur, usque contra sepulchrum David, et usque ad piscinam quæ grandi opere constructa est, et usque ad domum fortium.
text_pt: Depois dele edificou Neemias, filho de Azbuque, líder da metade de Bete-Zur, até defronte dos sepulcros de Davi, até ao tanque artificial e até à casa dos valentes.
text_el: ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Νεεμιας υἱὸς Αζαβουχ ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Βηθσουρ ἕως κήπου τάφου Δαυιδ καὶ ἕως τῆς κολυμβήθρας τῆς γεγονυίας καὶ ἕως Βηθαγγαβαριμ

text_en: After him built the Levites , Rehum the son of Benni. After him built Hasebias, lord of half the street of Ceila in his own street.
text_la: Post eum ædificaverunt Levitæ, Rehum filius Benni : post eum ædificavit Hasebias princeps dimidiæ partis vici Ceilæ in vico suo.
text_pt: Depois dele repararam os levitas, Reum, filho de Bani; ao seu lado reparou Hasabias, líder da metade de Queila, no seu distrito.
text_el: ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησαν οἱ Λευῖται Ραουμ υἱὸς Βανι ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ ἐκράτησεν Ασαβια ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Κεϊλα τῷ περιχώρῳ αὐτοῦ

text_en: After him built their brethren Bavai the son of Enadad, lord of half Ceila.
text_la: Post eum ædificaverunt fratres eorum : Bavai filius Enadad, princeps dimidiæ partis Ceilæ:
text_pt: Depois dele repararam seus irmãos, Bavai, filho de Henadade, líder da outra meia parte de Queila.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησαν ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν Βενι υἱὸς Ηναδαδ ἄρχων ἡμίσους περιχώρου Κεϊλα

text_en: And next to him Aser the son of Josue, lord of Maspha , built another measure, over against the going up of the strong corner.
text_la: et ædificavit juxta eum Azer filius Josue, princeps Maspha, mensuram secundam, contra ascensum firmissimi anguli.
text_pt: Ao seu lado reparou Ezer, filho de Jesuá, líder de Mizpá, outra porção, defronte da subida à casa das armas, à esquina.
text_el: καὶ ἐκράτησεν ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτοῦ Αζουρ υἱὸς Ἰησοῦ ἄρχων τοῦ Μασφε μέτρον δεύτερον πύργου ἀναβάσεως τῆς συναπτούσης τῆς γωνίας

text_en: After him in the mount Baruch the son of Zachai built another measure, from the corner to the door of the house of Eliasib the high priest .
text_la: Post eum in monte ædificavit Baruch filius Zachai mensuram secundam, ab angulo usque ad portam domus Eliasib sacerdotis magni.
text_pt: Depois dele reparou com grande ardor Baruque, filho de Zabai, outra medida, desde a esquina até à porta da casa de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Βαρουχ υἱὸς Ζαβου μέτρον δεύτερον ἀπὸ τῆς γωνίας ἕως θύρας Βηθελισουβ τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ μεγάλου

text_en: After him Merimuth the son of Urias the son of Haccus, built another measure, from the door of the house of Eliasib, to the end of the house of Eliasib.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Merimuth filius Uriæ filii Haccus, mensuram secundam, a porta domus Eliasib, donec extenderetur domus Eliasib.
text_pt: Depois dele reparou Meremote, filho de Urias, o filho de Coz, outra porção, desde a porta da casa de Eliasibe, até à extremidade da casa de Eliasibe.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Μεραμωθ υἱὸς Ουρια υἱοῦ Ακως μέτρον δεύτερον ἀπὸ θύρας Βηθελισουβ ἕως ἐκλείψεως Βηθελισουβ

text_en: And after him built the priests , the men of the plains of the Jordan .
text_la: Et post eum ædificaverunt sacerdotes, viri de campestribus Jordanis.
text_pt: E depois dele repararam os sacerdotes que habitavam na campina.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἄνδρες Αχεχαρ

text_en: After him built Benjamin and Hasub, over against their own house: and after him built Azarias the son of Maasias the son of Ananias over against his house.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Benjamin et Hasub contra domum suam: et post eum ædificavit Azarias filius Maasiæ filii Ananiæ contra domum suam.
text_pt: Depois reparou Benjamim e Hasube, defronte da sua casa; depois dele reparou Azarias, filho de Maaséias, o filho de Ananias, junto à sua casa.
text_el: καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Βενιαμιν καὶ Ασουβ κατέναντι οἴκου αὐτῶν μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Αζαρια υἱὸς Μαασηα υἱοῦ Ανανια ἐχόμενα οἴκου αὐτοῦ

text_en: After him built Bennui the son of Hanadad another measure, from the house of Azarias unto the bending, and unto the corner.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Bennui filius Henadad mensuram secundam, a domo Azariæ usque ad flexuram, et usque ad angulum.
text_pt: Depois dele reparou Binui, filho de Henadade, outra porção, desde a casa de Azarias até à esquina, e até ao canto.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Βανι υἱὸς Ηναδαδ μέτρον δεύτερον ἀπὸ Βηθαζαρια ἕως τῆς γωνίας καὶ ἕως τῆς καμπῆς

text_en: Phalel, the son of Ozi, over against the bending and the tower, which lies out from the king's high house, that is, in the court of the prison: after him Phadaia the son of Pharos.
text_la: Phalel filius Ozi contra flexuram, et turrim quæ eminet de domo regis excelsa, id est, in atrio carceris : post eum Phadaia filius Pharos.
text_pt: Palal, filho de Uzai, reparou defronte da esquina, e a torre que sai da casa real superior, que está junto ao pátio da prisão; depois dele Pedaías, filho de Parós.
text_el: Φαλαλ υἱοῦ Ευζαι ἐξ ἐναντίας τῆς γωνίας καὶ ὁ πύργος ὁ ἐξέχων ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου τοῦ βασιλέως ὁ ἀνώτερος ὁ τῆς αὐλῆς τῆς φυλακῆς καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν Φαδαια υἱὸς Φορος

text_en: And the Nathinites dwelt in Ophel, as far as over against the water gate toward the east, and the tower that stood out.
text_la: Nathinæi autem habitabant in Ophel usque contra portam aquarum ad orientem, et turrim quæ prominebat.
text_pt: E os servidores do templo que habitavam em Ofel, até defronte da porta das águas, para o oriente, e até à torre alta.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ναθινιμ ἦσαν οἰκοῦντες ἐν τῷ Ωφαλ ἕως κήπου πύλης τοῦ ὕδατος εἰς ἀνατολάς καὶ ὁ πύργος ὁ ἐξέχων

text_en: After him the Thecuites built another measure over against, from the great tower that stands out unto the wall of the temple .
text_la: Post eum ædificaverunt Thecueni mensuram secundam e regione, a turre magna et eminente usque ad murum templi.
text_pt: Depois repararam os tecoítas outra porção, defronte da torre grande e alta, e até ao muro de Ofel.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησαν οἱ Θεκωιν μέτρον δεύτερον ἐξ ἐναντίας τοῦ πύργου τοῦ μεγάλου τοῦ ἐξέχοντος καὶ ἕως τοῦ τείχους τοῦ Οφλα

text_en: And upward from the horse gate the priests built, every man over against his house.
text_la: Sursum autem a porta equorum ædificaverunt sacerdotes, unusquisque contra domum suam.
text_pt: Desde acima da porta dos cavalos repararam os sacerdotes, cada um defronte da sua casa.
text_el: ἀνώτερον πύλης τῶν ἵππων ἐκράτησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς ἀνὴρ ἐξ ἐναντίας οἴκου αὐτοῦ

text_en: After them built Sadoc the son of Emmer over against his house. And after him built Semaia the son of Sechenias, keeper of the east gate.
text_la: Post eos ædificavit Sadoc filius Emmer contra domum suam. Et post eum ædificavit Semaia filius Secheniæ, custos portæ orientalis.
text_pt: Depois deles reparou Zadoque, filho de Imer, defronte da sua casa; e depois dele reparou Semaías, filho de Secanias, guarda da porta oriental.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Σαδδουκ υἱὸς Εμμηρ ἐξ ἐναντίας οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Σαμαια υἱὸς Σεχενια φύλαξ τῆς πύλης τῆς ἀνατολῆς

text_en: After him built Hanania the son of Selemia, and Hanun the sixth son of Seleph, another measure: after him built Mosollam the son of Barachias over against his treasury.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Hanania filius Selemiæ, et Hanun filius Seleph sextus, mensuram secundam : post eum ædificavit Mosollam filius Barachiæ, contra gazophylacium suum.
text_pt: Depois dele reparou Hananias, filho de Selemias, e Hanum, filho de Zalafe, o sexto, outra porção; depois dele reparou Mesulão, filho de Berequias, defronte da sua câmara.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Ανανια υἱὸς Σελεμια καὶ Ανουμ υἱὸς Σελεφ ὁ ἕκτος μέτρον δεύτερον μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Μεσουλαμ υἱὸς Βαρχια ἐξ ἐναντίας γαζοφυλακίου αὐτοῦ

text_en: After him Melcias the goldsmith's son built unto the house of the Nathinites , and of the sellers of small wares, over against the judgment gate, and unto the chamber of the corner.
text_la: Post eum ædificavit Melchias filius aurificis usque ad domum Nathinæorum, et scruta vendentium contra portam judicialem, et usque ad cœnaculum anguli.
text_pt: Depois dele reparou Malquias, filho de um ourives, até à casa dos servidores do templo e mercadores, defronte da porta de Mifcade, e até à câmara do canto.
text_el: μετ' αὐτὸν ἐκράτησεν Μελχια υἱὸς τοῦ Σαραφι ἕως Βηθαναθινιμ καὶ οἱ ῥοποπῶλαι ἀπέναντι πύλης τοῦ Μαφεκαδ καὶ ἕως ἀναβάσεως τῆς καμπῆς

text_en: And within the chamber of the corner of the flock gate, the goldsmiths and the merchants built.
text_la: Et inter cœnaculum anguli in porta gregis, ædificaverunt aurifices et negotiatores.
text_pt: E entre a câmara do canto e a porta do gado, repararam os ourives e os mercadores.
text_el: καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον ἀναβάσεως τῆς πύλης τῆς προβατικῆς ἐκράτησαν οἱ χαλκεῖς καὶ οἱ ῥοποπῶλαι

text_en: And it came to pass, that when Sanaballat heard that we were building the wall he was angry : and being moved exceedingly he scoffed at the Jews .
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat quod ædificaremus murum, iratus est valde : et motus nimis subsannavit Judæos,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Sambalate que edificávamos o muro, ardeu em ira, e se indignou muito; e escarneceu dos judeus.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλατ ὅτι ἡμεῖς οἰκοδομοῦμεν τὸ τεῖχος καὶ πονηρὸν ἦν αὐτῷ καὶ ὠργίσθη ἐπὶ πολὺ καὶ ἐξεγέλα ἐπὶ τοῖς Ιουδαίοις

text_en: And said before his brethren, and the multitude of the Samaritans : What are the silly Jews doing? Will the Gentiles let them alone? Will they sacrifice and make an end in a day? Are they able to raise stones out of the heaps of the rubbish, which are burnt?
text_la: et dixit coram fratribus suis, et frequentia Samaritanorum : Quid Judæi faciunt imbecilles? num dimittent eos gentes? num sacrificabunt, et complebunt in una die? numquid ædificare poterunt lapides de acervis pulveris, qui combusti sunt?
text_pt: E falou na presença de seus irmãos, e do exército de Samaria, e disse: Que fazem estes fracos judeus? Permitir-se-lhes-á isto? Sacrificarão? Acabá-lo-ão num só dia? Vivificarão dos montões do pó as pedras que foram queimadas?
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀδελφῶν αὐτοῦ αὕτη ἡ δύναμις Σομορων ὅτι οἱ Ιουδαῖοι οὗτοι οἰκοδομοῦσιν τὴν ἑαυτῶν πόλιν

text_en: Tobias also the Ammonite who was by him said: Let them build: if a fox go up, he will leap over their stone wall.
text_la: Sed et Tobias Ammanites, proximus ejus, ait : Ædificent : si ascenderit vulpes, transiliet murum eorum lapideum.
text_pt: E estava com ele Tobias, o amonita, e disse: Ainda que edifiquem, contudo, vindo uma raposa, derrubará facilmente o seu muro de pedra.
text_el: καὶ Τωβιας ὁ αμμανίτης ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ ἦλθεν καὶ εἶπαν πρὸς ἑαυτούς μὴ θυσιάσουσιν ἢ φάγονται ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου αὐτῶν οὐχὶ ἀναβήσεται ἀλώπηξ καὶ καθελεῖ τὸ τεῖχος λίθων αὐτῶν

text_en: Hear our God , for we are despised : turn their reproach upon their own head, and give them to be despised in a land of captivity.
text_la: Audi, Deus noster, quia facti sumus despectui : converte opprobrium super caput eorum, et da eos in despectionem in terra captivitatis.
text_pt: Ouve, ó nosso Deus, que somos tão desprezados, e torna o seu opróbrio sobre a sua cabeça, e dá-os por presa, na terra do cativeiro.
text_el: ἄκουσον ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐγενήθημεν εἰς μυκτηρισμόν καὶ ἐπίστρεψον ὀνειδισμὸν αὐτῶν εἰς κεφαλὴν αὐτῶν καὶ δὸς αὐτοὺς εἰς μυκτηρισμὸν ἐν γῇ αἰχμαλωσίας

text_en: Cover not their iniquity , and let not their sin be blotted out from before your face, because they have mocked your builders.
text_la: Ne operias iniquitatem eorum, et peccatum eorum coram facie tua non deleatur, quia irriserunt ædificantes.
text_pt: E não cubras a sua iniqüidade, e não se risque de diante de ti o seu pecado, pois que te irritaram na presença dos edificadores.
text_el: καὶ μὴ καλύψῃς ἐπὶ ἀνομίαν

text_en: So we built the wall, and joined it all together unto the half thereof: and the heart of the people was excited to work.
text_la: Itaque ædificavimus murum, et conjunximus totum usque ad partem dimidiam : et provocatum est cor populi ad operandum.
text_pt: Porém edificamos o muro, e todo o muro se fechou até sua metade; porque o coração do povo se inclinava a trabalhar.

text_en: And it came to pass, when Sanaballat, and Tobias, and the Arabians, and the Ammonites , and the Azotians heard that the walls of Jerusalem were made up, and the breaches began to be closed, that they were exceedingly angry .
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat, et Tobias, et Arabes, et Ammanitæ, et Azotii, quod obducta esset cicatrix muri Jerusalem, et quod cœpissent interrupta concludi, irati sunt nimis.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo Sambalate e Tobias, e os árabes, os amonitas, e os asdoditas, que tanto ia crescendo a reparação dos muros de Jerusalém, que já as roturas se começavam a tapar, iraram-se sobremodo,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσεν Σαναβαλλατ καὶ Τωβια καὶ οἱ Ἄραβες καὶ οἱ Αμμανῖται ὅτι ἀνέβη φυὴ τοῖς τείχεσιν Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι ἤρξαντο αἱ διασφαγαὶ ἀναφράσσεσθαι καὶ πονηρὸν αὐτοῖς ἐφάνη σφόδρα

text_en: And they all assembled themselves together, to come, and to fight against Jerusalem , and to prepare ambushes.
text_la: Et congregati sunt omnes pariter ut venirent, et pugnarent contra Jerusalem, et molirentur insidias.
text_pt: E ligaram-se entre si todos, para virem guerrear contra Jerusalém, e para os desviarem do seu intento.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πάντες ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐλθεῖν παρατάξασθαι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And we prayed to our God , and set watchmen upon the wall day and night against them.
text_la: Et oravimus Deum nostrum, et posuimus custodes super murum die ac nocte contra eos.
text_pt: Porém nós oramos ao nosso Deus e pusemos uma guarda contra eles, de dia e de noite, por causa deles.
text_el: καὶ προσηυξάμεθα πρὸς τὸν θεὸν ἡμῶν καὶ ἐστήσαμεν προφύλακας ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἡμέρας καὶ νυκτὸς ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν

text_en: And Juda said: The strength of the bearer of burdens is decayed, and the rubbish is very much, and we shall not be able to build the wall.
text_la: Dixit autem Judas : Debilitata est fortitudo portantis, et humus nimia est, et nos non poterimus ædificare murum.
text_pt: Então disse Judá: Já desfaleceram as forças dos carregadores, e o pó é muito, e nós não poderemos edificar o muro.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Ιουδας συνετρίβη ἡ ἰσχὺς τῶν ἐχθρῶν καὶ ὁ χοῦς πολύς καὶ ἡμεῖς οὐ δυνησόμεθα οἰκοδομεῖν ἐν τῷ τείχει

text_en: And our enemies said: Let them not know, nor understand, till we come in the midst of them, and kill them, and cause the work to cease.
text_la: Et dixerunt hostes nostri : Nesciant, et ignorent donec veniamus in medium eorum, et interficiamus eos, et cessare faciamus opus.
text_pt: Disseram, porém, os nossos inimigos: Nada saberão disto, nem verão, até que entremos no meio deles, e os matemos; assim faremos cessar a obra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν οἱ θλίβοντες ἡμᾶς οὐ γνώσονται καὶ οὐκ ὄψονται ἕως ὅτου ἔλθωμεν εἰς μέσον αὐτῶν καὶ φονεύσωμεν αὐτοὺς καὶ καταπαύσωμεν τὸ ἔργον

text_en: And it came to pass, that when the Jews that dwelt by them came and told us ten times, out of all the places from whence they came to us,
text_la: Factum est autem venientibus Judæis qui habitabant juxta eos, et dicentibus nobis per decem vices, ex omnibus locis quibus venerant ad nos,
text_pt: E sucedeu que, vindo os judeus que habitavam entre eles, dez vezes nos disseram: De todos os lugares, tornarão contra nós.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤλθοσαν οἱ Ιουδαῖοι οἱ οἰκοῦντες ἐχόμενα αὐτῶν καὶ εἴποσαν ἡμῖν ἀναβαίνουσιν ἐκ πάντων τῶν τόπων ἐφ' ἡμᾶς

text_en: I set the people in the place behind the wall round about in order, with their swords, and spears, and bows.
text_la: statui in loco post murum per circuitum populum in ordinem cum gladiis suis, et lanceis, et arcubus.
text_pt: Então pus guardas nos lugares baixos por detrás do muro e nos altos; e pus ao povo pelas suas famílias com as suas espadas, com as suas lanças, e com os seus arcos.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησα εἰς τὰ κατώτατα τοῦ τόπου κατόπισθεν τοῦ τείχους ἐν τοῖς σκεπεινοῖς καὶ ἔστησα τὸν λαὸν κατὰ δήμους μετὰ ῥομφαιῶν αὐτῶν λόγχας αὐτῶν καὶ τόξα αὐτῶν

text_en: And I looked and rose up: and I said to the chief men and the magistrates, and to the rest of the common people: be not afraid of them. Remember the Lord who is great and terrible, and fight for your brethren, your sons, and your daughters, and your wives, and your houses.
text_la: Et perspexi atque surrexi : et aio ad optimates et magistratus, et ad reliquam partem vulgi : Nolite timere a facie eorum : Domini magni et terribilis mementote, et pugnate pro fratribus vestris, filiis vestris, et filiabus vestris, et uxoribus vestris, et domibus vestris.
text_pt: E olhei, e levantei-me, e disse aos nobres, aos magistrados, e ao restante do povo: Não os temais; lembrai-vos do grande e terrível Senhor, e pelejai pelos vossos irmãos, vossos filhos, vossas mulheres e vossas casas.
text_el: καὶ εἶδον καὶ ἀνέστην καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τοὺς ἐντίμους καὶ πρὸς τοὺς στρατηγοὺς καὶ πρὸς τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ προσώπου αὐτῶν μνήσθητε τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ μεγάλου καὶ φοβεροῦ καὶ παρατάξασθε περὶ τῶν ἀδελφῶν ὑμῶν υἱῶν ὑμῶν καὶ θυγατέρων ὑμῶν γυναικῶν ὑμῶν καὶ οἴκων ὑμῶν

text_en: And it came to pass, when our enemies heard that the thing had been told us, that God defeated their counsel. And we returned all of us to the walls, every man to his work.
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audissent inimici nostri nuntiatum esse nobis, dissipavit Deus consilium eorum. Et reversi sumus omnes ad muros, unusquisque ad opus suum.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo os nossos inimigos que já o sabíamos, e que Deus tinha dissipado o conselho deles, todos voltamos ao muro, cada um à sua obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἤκουσαν οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν ὅτι ἐγνώσθη ἡμῖν καὶ διεσκέδασεν ὁ θεὸς τὴν βουλὴν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐπεστρέψαμεν πάντες ἡμεῖς εἰς τὸ τεῖχος ἀνὴρ εἰς τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And it came to pass from that day forward, that half of their young men did the work, and half were ready for to fight, with spears, and shields, and bows, and coats of mail, and the rulers were behind them in all the house of Juda .
text_la: Et factum est a die illa, media pars juvenum eorum faciebat opus, et media parata erat ad bellum : et lanceæ, et scuta, et arcus, et loricæ, et principes post eos in omni domo Juda.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, desde aquele dia, metade dos meus servos trabalhava na obra, e metade deles tinha as lanças, os escudos, os arcos e as couraças; e os líderes estavam por detrás de toda a casa de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης ἥμισυ τῶν ἐκτετιναγμένων ἐποίουν τὸ ἔργον καὶ ἥμισυ αὐτῶν ἀντείχοντο καὶ λόγχαι καὶ θυρεοὶ καὶ τὰ τόξα καὶ οἱ θώρακες καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ὀπίσω παντὸς οἴκου Ιουδα

text_en: Of them that built on the wall and that carried burdens, and that laded: with one of his hands he did the work, and with the other he held a sword.
text_la: Ædificantium in muro, et portantium onera, et imponentium : una manu sua faciebat opus, et altera tenebat gladium:
text_pt: Os que edificavam o muro, os que traziam as cargas e os que carregavam, cada um com uma das mãos fazia a obra e na outra tinha as armas.
text_el: τῶν οἰκοδομούντων ἐν τῷ τείχει καὶ οἱ αἴροντες ἐν τοῖς ἀρτῆρσιν ἐν ὅπλοις ἐν μιᾷ χειρὶ ἐποίει αὐτὸ τὸ ἔργον καὶ μία ἐκράτει τὴν βολίδα

text_en: For every one of the builders was girded with a sword about his reins. And they built, and sounded with a trumpet by me.
text_la: ædificentium enim unusquisque gladio erat accinctus renes. Et ædificabant, et clangebant buccina juxta me.
text_pt: E os edificadores cada um trazia a sua espada cingida aos lombos, e edificavam; e o que tocava a trombeta estava junto comigo.
text_el: καὶ οἱ οἰκοδόμοι ἀνὴρ ῥομφαίαν αὐτοῦ ἐζωσμένος ἐπὶ τὴν ὀσφὺν αὐτοῦ καὶ ᾠκοδομοῦσαν καὶ ὁ σαλπίζων ἐν τῇ κερατίνῃ ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And I said to the nobles, and to the magistrates, and to the rest of the common people: The work is great and wide, and we are separated on the wall one far from another:
text_la: Et dixi ad optimates, et ad magistratus, et ad reliquam partem vulgi : Opus grande est et latum, et nos separati sumus in muro procul alter ab altero:
text_pt: E disse eu aos nobres, aos magistrados e ao restante do povo: Grande e extensa é a obra, e nós estamos apartados do muro, longe uns dos outros.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα πρὸς τοὺς ἐντίμους καὶ πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ πρὸς τοὺς καταλοίπους τοῦ λαοῦ τὸ ἔργον πλατὺ καὶ πολύ καὶ ἡμεῖς σκορπιζόμεθα ἐπὶ τοῦ τείχους μακρὰν ἀνὴρ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀδελφοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: In what place soever you shall hear the sound of the trumpet, run all thither unto us: our God will fight for us.
text_la: in loco quocumque audieritis clangorem tubæ, illuc concurrite ad nos : Deus noster pugnabit pro nobis.
text_pt: No lugar onde ouvirdes o som da buzina, ali vos ajuntareis conosco; o nosso Deus pelejará por nós.
text_el: ἐν τόπῳ οὗ ἐὰν ἀκούσητε τὴν φωνὴν τῆς κερατίνης ἐκεῖ συναχθήσεσθε πρὸς ἡμᾶς καὶ ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν πολεμήσει περὶ ἡμῶν

text_en: And let us do the work: and let one half of us hold our spears from the rising of the morning, till the stars appear.
text_la: Et nos ipsi faciamus opus, et media pars nostrum teneat lanceas ab ascensu auroræ donec egrediantur astra.
text_pt: Assim trabalhávamos na obra; e metade deles tinha as lanças desde a subida da alva até ao sair das estrelas.
text_el: καὶ ἡμεῖς ποιοῦντες τὸ ἔργον καὶ ἥμισυ αὐτῶν κρατοῦντες τὰς λόγχας ἀπὸ ἀναβάσεως τοῦ ὄρθρου ἕως ἐξόδου τῶν ἄστρων

text_en: At that time also I said to the people: Let every one with his servant stay in the midst of Jerusalem , and let us take our turns in the night, and by day, to work.
text_la: In tempore quoque illo dixi populo : Unusquisque cum puero suo maneat in medio Jerusalem, et sint nobis vices per noctem et diem ad operandum.
text_pt: Também naquele tempo disse ao povo: Cada um com o seu servo fique em Jerusalém, para que à noite nos sirvam de guarda, e de dia na obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῷ καιρῷ ἐκείνῳ εἶπα τῷ λαῷ αὐλίσθητε ἐν μέσῳ Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἔστω ὑμῖν ἡ νὺξ προφυλακὴ καὶ ἡ ἡμέρα ἔργον

text_en: Now I and my brethren, and my servants, and the watchmen that followed me, did not put off our clothes: only every man stripped himself when he was to be washed.
text_la: Ego autem et fratres mei, et pueri mei, et custodes, qui erant post me, non deponebamus vestimenta nostra : unusquisque tantum nudabatur ad baptismum.
text_pt: E nem eu, nem meus irmãos, nem meus servos, nem os homens da guarda que me seguiam largávamos as nossas vestes; cada um tinha suas armas e água.
text_el: καὶ ἤμην ἐγὼ καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες τῆς προφυλακῆς ὀπίσω μου καὶ οὐκ ἦν ἐξ ἡμῶν ἐκδιδυσκόμενος ἀνὴρ τὰ ἱμάτια αὐτοῦ

text_en: Now there was a great cry of the people, and of their wives against their brethren the Jews .
text_la: Et factus est clamor populi et uxorum ejus magnus adversus fratres suos Judæos.
text_pt: Foi, porém, grande o clamor do povo e de suas mulheres, contra os judeus, seus irmãos.
text_el: καὶ ἦν κραυγὴ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ γυναικῶν αὐτῶν μεγάλη πρὸς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν τοὺς Ιουδαίους

text_en: And there were some that said: Our sons and our daughters are very many: let us take up corn for the price of them, and let us eat and live.
text_la: Et erant qui dicerent : Filii nostri et filiæ nostræ multæ sunt nimis : accipiamus pro pretio eorum frumentum, et comedamus, et vivamus.
text_pt: Porque havia quem dizia: Nós, nossos filhos e nossas filhas, somos muitos; então tomemos trigo, para que comamos e vivamos.
text_el: καὶ ἦσάν τινες λέγοντες ἐν υἱοῖς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν θυγατράσιν ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς πολλοί καὶ λημψόμεθα σῖτον καὶ φαγόμεθα καὶ ζησόμεθα

text_en: And there were some that said: Let us mortgage our lands, and our vineyards, and our houses, and let us take corn because of the famine.
text_la: Et erant qui dicerent : Agros nostros, et vineas, et domus nostras opponamus, et accipiamus frumentum in fame.
text_pt: Também havia quem dizia: As nossas terras, as nossas vinhas e as nossas casas empenhamos, para tomarmos trigo nesta fome.
text_el: καὶ εἰσίν τινες λέγοντες ἀγροὶ ἡμῶν καὶ ἀμπελῶνες ἡμῶν καὶ οἰκίαι ἡμῶν ἡμεῖς διεγγυῶμεν καὶ λημψόμεθα σῖτον καὶ φαγόμεθα

text_en: And others said: Let us borrow money for the king's tribute, and let us give up our fields and vineyards:
text_la: Et alii dicebant : Mutuo sumamus pecunias in tributa regis, demusque agros nostros et vineas:
text_pt: Também havia quem dizia: Tomamos emprestado dinheiro até para o tributo do rei, sobre as nossas terras e as nossas vinhas.
text_el: καὶ εἰσίν τινες λέγοντες ἐδανεισάμεθα ἀργύριον εἰς φόρους τοῦ βασιλέως ἀγροὶ ἡμῶν καὶ ἀμπελῶνες ἡμῶν καὶ οἰκίαι ἡμῶν

text_en: And now our flesh is as the flesh of our brethren: and our children as their children. Behold we bring into bondage our sons and our daughters, and some of our daughters are bondwomen already, neither have we wherewith to redeem them, and our fields and our vineyards other men possess.
text_la: et nunc sicut carnes fratrum nostrorum, sic carnes nostræ sunt : et sicut filii eorum, ita et filii nostri : ecce nos subjugamus filios nostros et filias nostras in servitutem, et de filiabus nostris sunt famulæ, nec habemus unde possint redimi : et agros nostros et vineas nostras alii possident.
text_pt: Agora, pois, a nossa carne é como a carne de nossos irmãos, e nossos filhos como seus filhos; e eis que sujeitamos nossos filhos e nossas filhas para serem servos; e até algumas de nossas filhas são tão sujeitas, que já não estão no poder de nossas mãos; e outros têm as nossas terras e as nossas vinhas.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὡς σὰρξ ἀδελφῶν ἡμῶν σὰρξ ἡμῶν ὡς υἱοὶ αὐτῶν υἱοὶ ἡμῶν καὶ ἰδοὺ ἡμεῖς καταδυναστεύομεν τοὺς υἱοὺς ἡμῶν καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας ἡμῶν εἰς δούλους καὶ εἰσὶν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων ἡμῶν καταδυναστευόμεναι καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν δύναμις χειρῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ἀγροὶ ἡμῶν καὶ ἀμπελῶνες ἡμῶν τοῖς ἐντίμοις

text_en: And I was exceedingly angry when I heard their cry according to these words.
text_la: Et iratus sum nimis cum audissem clamorem eorum secundum verba hæc:
text_pt: Ouvindo eu, pois, o seu clamor, e estas palavras, muito me indignei.
text_el: καὶ ἐλυπήθην σφόδρα καθὼς ἤκουσα τὴν κραυγὴν αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς λόγους τούτους

text_en: And my heart thought with myself: and I rebuked the nobles and magistrates, and said to them: Do you every one exact usury of your brethren? And I gathered together a great assembly against them,
text_la: cogitavitque cor meum mecum, et increpavi optimates et magistratus, et dixi eis : Usurasne singuli a fratribus vestris exigitis? Et congregavi adversum eos concionem magnam,
text_pt: E considerei comigo mesmo no meu coração; depois pelejei com os nobres e com os magistrados, e disse-lhes: Sois usurários cada um para com seu irmão. E convoquei contra eles uma grande assembléia.
text_el: καὶ ἐβουλεύσατο καρδία μου ἐπ' ἐμέ καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην πρὸς τοὺς ἐντίμους καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς ἀπαιτήσει ἀνὴρ τὸν ἀδελφὸν αὐτοῦ ὑμεῖς ἀπαιτεῖτε καὶ ἔδωκα ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἐκκλησίαν μεγάλην

text_en: and I said to them: We, as you know, have redeemed according to our ability our brethren the Jews , that were sold to the Gentiles : and will you then sell your brethren, for us to redeem them? And they held their peace, and found not what to answer.
text_la: et dixi eis : Nos, ut scitis, redemimus fratres nostros Judæos, qui venditi fuerant gentibus secundum possibilitatem nostram : et vos igitur vendetis fratres vestros, et redimemus eos? Et siluerunt, nec invenerunt quid responderent.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Nós resgatamos os judeus, nossos irmãos, que foram vendidos às nações, segundo nossas posses; e vós outra vez venderíeis a vossos irmãos, ou vender-se-iam a nós? Então se calaram, e não acharam que responder.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς ἡμεῖς κεκτήμεθα τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ἡμῶν τοὺς Ιουδαίους τοὺς πωλουμένους τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἐν ἑκουσίῳ ἡμῶν καὶ ὑμεῖς πωλεῖτε τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὑμῶν καὶ ἡσύχασαν καὶ οὐχ εὕροσαν λόγον

text_en: And I said to them: The thing you do is not good : why walk you not in the fear of our God , that we be not exposed to the reproaches of the Gentiles our enemies?
text_la: Dixique ad eos : Non est bona res quam facitis : quare non in timore Dei nostri ambulastis, ne exprobretur nobis a gentibus inimicis nostris?
text_pt: Disse mais: Não é bom o que fazeis; porventura não andaríeis no temor do nosso Deus, por causa do opróbrio das nações, os nossos inimigos?
text_el: καὶ εἶπα οὐκ ἀγαθὸς ὁ λόγος ὃν ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε οὐχ οὕτως ἐν φόβῳ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἀπελεύσεσθε ἀπὸ ὀνειδισμοῦ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν

text_en: Both I and my brethren, and my servants, have lent money and corn to many: let us all agree not to call for it again; let us forgive the debt that is owing to us.
text_la: Et ego, et fratres mei, et pueri mei commodavimus plurimis pecuniam et frumentum. Non repetamus in commune istud : æs alienum concedamus quod debetur nobis.
text_pt: Também eu, meus irmãos e meus servos, a juros lhes temos emprestado dinheiro e trigo. Deixemos este ganho.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου καὶ οἱ γνωστοί μου καὶ ἐγὼ ἐθήκαμεν ἐν αὐτοῖς ἀργύριον καὶ σῖτον ἐγκαταλίπωμεν δὴ τὴν ἀπαίτησιν ταύτην

text_en: Restore to them this day their fields, and their vineyards, and their oliveyards, and their houses: and the hundredth part of the money, and of the corn, the wine, and the oil, which you were wont to exact of them, give it rather for them.
text_la: Reddite eis hodie agros suos, et vineas suas, et oliveta sua, et domos suas : quin potius et centesimum pecuniæ, frumenti, vini et olei, quam exigere soletis ab eis, date pro illis.
text_pt: Restituí-lhes hoje, vos peço, as suas terras, as suas vinhas, os seus olivais e as suas casas; como também a centésima parte do dinheiro, do trigo, do mosto e do azeite, que vós exigis deles.
text_el: ἐπιστρέψατε δὴ αὐτοῖς ὡς σήμερον ἀγροὺς αὐτῶν ἀμπελῶνας αὐτῶν ἐλαίας αὐτῶν καὶ οἰκίας αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ τοῦ ἀργυρίου τὸν σῖτον καὶ τὸν οἶνον καὶ τὸ ἔλαιον ἐξενέγκατε αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they said: We will restore, and we will require nothing of them: and we will do as you say. And I called the priests and took an oath of them, to do according to what I had said.
text_la: Et dixerunt : Reddemus, et ab eis nihil quæremus : sicque faciemus ut loqueris. Et vocavi sacerdotes, et adjuravi eos ut facerent juxta quod dixeram.
text_pt: Então disseram: Restituir-lhes-emos, e nada procuraremos deles; faremos assim como dizes. Então chamei os sacerdotes, e os fiz jurar que fariam conforme a esta palavra.
text_el: καὶ εἶπαν ἀποδώσομεν καὶ παρ' αὐτῶν οὐ ζητήσομεν οὕτως ποιήσομεν καθὼς σὺ λέγεις καὶ ἐκάλεσα τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ ὥρκισα αὐτοὺς ποιῆσαι ὡς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: Moreover I shook my lap, and said: So may God shake every man that shall not accomplish this word, out of his house, and out of his labours, thus may he be shaken out, and become empty. And all the multitude said: Amen . And they praised God . And the people did according to what was said.
text_la: Insuper excussi sinum meum, et dixi : Sic excutiat Deus omnem virum qui non compleverit verbum istud, de domo sua, et de laboribus suis : sic excutiatur, et vacuus fiat. Et dixit universa multitudo : Amen : et laudaverunt Deum. Fecit ergo populus sicut erat dictum.
text_pt: Também sacudi as minhas vestes, e disse: Assim sacuda Deus todo o homem da sua casa e do seu trabalho que não confirmar esta palavra, e assim seja sacudido e vazio. E toda a congregação disse: Amém! E louvaram ao Senhor; e o povo fez conforme a esta palavra.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἀναβολήν μου ἐξετίναξα καὶ εἶπα οὕτως ἐκτινάξαι ὁ θεὸς πάντα ἄνδρα ὃς οὐ στήσει τὸν λόγον τοῦτον ἐκ τοῦ οἴκου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐκ κόπου αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔσται οὕτως ἐκτετιναγμένος καὶ κενός καὶ εἶπεν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία αμην καὶ ᾔνεσαν τὸν κύριον καὶ ἐποίησεν ὁ λαὸς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο

text_en: And from the day, in which the king commanded me to be governor in the land of Juda , from the twentieth year even to the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes the king, for twelve years, I and my brethren did not eat the yearly allowance that was due to the governors.
text_la: A die autem illa, qua præceperat rex mihi ut essem dux in terra Juda, ab anno vigesimo usque ad annum trigesimum secundum Artaxerxis regis per annos duodecim, ego et fratres mei annonas quæ ducibus debebantur non comedimus.
text_pt: Também desde o dia em que me mandou que eu fosse seu governador na terra de Judá, desde o ano vinte, até ao ano trinta e dois do rei Artaxerxes, doze anos, nem eu nem meus irmãos comemos o pão do governador.
text_el: ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας ἧς ἐνετείλατό μοι εἶναι εἰς ἄρχοντα αὐτῶν ἐν γῇ Ιουδα ἀπὸ ἔτους εἰκοστοῦ καὶ ἕως ἔτους τριακοστοῦ καὶ δευτέρου τῷ Αρθασασθα ἔτη δώδεκα ἐγὼ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοί μου βίαν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔφαγον

text_en: But the former governors that had been before me, were chargeable to the people, and took of them in bread, and wine, and in money every day forty sicles: and their officers also oppressed the people. But I did not so for the fear of God .
text_la: Duces autem primi, qui fuerant ante me, gravaverunt populum, et acceperunt ab eis in pane, et vino, et pecunia, quotidie siclos quadraginta : sed et ministri eorum depresserunt populum. Ego autem non feci ita propter timorem Dei:
text_pt: Mas os primeiros governadores, que foram antes de mim, oprimiram o povo, e tomaram-lhe pão e vinho e, além disso, quarenta siclos de prata, como também os seus servos dominavam sobre o povo; porém eu assim não fiz, por causa do temor de Deus.
text_el: καὶ τὰς βίας τὰς πρώτας ἃς πρὸ ἐμοῦ ἐβάρυναν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐλάβοσαν παρ' αὐτῶν ἐν ἄρτοις καὶ ἐν οἴνῳ ἔσχατον ἀργύριον δίδραχμα τεσσαράκοντα καὶ οἱ ἐκτετιναγμένοι αὐτῶν ἐξουσιάζονται ἐπὶ τὸν λαόν καὶ ἐγὼ οὐκ ἐποίησα οὕτως ἀπὸ προσώπου φόβου θεοῦ

text_en: Moreover I built in the work of the wall, and I bought no land, and all my servants were gathered together to the work.
text_la: quin potius in opere muri ædificavi, et agrum non emi, et omnes pueri mei congregati ad opus erant.
text_pt: Como também na obra deste muro fiz reparação, e terra nenhuma compramos; e todos os meus servos se ajuntaram ali à obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἔργῳ τοῦ τείχους τούτων οὐκ ἐκράτησα ἀγρὸν οὐκ ἐκτησάμην καὶ πάντες οἱ συνηγμένοι ἐκεῖ ἐπὶ τὸ ἔργον

text_en: The Jews also and the magistrates to the number of one hundred and fifty men , were at my table, besides them that came to us from among the nations that were round about us.
text_la: Judæi quoque et magistratus centum quinquaginta viri, et qui veniebant ad nos de gentibus quæ in circuitu nostro sunt, in mensa mea erant.
text_pt: Também dos judeus e dos magistrados, cento e cinqüenta homens, e os que vinham a nós dentre as nações que estão ao redor de nós, se punham à minha mesa.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Ιουδαῖοι ἑκατὸν καὶ πεντήκοντα ἄνδρες καὶ οἱ ἐρχόμενοι πρὸς ἡμᾶς ἀπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν τῶν κύκλῳ ἡμῶν ἐπὶ τράπεζάν μου

text_en: And there was prepared for me day be day one ox, and six choice rams, besides fowls, and once in ten days I gave store of divers wines, and many other things: yet I did not require my yearly allowance as governor: for the people were very much impoverished.
text_la: Parabatur autem mihi per dies singulos bos unus, arietes sex electi, exceptis volatilibus, et inter dies decem vina diversa, et alia multa tribuebam : insuper et annonas ducatus mei non quæsivi : valde enim attenuatus erat populus.
text_pt: E o que se preparava para cada dia era um boi e seis ovelhas escolhidas; também aves se me preparavam e, de dez em dez dias, muito vinho de todas as espécies; e nem por isso exigi o pão do governador, porquanto a servidão deste povo era grande.
text_el: καὶ ἦν γινόμενον εἰς ἡμέραν μίαν μόσχος εἷς καὶ πρόβατα ἓξ ἐκλεκτὰ καὶ χίμαρος ἐγίνοντό μοι καὶ ἀνὰ μέσον δέκα ἡμερῶν ἐν πᾶσιν οἶνος τῷ πλήθει καὶ σὺν τούτοις ἄρτους τῆς βίας οὐκ ἐζήτησα ὅτι βαρεῖα ἡ δουλεία ἐπὶ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον

text_en: Remember me, O my God , for good according to all that I have done for this people.
text_la: Memento mei, Deus meus, in bonum, secundum omnia quæ feci populo huic.
text_pt: Lembra-te de mim para bem, ó meu Deus, e de tudo quanto fiz a este povo.
text_el: μνήσθητί μου ὁ θεός εἰς ἀγαθὸν πάντα ὅσα ἐποίησα τῷ λαῷ τούτῳ

text_en: And it came to pass, when Sanaballat, and Tobias, and Gossem the Arabian, and the rest of our enemies, heard that I had built the wall, and that there was no breach left in it, (though at that time I had not set up the doors in the gates),
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audisset Sanaballat, et Tobias, et Gossem Arabs, et ceteri inimici nostri, quod ædificassem ego murum, et non esset in ipso residua interruptio (usque ad tempus autem illud valvas non posueram in portis),
text_pt: Sucedeu que, ouvindo Sambalate, Tobias, Gesém, o árabe, e o resto dos nossos inimigos, que eu tinha edificado o muro, e que nele já não havia brecha alguma, ainda que até este tempo não tinha posto as portas nos portais,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο καθὼς ἠκούσθη τῷ Σαναβαλλατ καὶ Τωβια καὶ τῷ Γησαμ τῷ Αραβι καὶ τοῖς καταλοίποις τῶν ἐχθρῶν ἡμῶν ὅτι ᾠκοδόμησα τὸ τεῖχος καὶ οὐ κατελείφθη ἐν αὐτοῖς πνοή ἕως τοῦ καιροῦ ἐκείνου θύρας οὐκ ἐπέστησα ἐν ταῖς πύλαις

text_en: Sanaballat and Gossem sent to me, saying: Come, and let us make a league together in the villages , in the plain of Ono. But they thought to do me mischief.
text_la: miserunt Sanaballat et Gossem ad me, dicentes : Veni, et percutiamus fœdus pariter in viculis in campo Ono. Ipsi autem cogitabant ut facerent mihi malum.
text_pt: Sambalate e Gesém mandaram dizer-me: Vem, e congreguemo-nos juntamente nas aldeias, no vale de Ono. Porém intentavam fazer-me mal.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Σαναβαλλατ καὶ Γησαμ πρός με λέγων δεῦρο καὶ συναχθῶμεν ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτὸ ἐν ταῖς κώμαις ἐν πεδίῳ Ωνω καὶ αὐτοὶ λογιζόμενοι ποιῆσαί μοι πονηρίαν

text_en: And I sent messengers to them, saying: I am doing a great work, and I cannot come down, lest it be neglected whilst I come, and go down to you.
text_la: Misi ergo ad eos nuntios, dicens : Opus grande ego facio, et non possum descendere, ne forte negligatur cum venero, et descendero ad vos.
text_pt: E enviei-lhes mensageiros a dizer: Faço uma grande obra, de modo que não poderei descer; por que cessaria esta obra, enquanto eu a deixasse, e fosse ter convosco?
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλα ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἀγγέλους λέγων ἔργον μέγα ἐγὼ ποιῶ καὶ οὐ δυνήσομαι καταβῆναι μήποτε καταπαύσῃ τὸ ἔργον ὡς ἂν τελειώσω αὐτό καταβήσομαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς

text_en: And they sent to me according to this word, four times: and I answered them after the same manner.
text_la: Miserunt autem ad me secundum verbum hoc per quatuor vices: et respondi eis juxta sermonem priorem.
text_pt: E do mesmo modo enviaram a mim quatro vezes; e da mesma forma lhes respondi.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλαν πρός με ὡς τὸ ῥῆμα τοῦτο καὶ ἀπέστειλα αὐτοῖς κατὰ ταῦτα

text_en: And Sanaballat sent his servant to me the fifth time according to the former word, and he had a letter in his hand written in this manner:
text_la: Et misit ad me Sanaballat juxta verbum prius quinta vice puerum suum, et epistolam habebat in manu sua scriptam hoc modo:
text_pt: Então Sambalate ainda pela quinta vez me enviou seu servo com uma carta aberta na sua mão;
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν πρός με Σαναβαλλατ τὸν παῖδα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐπιστολὴν ἀνεῳγμένην ἐν χειρὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: It is reported amongst the Gentiles , and Gossem has said it, that you and the Jews think to rebel, and therefore you build the wall, and have a mind to set yourself king over them: for which end
text_la: In gentibus auditum est, et Gossem dixit, quod tu et Judæi cogitetis rebellare, et propterea ædifices murum, et levare te velis super eos regem : propter quam causam
text_pt: E na qual estava escrito: Entre os gentios se ouviu, e Gasmu diz: Tu e os judeus intentais rebelar-vos, então edificas o muro; e tu te farás rei deles segundo estas palavras;
text_el: καὶ ἦν γεγραμμένον ἐν αὐτῇ ἐν ἔθνεσιν ἠκούσθη ὅτι σὺ καὶ οἱ Ιουδαῖοι λογίζεσθε ἀποστατῆσαι διὰ τοῦτο σὺ οἰκοδομεῖς τὸ τεῖχος καὶ σὺ γίνῃ αὐτοῖς εἰς βασιλέα

text_en: you have also set up prophets , to preach of you at Jerusalem , saying: There is a king in Judea . The king will hear of these things: therefore come now, that we may take counsel together.
text_la: et prophetas posueris, qui prædicent de te in Jerusalem, dicentes : Rex in Judæa est. Auditurus est rex verba hæc : idcirco nunc veni, ut ineamus consilium pariter.
text_pt: E que puseste profetas, para pregarem de ti em Jerusalém, dizendo: Este é rei em Judá; de modo que o rei o ouvirá, segundo estas palavras; vem, pois, agora, e consultemos juntamente.
text_el: καὶ πρὸς τούτοις προφήτας ἔστησας σεαυτῷ ἵνα καθίσῃς ἐν Ιερουσαλημ εἰς βασιλέα ἐν Ιουδα καὶ νῦν ἀπαγγελήσονται τῷ βασιλεῖ οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι καὶ νῦν δεῦρο βουλευσώμεθα ἐπὶ τὸ αὐτό

text_en: And I sent to them, saying: There is no such thing done as you say: but you feign these things out of your own heart.
text_la: Et misi ad eos, dicens : Non est factum secundum verba hæc, quæ tu loqueris : de corde enim tuo tu componis hæc.
text_pt: Porém eu mandei dizer-lhe: De tudo o que dizes coisa nenhuma sucedeu; mas tu, do teu coração, o inventas.
text_el: καὶ ἀπέστειλα πρὸς αὐτὸν λέγων οὐκ ἐγενήθη ὡς οἱ λόγοι οὗτοι οὓς σὺ λέγεις ὅτι ἀπὸ καρδίας σου σὺ ψεύδῃ αὐτούς

text_en: For all these men thought to frighten us, thinking that our hands would cease from the work, and that we would leave off. Wherefore I strengthened my hands the more:
text_la: Omnes enim hi terrebant nos, cogitantes quod cessarent manus nostræ ab opere, et quiesceremus : quam ob causam magis confortavi manus meas.
text_pt: Porque todos eles procuravam atemorizar-nos, dizendo: As suas mãos largarão a obra, e não se efetuará. Agora, pois, ó Deus, fortalece as minhas mãos.
text_el: ὅτι πάντες φοβερίζουσιν ἡμᾶς λέγοντες ἐκλυθήσονται αἱ χεῖρες αὐτῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἔργου τούτου καὶ οὐ ποιηθήσεται καὶ νῦν ἐκραταίωσα τὰς χεῖράς μου

text_en: And I went into the house of Samaia the son of Delaia, the son of Metabeel privately. And he said: Let us consult together in the house of God in the midst of the temple : and let us shut the doors of the temple , for they will come to kill you, and in the night they will come to slay you.
text_la: Et ingressus sum domum Semaiæ filii Dalaiæ filii Metabeel secreto. Qui ait : Tractemus nobiscum in domo Dei in medio templi, et claudamus portas ædis : quia venturi sunt ut interficiant te, et nocte venturi sunt ad occidendum te.
text_pt: E, entrando eu em casa de Semaías, filho de Delaías, o filho de Meetabel (que estava encerrado), disse ele: Vamos juntamente à casa de Deus, ao meio do templo, e fechemos as portas do templo; porque virão matar-te; sim, de noite virão matar-te.
text_el: καὶ ἐγὼ εἰσῆλθον εἰς οἶκον Σεμεϊ υἱοῦ Δαλαια υἱοῦ Μεηταβηλ καὶ αὐτὸς συνεχόμενος καὶ εἶπεν συναχθῶμεν εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἐν μέσῳ αὐτοῦ καὶ κλείσωμεν τὰς θύρας αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἔρχονται νυκτὸς φονεῦσαί σε

text_en: And I said: Should such a man as I flee? And who is there that being as I am, would go into the temple , to save his life? I will not go in.
text_la: Et dixi : Num quisquam similis mei fugit? et quis ut ego ingredietur templum, et vivet? non ingrediar.
text_pt: Porém eu disse: Um homem como eu fugiria? E quem há, como eu, que entre no templo para que viva? De maneira nenhuma entrarei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τίς ἐστιν ὁ ἀνήρ ὃς εἰσελεύσεται εἰς τὸν οἶκον καὶ ζήσεται

text_en: And I understood that God had not sent him, but that he had spoken to me as if he had been prophesying , and Tobias, and Sanaballat had hired him.
text_la: Et intellexi quod Deus non misisset eum, sed quasi vaticinans locutus esset ad me, et Tobias et Sanaballat conduxissent eum.
text_pt: E percebi que não era Deus quem o enviara; mas esta profecia falou contra mim, porquanto Tobias e Sambalate o subornaram.
text_el: καὶ ἐπέγνων καὶ ἰδοὺ ὁ θεὸς οὐκ ἀπέστειλεν αὐτόν ὅτι ἡ προφητεία λόγος κατ' ἐμοῦ καὶ Τωβιας καὶ Σαναβαλλατ ἐμισθώσαντο

text_en: For he had taken money, that I being afraid should do this thing, and sin , and they might have some evil to upbraid me withal.
text_la: Acceperat enim pretium, ut territus facerem, et peccarem, et haberent malum quod exprobrarent mihi.
text_pt: Para isto o subornaram, para me atemorizar, e para que assim fizesse, e pecasse, para que tivessem alguma causa para me infamarem, e assim me vituperarem.
text_el: ἐπ' ἐμὲ ὄχλον ὅπως φοβηθῶ καὶ ποιήσω οὕτως καὶ ἁμάρτω καὶ γένωμαι αὐτοῖς εἰς ὄνομα πονηρόν ὅπως ὀνειδίσωσίν με

text_en: Remember me, O Lord , for Tobias and Sanaballat, according to their works of this kind: and Noadias the prophet , and the rest of the prophets that would have put me in fear.
text_la: Memento mei, Domine, pro Tobia et Sanaballat, juxta opera eorum talia : sed et Noadiæ prophetæ, et ceterorum prophetarum, qui terrebant me.
text_pt: Lembra-te, meu Deus, de Tobias e de Sambalate, conforme a estas suas obras, e também da profetisa Noadia, e dos mais profetas que procuraram atemorizar-me.
text_el: μνήσθητι ὁ θεός τῷ Τωβια καὶ τῷ Σαναβαλλατ ὡς τὰ ποιήματα αὐτοῦ ταῦτα καὶ τῷ Νωαδια τῷ προφήτῃ καὶ τοῖς καταλοίποις τῶν προφητῶν οἳ ἦσαν φοβερίζοντές με

text_en: But the wall was finished the five and twentieth day of the month of Elul, in two and fifty days.
text_la: Completus est autem murus vigesimo quinto die mensis Elul, quinquaginta duobus diebus.
text_pt: Acabou-se, pois, o muro aos vinte e cinco do mês de Elul; em cinqüenta e dois dias.
text_el: καὶ ἐτελέσθη τὸ τεῖχος πέμπτῃ καὶ εἰκάδι τοῦ Ελουλ εἰς πεντήκοντα καὶ δύο ἡμέρας

text_en: And it came to pass when all our enemies heard of it, that all nations which were round about us, were afraid, and were cast down within themselves, for they perceived that this work was the work of God .
text_la: Factum est ergo cum audissent omnes inimici nostri, ut timerent universæ gentes quæ erant in circuitu nostro, et conciderent intra semetipsos, et scirent quod a Deo factum esset opus hoc.
text_pt: E sucedeu que, ouvindo-o todos os nossos inimigos, todos os povos que havia em redor de nós temeram, e abateram-se muito a seus próprios olhos; porque reconheceram que o nosso Deus fizera esta obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἤκουσαν πάντες οἱ ἐχθροὶ ἡμῶν καὶ ἐφοβήθησαν πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τὰ κύκλῳ ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπέπεσεν φόβος σφόδρα ἐν ὀφθαλμοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἔγνωσαν ὅτι παρὰ τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐγενήθη τελειωθῆναι τὸ ἔργον τοῦτο

text_en: Moreover in those days many letters were sent by the principal men of the Jews to Tobias, and from Tobias there came letters to them.
text_la: Sed et in diebus illis multæ optimatum Judæorum epistolæ mittebantur ad Tobiam, et a Tobia veniebant ad eos.
text_pt: Também naqueles dias alguns nobres de Judá escreveram muitas cartas que iam para Tobias; e as cartas de Tobias vinham para eles.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις ἀπὸ πολλῶν ἐντίμων Ιουδα ἐπιστολαὶ ἐπορεύοντο πρὸς Τωβιαν καὶ αἱ Τωβια ἤρχοντο πρὸς αὐτούς

text_en: For there were many in Judea sworn to him, because he was the son in law of Sechenias the son of Area, and Johanan his son had taken to wife the daughter of Mosollam the son of Barachias.
text_la: Multi enim erant in Judæa habentes juramentum ejus, quia gener erat Secheniæ filii Area, et Johanan filius ejus acceperat filiam Mosollam filii Barachiæ:
text_pt: Porque muitos em Judá lhe eram ajuramentados, porque era genro de Secanias filho de Ará; e seu filho Joanã se casara com a filha de Mesulão, filho de Berequias.
text_el: ὅτι πολλοὶ ἐν Ιουδα ἔνορκοι ἦσαν αὐτῷ ὅτι γαμβρὸς ἦν τοῦ Σεχενια υἱοῦ Ηραε καὶ Ιωαναν υἱὸς αὐτοῦ ἔλαβεν τὴν θυγατέρα Μεσουλαμ υἱοῦ Βαραχια εἰς γυναῖκα

text_en: And they praised him also before me, and they related my words to him: And Tobias sent letters to put me in fear.
text_la: sed et laudabant eum coram me, et verba mea nuntiabant ei : et Tobias mittebat epistolas ut terreret me.
text_pt: Também as suas boas ações contavam perante mim, e as minhas palavras transmitiam a ele; portanto Tobias escrevia cartas para me atemorizar.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς λόγους αὐτοῦ ἦσαν λέγοντες πρός με καὶ λόγους μου ἦσαν ἐκφέροντες αὐτῷ καὶ ἐπιστολὰς ἀπέστειλεν Τωβιας φοβερίσαι με

text_en: Now after the wall was built, and I had set up the doors, and numbered the porters and singing men , and Levites :
text_la: Postquam autem ædificatus est murus, et posui valvas, et recensui janitores, et cantores, et Levitas,
text_pt: Sucedeu que, depois que o muro foi edificado, eu levantei as portas; e foram estabelecidos os porteiros, os cantores e os levitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ᾠκοδομήθη τὸ τεῖχος καὶ ἔστησα τὰς θύρας καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ οἱ Λευῖται
