text_en: I commanded Hanani my brother, and Hananias ruler of the house of Jerusalem , (for he seemed as a sincere man , and one that feared God above the rest),
text_la: præcepi Hanani fratri meo, et Hananiæ principi domus de Jerusalem (ipse enim quasi vir verax et timens Deum plus ceteris videbatur),
text_pt: Eu nomeei a Hanani, meu irmão, e a Hananias, líder da fortaleza, sobre Jerusalém; porque ele era homem fiel e temente a Deus, mais do que muitos.
text_el: καὶ ἐνετειλάμην τῷ Ανανια ἀδελφῷ μου καὶ τῷ Ανανια ἄρχοντι τῆς βιρα ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι αὐτὸς ὡς ἀνὴρ ἀληθὴς καὶ φοβούμενος τὸν θεὸν παρὰ πολλούς

text_en: and I said to them: Let not the gates of Jerusalem be opened till the sun be hot. And while they were yet standing by the gates were shut, and barred: and I set watchmen of the inhabitants of Jerusalem , every one by their courses, and every man over against his house.
text_la: et dixi eis : Non aperiantur portæ Jerusalem usque ad calorem solis. Cumque adhuc assisterent, clausæ portæ sunt, et oppilatæ : et posui custodes de habitatoribus Jerusalem, singulos per vices suas, et unumquemque contra domum suam.
text_pt: E disse-lhes: Não se abram as portas de Jerusalém até que o sol aqueça, e enquanto os que assisti-rem ali permanecerem, fechem as portas, e vós trancai-as; e ponhamse guardas dos moradores de Jerusalém, cada um na sua guarda, e cada um diante da sua casa.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς οὐκ ἀνοιγήσονται πύλαι Ιερουσαλημ ἕως ἅμα τῷ ἡλίῳ καὶ ἔτι αὐτῶν γρηγορούντων κλειέσθωσαν αἱ θύραι καὶ σφηνούσθωσαν καὶ στῆσον προφύλακας οἰκούντων ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἀνὴρ ἐν προφυλακῇ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀνὴρ ἀπέναντι οἰκίας αὐτοῦ

text_en: And the city was very wide and great, and the people few in the midst thereof, and the houses were not built.
text_la: Civitas autem erat lata nimis et grandis, et populus parvus in medio ejus, et non erant domus ædificatæ.
text_pt: E era a cidade larga de espaço, e grande, porém pouco povo havia dentro dela; e ainda as casas não estavam edificadas.
text_el: καὶ ἡ πόλις πλατεῖα καὶ μεγάλη καὶ ὁ λαὸς ὀλίγος ἐν αὐτῇ καὶ οὐκ ἦσαν οἰκίαι ᾠκοδομημέναι

text_en: But God had put in my heart, and I assembled the princes and magistrates, and common people, to number them: and I found a book of the number of them who came up at first and therein it was found written:
text_la: Deus autem dedit in corde meo, et congregavi optimates, et magistratus, et vulgus, ut recenserem eos : et inveni librum census eorum qui ascenderant primum, et inventum est scriptum in eo.
text_pt: Então o meu Deus me pôs no coração que ajuntasse os nobres, os magistrados e o povo, para registrar as genealogias; e achei o livro da genealogia dos que subiram primeiro e nele estava escrito o seguinte:
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκεν ὁ θεὸς εἰς τὴν καρδίαν μου καὶ συνῆξα τοὺς ἐντίμους καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας καὶ τὸν λαὸν εἰς συνοδίας καὶ εὗρον βιβλίον τῆς συνοδίας οἳ ἀνέβησαν ἐν πρώτοις καὶ εὗρον γεγραμμένον ἐν αὐτῷ

text_en: These are the children of the province, who came up from the captivity of them that had been carried away, whom Nabuchodonosor the king of Babylon had carried away, and who returned into Judea , every one into his own city.
text_la: Isti filii provinciæ, qui ascenderunt de captivitate migrantium, quos transtulerat Nabuchodonosor rex Babylonis, et reversi sunt in Jerusalem et in Judæam, unusquisque in civitatem suam.
text_pt: Estes são os filhos da província, que subiram do cativeiro dos exilados, que transportara Nabucodonosor, rei de Babilônia; e voltaram para Jerusalém e para Judá, cada um para a sua cidade;
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ τῆς χώρας οἱ ἀναβάντες ἀπὸ αἰχμαλωσίας τῆς ἀποικίας ἧς ἀπῴκισεν Ναβουχοδονοσορ βασιλεὺς Βαβυλῶνος καὶ ἐπέστρεψαν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ εἰς Ιουδα ἀνὴρ εἰς τὴν πόλιν αὐτοῦ

text_en: Who came with Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardochai, Belsam, Mespharath, Begoia, Nahum, Baana. The number of the men of the people of Israel :
text_la: Qui venerunt cum Zorobabel, Josue, Nehemias, Azarias, Raamias, Nahamani, Mardochæus, Belsam, Mespharath, Begoai, Nahum, Baana. Numerus virorum populi Israël:
text_pt: Os quais vieram com Zorobabel, Jesuá, Neemias, Azarias, Raamias, Naamani, Mordecai, Bilsã, Misperete, Bigvai, Neum, e Baaná; este é o número dos homens do povo de Israel.
text_el: μετὰ Ζοροβαβελ καὶ Ἰησοῦ καὶ Νεεμια Αζαρια Δαεμια Ναεμανι Μαρδοχαιος Βαλσαν Μασφαραθ Εσδρα Βαγοι Ναουμ Βαανα Μασφαρ ἄνδρες λαοῦ Ισραηλ

text_en: The children of Pharos, two thousand one hundred seventy-two.
text_la: filii Pharos, duo millia centum septuaginta duo:
text_pt: Foram os filhos de Parós, dois mil, cento e setenta e dois.
text_el: υἱοὶ Φορος δισχίλιοι ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα δύο

text_en: The children of Sephatia, three hundred seventy-two.
text_la: filii Saphatia, trecenti septuaginta duo:
text_pt: Os filhos de Sefatias, trezentos e setenta e dois.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαφατια τριακόσιοι ἑβδομήκοντα δύο

text_en: The children of Area, six hundred fifty-two.
text_la: filii Area, sexcenti quinquaginta duo:

text_el: υἱοὶ Ηρα ἑξακόσιοι πεντήκοντα δύο

text_el: υἱοὶ Βανουι ἑξακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα ὀκτώ

text_el: υἱοὶ Ηδιν ἑξακόσιοι πεντήκοντα πέντε

text_pt: Os filhos de Bezai, trezentos e vinte e quatro.
text_el: υἱοὶ Βεσι τριακόσιοι εἴκοσι τέσσαρες

text_en: The children of Hareph, a hundred and twelve.
text_la: filii Hareph, centum duodecim:
text_pt: Os filhos de Harife, cento e doze.
text_el: υἱοὶ Αριφ ἑκατὸν δώδεκα

text_la: filii Gabaon, nonaginta quinque:

text_el: υἱοὶ Γαβαων ἐνενήκοντα πέντε

text_el: υἱοὶ Βαιθλεεμ ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι τρεῖς υἱοὶ Νετωφα πεντήκοντα ἕξ

text_el: ἄνδρες Αραμα καὶ Γαβαα ἑξακόσιοι εἴκοσι εἷς

text_pt: Os filhos de Harim, trezentos e vinte.

text_la: Filii Lod Hadid et Ono, septingenti viginti unus.

text_el: υἱοὶ Λοδ Αδιδ καὶ Ωνω ἑπτακόσιοι εἴκοσι εἷς

text_en: The children of Senaa, three thousand nine hundred thirty.
text_la: Filii Senaa, tria millia nongenti triginta.
text_pt: Os filhos de Senaá, três mil, novecentos e trinta.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαναα τρισχίλιοι ἐννακόσιοι τριάκοντα

text_pt: Os sacerdotes: Os filhos de Jedaías, da casa de Jesuá, novecentos e setenta e três.

text_la: Filii Emmer, mille quinquaginta duo.
text_pt: Os filhos de Imer, mil e cinqüenta e dois.

text_la: Filii Phashur, mille ducenti quadraginta septem.

text_el: υἱοὶ Φασσουρ χίλιοι διακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα ἑπτά

text_la: Filii Arem, mille decem et septem. Levitæ:
text_pt: Os filhos de Harim, mil e dezessete.
text_el: υἱοὶ Ηραμ χίλιοι δέκα ἑπτά

text_la: filii Josue et Cedmihel filiorum
text_pt: Os levitas: Os filhos de Jesuá, de Cadmiel, dos filhos de Hodeva, setenta e quatro.

text_la: Oduiæ, septuaginta quatuor. Cantores:
text_pt: Os cantores: Os filhos de Asafe, cento e quarenta e oito.

text_pt: Os filhos de Besai, os filhos de Meunim, os filhos de Nefussim,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βησι υἱοὶ Μεϊνωμ υἱοὶ Νεφωσασιμ

text_en: the children of Bacbuc, the children of Hacupha, the children of Harhur,
text_la: filii Bacbuc, filii Hacupha, filii Harhur,
text_pt: Os filhos de Bacbuque, os filhos de Hacufa, os filhos de Harur,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βακβουκ υἱοὶ Αχιφα υἱοὶ Αρουρ

text_en: the children of Besloth, the children of Mahida, the children of Harsa,
text_la: filii Besloth, filii Mahida, filii Harsa,
text_pt: Os filhos de Bazlite, os filhos de Meída, os filhos de Harsa,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βασαλωθ υἱοὶ Μεϊδα υἱοὶ Αδασαν

text_en: the children of Bercos, the children of Sisara, the children of Thema,
text_la: filii Bercos, filii Sisara, filii Thema,
text_pt: Os filhos de Barcos, os filhos de Sísera, os filhos de Tamá,
text_el: υἱοὶ Βαρκους υἱοὶ Σισαρα υἱοὶ Θημα

text_en: the children of Nasia, the children of Hatipha,
text_la: filii Nasia, filii Hatipha,
text_pt: Os filhos de Neziá, os filhos de Hatifa.
text_el: υἱοὶ Νισια υἱοὶ Ατιφα

text_en: the children of the servants of Solomon , the children of Sothai, the children of Sophereth, the children of Pharida,
text_la: filii servorum Salomonis, filii Sothai, filii Sophereth, filii Pharida,
text_pt: Os filhos dos servos de Salomão, os filhos de Sotai, os filhos de Soferete, os filhos de Perida,
text_el: υἱοὶ δούλων Σαλωμων υἱοὶ Σουτι υἱοὶ Σαφαραθ υἱοὶ Φεριδα

text_en: the children of Jahala, the children of Darcon, the children of Jeddel,
text_la: filii Jahala, filii Darcon, filii Jeddel,
text_pt: Os filhos de Jaala, os filhos de Darcom, os filhos de Gidel,
text_el: υἱοὶ Ιεαλη υἱοὶ Δορκων υἱοὶ Γαδηλ

text_en: the children of Saphatia, the children of Hatil, the children of Phochereth, who was born of Sabaim, the son of Amon.
text_la: filii Saphatia, filii Hatil, filii Phochereth, qui erat ortus ex Sabaim filio Amon.
text_pt: Os filhos de Sefatias, os filhos de Hatil, os filhos de Poquerete-Hazebaim, os filhos de Amom.
text_el: υἱοὶ Σαφατια υἱοὶ Ετηλ υἱοὶ Φαχαραθ υἱοὶ Σαβαϊμ υἱοὶ Ημιμ

text_en: All the Nathinites , and the children of the servants of Solomon , three hundred ninety-two.
text_la: Omnes Nathinæi, et filii servorum Salomonis, trecenti nonaginta duo.
text_pt: Todos os servidores do templo e os filhos dos servos de Salomão, trezentos e noventa e dois.
text_el: πάντες οἱ ναθινιμ καὶ υἱοὶ δούλων Σαλωμων τριακόσιοι ἐνενήκοντα δύο

text_en: And these are they that came up from Telmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, Addon, and Emmer: and could not show the house of their fathers, nor their seed, whether they were of Israel .
text_la: Hi sunt autem qui ascenderunt de Thelmela, Thelharsa, Cherub, Addon, et Emmer : et non potuerunt indicare domum patrum suorum, et semen suum, utrum ex Israël essent,
text_pt: Também estes subiram de Tel-Melá, e Tel-Harsa, Querube, Adom, Imer; porém não puderam provar que a casa de seus pais e a sua linhagem, eram de Israel.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι ἀνέβησαν ἀπὸ Θελμελεθ Αρησα Χαρουβ Ηρων Ιεμηρ καὶ οὐκ ἠδυνάσθησαν ἀπαγγεῖλαι οἴκους πατριῶν αὐτῶν καὶ σπέρμα αὐτῶν εἰ ἀπὸ Ισραηλ εἰσίν

text_en: The children of Dalaia, the children of Tobia, the children of Necoda, six hundred forty-two.
text_la: filii Dalaia, filii Tobia, filii Necoda, sexcenti quadraginta duo.
text_pt: Os filhos de Delaías, os filhos de Tobias, os filhos de Necoda, seiscentos e quarenta e dois.
text_el: υἱοὶ Δαλαια υἱοὶ Τωβια υἱοὶ Νεκωδα ἑξακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα δύο

text_en: And of the priests , the children of Habia, the children of Accos, the children of Berzellai, who took a wife of the daughters of Berzellai the Galaadite, and he was called by their name .
text_la: Et de sacerdotibus, filii Habia, filii Accos, filii Berzellai, qui accepit de filiabus Berzellai Galaaditis uxorem, et vocatus est nomine eorum.
text_pt: E dos sacerdotes: os filhos de Habaías, os filhos de Coz, os filhos de Barzilai, que tomara uma mulher das filhas de Barzilai, o gileadita, e que foi chamado do seu nome.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων υἱοὶ Εβια υἱοὶ Ακως υἱοὶ Βερζελλι ὅτι ἔλαβεν ἀπὸ θυγατέρων Βερζελλι τοῦ Γαλααδίτου γυναῖκας καὶ ἐκλήθη ἐπ' ὀνόματι αὐτῶν

text_en: These sought their writing in the record, and found it not: and they were cast out of the priesthood .
text_la: Hi quæsierunt scripturam suam in censu, et non invenerunt : et ejecti sunt de sacerdotio.
text_pt: Estes buscaram o seu registro nos livros genealógicos, porém não se achou; então, como imundos, foram excluídos do sacerdócio.
text_el: οὗτοι ἐζήτησαν γραφὴν αὐτῶν τῆς συνοδίας καὶ οὐχ εὑρέθη καὶ ἠγχιστεύθησαν ἀπὸ τῆς ἱερατείας

text_en: And Athersatha said to them, that they should not eat of the holies of holies, until there stood up a priest learned and skilful.
text_la: Dixitque Athersatha eis ut non manducarent de Sanctis sanctorum, donec staret sacerdos doctus et eruditus.
text_pt: E o governador lhes disse que não comessem das coisas sagradas, até que se apresentasse o sacerdote com Urim e Tumim.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Αθερσαθα ἵνα μὴ φάγωσιν ἀπὸ τοῦ ἁγίου τῶν ἁγίων ἕως ἀναστῇ ὁ ἱερεὺς φωτίσων

text_en: All the multitude as it were one man , forty-two thousand three hundred sixty,
text_la: Omnis multitudo quasi vir unus quadraginta duo millia trecenti sexaginta,
text_pt: Toda esta congregação junta foi de quarenta e dois mil, trezentos e sessenta,
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία ὡς εἷς τέσσαρες μυριάδες δισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα

text_en: beside their menservants and womenservants, who were seven thousand three hundred thirty-seven: and among them singing men , and singing women , two hundred forty-five.
text_la: absque servis et ancillis eorum, qui erant septem millia trecenti triginta septem, et inter eos cantores et cantatrices, ducenti quadraginta quinque.
text_pt: Afora os seus servos e as suas servas, que foram sete mil, trezentos e trinta e sete; e tinham duzentos e quarenta e cinco cantores e cantoras.
text_el: πάρεξ δούλων αὐτῶν καὶ παιδισκῶν αὐτῶν οὗτοι ἑπτακισχίλιοι τριακόσιοι τριάκοντα ἑπτά καὶ ᾄδοντες καὶ ᾄδουσαι διακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα πέντε

text_en: Their horses, seven hundred thirty-six: their mules two hundred forty-five.
text_la: Equi eorum, septingenti triginta sex : muli eorum, ducenti quadraginta quinque:
text_pt: Os seus cavalos, setecentos e trinta e seis; os seus mulos, duzentos e quarenta e cinco.
text_el: ἵπποι ἑπτακόσιοι τριάκοντα ἕξ ἡμίονοι διακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα πέντε

text_en: Their camels, four hundred thirty-five, their asses, six thousand seven hundred and twenty.
text_la: cameli eorum, quadringenti triginta quinque : asini, sex millia septingenti viginti.
text_pt: Camelos, quatrocentos e trinta e cinco; jumentos, seis mil, setecentos e vinte.
text_el: κάμηλοι τετρακόσιοι τριάκοντα πέντε ὄνοι ἑξακισχίλιοι ἑπτακόσιοι εἴκοσι

text_en: And some of the heads of the families gave unto the work. Athersatha gave into the treasure a thousand drams of gold, fifty bowls, and five hundred and thirty garments for priests .
text_la: Nonnulli autem de principibus familiarum dederunt in opus. Athersatha dedit in thesaurum auri drachmas mille, phialas quinquaginta, tunicas sacerdotales quingentas triginta.
text_pt: E uma parte dos chefes dos pais contribuíram para a obra. O governador deu para o tesouro, em ouro, mil dracmas, cinqüenta bacias, e quinhentas e trinta vestes sacerdotais.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ μέρους ἀρχηγῶν τῶν πατριῶν ἔδωκαν εἰς τὸ ἔργον τῷ Νεεμια εἰς θησαυρὸν χρυσοῦς χιλίους φιάλας πεντήκοντα καὶ χοθωνωθ τῶν ἱερέων τριάκοντα

text_en: And some of the heads of families gave to the treasure of the work, twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand two hundred pounds of silver.
text_la: Et de principibus familiarum dederunt in thesaurum operis, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia ducentas.
text_pt: E alguns mais dos chefes dos pais contribuíram para o tesouro da obra, em ouro, vinte mil dracmas, e em prata, duas mil e duzentas libras.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ ἀρχηγῶν τῶν πατριῶν ἔδωκαν εἰς θησαυρὸν τοῦ ἔργου χρυσίου δύο μυριάδας καὶ ἀργυρίου μνᾶς δισχιλίας διακοσίας

text_en: And that which the rest of the people gave, was twenty thousand drams of gold, and two thousand pounds of silver, and sixty-seven garments for priests .
text_la: Et quod dedit reliquus populus, auri drachmas viginti millia, et argenti mnas duo millia, et tunicas sacerdotales sexaginta septem.
text_pt: E o que deu o restante do povo foi, em ouro, vinte mil dracmas, e em prata, duas mil libras; e sessenta e sete vestes sacerdotais.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκαν οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ χρυσίου δύο μυριάδας καὶ ἀργυρίου μνᾶς δισχιλίας διακοσίας καὶ χοθωνωθ τῶν ἱερέων ἑξήκοντα ἑπτά

text_en: And the priests , and the Levites , and the porters, and the singing men , and the rest of the common people, and the Nathinites , and all Israel dwelt in their cities.
text_la: Habitaverunt autem sacerdotes, et Levitæ, et janitores, et cantores, et reliquum vulgus, et Nathinæi, et omnis Israël, in civitatibus suis.
text_pt: E habitaram os sacerdotes, os levitas, os porteiros, os cantores, alguns do povo, os servidores do templo, e todo o Israel nas suas cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ οἱ ἀπὸ τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ οἱ ναθινιμ καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἔφθασεν ὁ μὴν ὁ ἕβδομος καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the seventh month came: and the children of Israel were in their cities. And all the people were gathered together as one man to the street which is before the water gate, and they spoke to Esdras the scribe , to bring the book of the law of Moses , which the Lord had commanded to Israel .
text_la: Et venerat mensis septimus : filii autem Israël erant in civitatibus suis. Congregatusque est omnis populus quasi vir unus ad plateam quæ est ante portam aquarum : et dixerunt Esdræ scribæ ut afferret librum legis Moysi, quam præceperat Dominus Israëli.
text_pt: E chegado o sétimo mês, e estando os filhos de Israel nas suas cidades, todo o povo se ajuntou como um só homem, na praça, diante da porta das águas; e disseram a Esdras, o escriba, que trouxesse o livro da lei de Moisés, que o SENHOR tinha ordenado a Israel.
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς ὡς ἀνὴρ εἷς εἰς τὸ πλάτος τὸ ἔμπροσθεν πύλης τοῦ ὕδατος καὶ εἶπαν τῷ Εσδρα τῷ γραμματεῖ ἐνέγκαι τὸ βιβλίον νόμου Μωυσῆ ὃν ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Ισραηλ

text_en: Then Esdras the priest brought the law before the multitude of men and women , and all those that could understand, in the first day of the seventh month.
text_la: Attulit ergo Esdras sacerdos legem coram multitudine virorum et mulierum, cunctisque qui poterant intelligere, in die prima mensis septimi.
text_pt: E Esdras, o sacerdote, trouxe a lei perante a congregação, tanto de homens como de mulheres, e todos os que podiam ouvir com entendimento, no primeiro dia do sétimo mês.
text_el: καὶ ἤνεγκεν Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς τὸν νόμον ἐνώπιον τῆς ἐκκλησίας ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς καὶ ἕως γυναικὸς καὶ πᾶς ὁ συνίων ἀκούειν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ μιᾷ τοῦ μηνὸς τοῦ ἑβδόμου

text_en: And he read it plainly in the street that was before the water gate, from the morning until midday, before the men , and the women , and all those that could understand: and the ears of all the people were attentive to the book.
text_la: Et legit in eo aperte in platea quæ erat ante portam aquarum, de mane usque ad mediam diem, in conspectu virorum et mulierum, et sapientium : et aures omnis populi erant erectæ ad librum.
text_pt: E leu no livro diante da praça, que está diante da porta das águas, desde a alva até ao meio-dia, perante homens e mulheres, e os que podiam entender; e os ouvidos de todo o povo estavam atentos ao livro da lei.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνω ἐν αὐτῷ ἀπὸ τῆς ὥρας τοῦ διαφωτίσαι τὸν ἥλιον ἕως ἡμίσους τῆς ἡμέρας ἀπέναντι τῶν ἀνδρῶν καὶ τῶν γυναικῶν καὶ αὐτοὶ συνιέντες καὶ ὦτα παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ εἰς τὸ βιβλίον τοῦ νόμου

text_en: And Esdras the scribe stood upon a step of wood, which he had made to speak upon, and there stood by him Mathathias , and Semeia, and Ania, and Uria, and Helcia, and Maasia, on his right hand: and on the left, Phadaia, Misael, and Melchia, and Hasum, and Hasbadana, Zacharia and Mosollam.
text_la: Stetit autem Esdras scriba super gradum ligneum, quem fecerat ad loquendum : et steterunt juxta eum Mathathias, et Semeia, et Ania, et Uria, et Helcia, et Maasia, ad dexteram ejus : et ad sinistram, Phadaia, Misaël, et Melchia, et Hasum, et Hasbadana, Zacharia, et Mosollam.
text_pt: E Esdras, o escriba, estava sobre um púlpito de madeira, que fizeram para aquele fim; e estava em pé junto a ele, à sua mão direita, Matitias, Sema, Anaías, Urias, Hilquias e Maaséias; e à sua mão esquerda, Pedaías, Misael, Melquias, Hasum, Hasbadana, Zacarias e Mesulão.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη Εσδρας ὁ γραμματεὺς ἐπὶ βήματος ξυλίνου καὶ ἔστησαν ἐχόμενα αὐτοῦ Ματταθιας καὶ Σαμαιας καὶ Ανανιας καὶ Ουρια καὶ Ελκια καὶ Μαασαια ἐκ δεξιῶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐξ ἀριστερῶν Φαδαιας καὶ Μισαηλ καὶ Μελχιας καὶ Ωσαμ καὶ Ασαβδανα καὶ Ζαχαριας καὶ Μοσολλαμ

text_en: And Esdras opened the book before all the people: for he was above all the people: and when he had opened it, all the people stood.
text_la: Et aperuit Esdras librum coram omni populo : super universum quippe populum eminebat : et cum aperuisset eum, stetit omnis populus.
text_pt: E Esdras abriu o livro perante à vista de todo o povo; porque estava acima de todo o povo; e, abrindo-o ele, todo o povo se pôs em pé.
text_el: καὶ ἤνοιξεν Εσδρας τὸ βιβλίον ἐνώπιον παντὸς τοῦ λαοῦ ὅτι αὐτὸς ἦν ἐπάνω τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα ἤνοιξεν αὐτό ἔστη πᾶς ὁ λαός

text_en: And Esdras blessed the Lord the great God : and all the people answered, Amen , amen : lifting up their hands: and they bowed down, and adored God with their faces to the ground.
text_la: Et benedixit Esdras Domino Deo magno : et respondit omnis populus : Amen, amen, elevans manus suas : et incurvati sunt, et adoraverunt Deum proni in terram.
text_pt: E Esdras louvou ao Senhor, o grande Deus; e todo o povo respondeu: Amém, Amém! levantando as suas mãos; e inclinaram suas cabeças, e adoraram ao Senhor, com os rostos em terra.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλόγησεν Εσδρας κύριον τὸν θεὸν τὸν μέγαν καὶ ἀπεκρίθη πᾶς ὁ λαὸς καὶ εἶπαν αμην ἐπάραντες χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ ἔκυψαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν τῷ κυρίῳ ἐπὶ πρόσωπον ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν

text_en: Now Josue, and Bani, and Serebia, Jamin, Accub, Sephtai, Odia, Maasia, Celtia, Azarias, Jozabed, Hanan, Phalaia, the Levites , made silence among the people to hear the law: and the people stood in their place.
text_la: Porro Josue, et Bani, et Serebia, Jamin, Accub, Septhai, Odia, Maasia, Celita, Azarias, Jozabed, Hanan, Phalaia, Levitæ, silentium faciebant in populo ad audiendam legem : populus autem stabat in gradu suo.
text_pt: E Jesuá, Bani, Serebias, Jamim, Acube, Sabetai, Hodias, Maaséias, Quelita, Azarias, Jozabade, Hanã, Pelaías, e os levitas ensinavam o povo na lei; e o povo estava no seu lugar.
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς καὶ Βαναιας καὶ Σαραβια ἦσαν συνετίζοντες τὸν λαὸν εἰς τὸν νόμον καὶ ὁ λαὸς ἐν τῇ στάσει αὐτοῦ

text_en: And they read in the book of the law of God distinctly and plainly to be understood: and they understood when it was read.
text_la: Et legerunt in libro legis Dei distincte, et aperte ad intelligendum : et intellexerunt cum legeretur.
text_pt: E leram no livro, na lei de Deus; e declarando, e explicando o sentido, faziam que, lendo, se entendesse.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνωσαν ἐν βιβλίῳ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐδίδασκεν Εσδρας καὶ διέστελλεν ἐν ἐπιστήμῃ κυρίου καὶ συνῆκεν ὁ λαὸς ἐν τῇ ἀναγνώσει

text_en: And Nehemias (he is Athersatha) and Esdras the priest and scribe , and the Levites who interpreted to all the people, said: This is a holy day to the Lord our God : do not mourn, nor weep: for all the people wept, when they heard the words of the law.
text_la: Dixit autem Nehemias (ipse est Athersatha) et Esdras sacerdos et scriba, et Levitæ interpretantes universo populo : Dies sanctificatus est Domino Deo nostro : nolite lugere, et nolite flere. Flebat enim omnis populus cum audiret verba legis.
text_pt: E Neemias, que era o governador, e o sacerdote Esdras, o escriba, e os levitas que ensinavam ao povo, disseram a todo o povo: Este dia é consagrado ao Senhor vosso Deus, então não vos lamenteis, nem choreis. Porque todo o povo chorava, ouvindo as palavras da lei.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Νεεμιας καὶ Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς καὶ γραμματεὺς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται οἱ συνετίζοντες τὸν λαὸν καὶ εἶπαν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ ἡ ἡμέρα ἁγία ἐστὶν τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ ἡμῶν μὴ πενθεῖτε μηδὲ κλαίετε ὅτι ἔκλαιεν πᾶς ὁ λαός ὡς ἤκουσαν τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου

text_en: And he said to them: Go, eat fat meats, and drink sweet wine, and send portions to them that have not prepared for themselves: because it is the holy day of the Lord , and be not sad: for the joy of the Lord is our strength.
text_la: Et dixit eis : Ite, comedite pinguia, et bibite mulsum, et mittite partes his qui non præparaverunt sibi, quia sanctus dies Domini est : et nolite contristari : gaudium etenim Domini est fortitudo nostra.
text_pt: Disse-lhes mais: Ide, comei as gorduras, e bebei as doçuras, e enviai porções aos que não têm nada preparado para si; porque este dia é consagrado ao nosso Senhor; portanto não vos entristeçais; porque a alegria do Senhor é a vossa força.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς πορεύεσθε φάγετε λιπάσματα καὶ πίετε γλυκάσματα καὶ ἀποστείλατε μερίδας τοῖς μὴ ἔχουσιν ὅτι ἁγία ἐστὶν ἡ ἡμέρα τῷ κυρίῳ ἡμῶν καὶ μὴ διαπέσητε ὅτι ἐστὶν ἰσχὺς ὑμῶν

text_en: And the Levites stilled all the people, saying: Hold your peace, for the day is holy , and be not sorrowful.
text_la: Levitæ autem silentium faciebant in omni populo, dicentes : Tacete, quia dies sanctus est, et nolite dolere.
text_pt: E os levitas fizeram calar a todo o povo, dizendo: Calai-vos; porque este dia é santo; por isso não vos entristeçais.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Λευῖται κατεσιώπων πάντα τὸν λαὸν λέγοντες σιωπᾶτε ὅτι ἡ ἡμέρα ἁγία καὶ μὴ καταπίπτετε

text_en: So all the people went to eat and drink, and to send portions, and to make great mirth: because they understood the words that he had taught them.
text_la: Abiit itaque omnis populus ut comederet, et biberet, et mitteret partes, et faceret lætitiam magnam : quia intellexerant verba quæ docuerat eos.
text_pt: Então todo o povo se foi a comer, a beber, a enviar porções e a fazer grande regozijo; porque entenderam as palavras que lhes fizeram saber.
text_el: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν πᾶς ὁ λαὸς φαγεῖν καὶ πιεῖν καὶ ἀποστέλλειν μερίδας καὶ ποιῆσαι εὐφροσύνην μεγάλην ὅτι συνῆκαν ἐν τοῖς λόγοις οἷς ἐγνώρισεν αὐτοῖς

text_en: And on the second day the chiefs of the families of all the people, the priests , and the Levites were gathered together to Esdras the scribe , that he should interpret to them the words of the law.
text_la: Et in die secundo congregati sunt principes familiarum universi populi, sacerdotes et Levitæ, ad Esdram scribam, ut interpretaretur eis verba legis.
text_pt: E no dia seguinte ajuntaram-se os chefes dos pais de todo o povo, os sacerdotes e os levitas, a Esdras, o escriba; e isto para atentarem nas palavras da lei.
text_el: καὶ ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ δευτέρᾳ συνήχθησαν οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῷ παντὶ λαῷ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται πρὸς Εσδραν τὸν γραμματέα ἐπιστῆσαι πρὸς πάντας τοὺς λόγους τοῦ νόμου

text_en: And they found written in the law, that the Lord had commanded by the hand of Moses , that the children of Israel should dwell in tabernacles, on the feast, in the seventh month:
text_la: Et invenerunt scriptum in lege præcepisse Dominum in manu Moysi ut habitent filii Israël in tabernaculis in die solemni, mense septimo:
text_pt: E acharam escrito na lei que o Senhor ordenara, pelo ministério de Moisés, que os filhos de Israel habitassem em cabanas, na solenidade da festa, no sétimo mês.
text_el: καὶ εὕροσαν γεγραμμένον ἐν τῷ νόμῳ ᾧ ἐνετείλατο κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ ὅπως κατοικήσωσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν σκηναῖς ἐν ἑορτῇ ἐν μηνὶ τῷ ἑβδόμῳ

text_en: And that they should proclaim and publish the word in all their cities, and in Jerusalem , saying: Go forth to the mount, and fetch branches of olive, and branches of beautiful wood, branches of myrtle, and branches of palm, and branches of thick trees, to make tabernacles, as it is written.
text_la: et ut prædicent, et divulgent vocem in universis urbibus suis, et in Jerusalem, dicentes : Egredimini in montem, et afferte frondes olivæ, et frondes ligni pulcherrimi, frondes myrti, et ramos palmarum, et frondes ligni nemorosi, ut fiant tabernacula, sicut scriptum est.
text_pt: Assim publicaram, e fizeram passar pregão por todas as suas cidades, e em Jerusalém, dizendo: Saí ao monte, e trazei ramos de oliveiras, e ramos de zambujeiros, e ramos de murtas, e ramos de palmeiras, e ramos de árvores espessas, para fazer cabanas, como está escrito.
text_el: καὶ ὅπως σημάνωσιν σάλπιγξιν ἐν πάσαις ταῖς πόλεσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ εἶπεν Εσδρας ἐξέλθετε εἰς τὸ ὄρος καὶ ἐνέγκετε φύλλα ἐλαίας καὶ φύλλα ξύλων κυπαρισσίνων καὶ φύλλα μυρσίνης καὶ φύλλα φοινίκων καὶ φύλλα ξύλου δασέος ποιῆσαι σκηνὰς κατὰ τὸ γεγραμμένον

text_en: And the people went forth, and brought. And they made themselves tabernacles every man on the top of his house, and in their courts , and in the courts of the house of God , and in the street of the water gate, and in the street of the gate of Ephraim.
text_la: Et egressus est populus, et attulerunt. Feceruntque sibi tabernacula unusquisque in domate suo : et in atriis suis, et in atriis domus Dei, et in platea portæ aquarum, et in platea portæ Ephraim.
text_pt: Saiu, pois, o povo, e os trouxeram, e fizeram para si cabanas, cada um no seu terraço, nos seus pátios, e nos átrios da casa de Deus, na praça da porta das águas, e na praça da porta de Efraim.
text_el: καὶ ἐξῆλθεν ὁ λαὸς καὶ ἤνεγκαν καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς σκηνὰς ἀνὴρ ἐπὶ τοῦ δώματος αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐν ταῖς αὐλαῖς οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐν πλατείαις τῆς πόλεως καὶ ἕως πύλης Εφραιμ

text_en: And all the assembly of them that were returned from the captivity, made tabernacles, and dwelt in tabernacles: for since the days of Joshua the son of Nun the children of Israel had not done so, until that day: and there was exceeding great joy .
text_la: Fecit ergo universa ecclesia eorum qui redierant de captivitate, tabernacula, et habitaverunt in tabernaculis : non enim fecerant a diebus Josue filii Nun taliter filii Israël usque ad diem illum. Et fuit lætitia magna nimis.
text_pt: E toda a congregação dos que voltaram do cativeiro fizeram cabanas, e habitaram nas cabanas, porque nunca fizeram assim os filhos de Israel, desde os dias de Jesua, filho de Num, até àquele dia; e houve mui grande alegria.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησαν πᾶσα ἡ ἐκκλησία οἱ ἐπιστρέψαντες ἀπὸ τῆς αἰχμαλωσίας σκηνὰς καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν σκηναῖς ὅτι οὐκ ἐποίησαν ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν Ἰησοῦ υἱοῦ Ναυη οὕτως οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ἐκείνης καὶ ἐγένετο εὐφροσύνη μεγάλη

text_en: And he read in the book of the law of God day by day, from the first day till the last, and they kept the solemnity seven days, and in the eighth day a solemn assembly according to the manner.
text_la: Legit autem in libro legis Dei per dies singulos, a die primo usque ad diem novissimum. Et fecerunt solemnitatem septem diebus, et in die octavo collectam juxta ritum.
text_pt: E, de dia em dia, Esdras leu no livro da lei de Deus, desde o primeiro dia até ao derradeiro; e celebraram a solenidade da festa sete dias, e no oitavo dia, houve uma assembléia solene, segundo o rito.
text_el: καὶ ἀνέγνω ἐν βιβλίῳ νόμου τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμέραν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἀπὸ τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς πρώτης ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας τῆς ἐσχάτης καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑορτὴν ἑπτὰ ἡμέρας καὶ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τῇ ὀγδόῃ ἐξόδιον κατὰ τὸ κρίμα

text_en: And in the four and twentieth day of the month the children of Israel came together with fasting and with sackcloth , and earth upon them.
text_la: In die autem vigesimo quarto mensis hujus, convenerunt filii Israël in jejunio et in saccis, et humus super eos.
text_pt: E, no dia vinte e quatro deste mês, ajuntaram-se os filhos de Israel com jejum e com sacos, e traziam terra sobre si.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ εἰκοστῇ καὶ τετάρτῃ τοῦ μηνὸς τούτου συνήχθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἐν νηστείᾳ καὶ ἐν σάκκοις

text_en: And the seed of the children of Israel separated themselves from every stranger: and they stood, and confessed their sins , and the iniquities of their fathers.
text_la: Et separatum est semen filiorum Israël ab omni filio alienigena : et steterunt, et confitebantur peccata sua, et iniquitates patrum suorum.
text_pt: E a descendência de Israel se apartou de todos os estrangeiros, e puseram-se em pé, e fizeram confissão pelos seus pecados e pelas iniqüidades de seus pais.
text_el: καὶ ἐχωρίσθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ ἀπὸ παντὸς υἱοῦ ἀλλοτρίου καὶ ἔστησαν καὶ ἐξηγόρευσαν τὰς ἁμαρτίας αὐτῶν καὶ τὰς ἀνομίας τῶν πατέρων αὐτῶν

text_en: And they rose up to stand: and they read in the book of the law of the Lord their God , four times in the day, and four times they confessed, and adored the Lord their God .
text_la: Et consurrexerunt ad standum : et legerunt in volumine legis Domini Dei sui, quater in die, et quater confitebantur, et adorabant Dominum Deum suum.
text_pt: E, levantando-se no seu lugar, leram no livro da lei do Senhor seu Deus uma quarta parte do dia; e na outra quarta parte fizeram confissão, e adoraram ao Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν ἐπὶ στάσει αὐτῶν καὶ ἀνέγνωσαν ἐν βιβλίῳ νόμου κυρίου θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ ἦσαν ἐξαγορεύοντες τῷ κυρίῳ καὶ προσκυνοῦντες τῷ κυρίῳ θεῷ αὐτῶν

text_en: And there stood up upon the step of the Levites , Josue, and Bani, and Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, and Chanani: and they cried with a loud voice to the Lord their God .
text_la: Surrexerunt autem super gradum Levitarum Josue, et Bani, et Cedmihel, Sabania, Bonni, Sarebias, Bani, et Chanani : et clamaverunt voce magna ad Dominum Deum suum.
text_pt: E Jesuá, Bani, Cadmiel, Sebanias, Buni, Serebias, Bani e Quenani se puseram em pé no lugar alto dos levitas, e clamaram em alta voz ao Senhor seu Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔστη ἐπὶ ἀναβάσει τῶν Λευιτῶν Ἰησοῦς καὶ υἱοὶ Καδμιηλ Σαχανια υἱὸς Σαραβια υἱοὶ Χανανι καὶ ἐβόησαν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ πρὸς κύριον τὸν θεὸν αὐτῶν

text_en: And the Levites Josue and Cedmihel, Bonni, Hasebnia, Serebia, Oduia, Sebnia, and Phathahia, said: Arise, bless the Lord your God from eternity to eternity: and blessed be the high name of your glory with all blessing and praise.
text_la: Et dixerunt Levitæ Josue, et Cedmihel, Bonni, Hasebnia, Serebia, Odaia, Sebnia, Phathathia : Surgite, benedicite Domino Deo vestro ab æterno usque in æternum : et benedicant nomini gloriæ tuæ excelso in omni benedictione et laude.
text_pt: E os levitas, Jesuá, Cadmiel, Bani, Hasabnéias, Serebias, Hodias, Sebanias e Petaías, disseram: Levantai-vos, bendizei ao Senhor vosso Deus de eternidade em eternidade; e bendigam o teu glorioso nome, que está exaltado sobre toda a bênção e louvor.
text_el: καὶ εἴποσαν οἱ Λευῖται Ἰησοῦς καὶ Καδμιηλ ἀνάστητε εὐλογεῖτε τὸν κύριον θεὸν ὑμῶν ἀπὸ τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ ἕως τοῦ αἰῶνος καὶ εὐλογήσουσιν ὄνομα δόξης σου καὶ ὑψώσουσιν ἐπὶ πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ καὶ αἰνέσει

text_en: You yourself, O Lord alone, you have made heaven , and the heaven of heavens , and all the host thereof: the earth and all things that are in it: the seas and all that are therein: and you give life to all these things, and the host of heaven adores you.
text_la: Tu ipse, Domine, solus, tu fecisti cælum, et cælum cælorum, et omnem exercitum eorum : terram, et universa quæ in ea sunt : maria, et omnia quæ in eis sunt : et tu vivificas omnia hæc, et exercitus cæli te adorat.
text_pt: Só tu és Senhor; tu fizeste o céu, o céu dos céus, e todo o seu exército, a terra e tudo quanto nela há, os mares e tudo quanto neles há, e tu os guardas com vida a todos; e o exército dos céus te adora.
text_el: καὶ εἶπεν Εσδρας σὺ εἶ αὐτὸς κύριος μόνος σὺ ἐποίησας τὸν οὐρανὸν καὶ τὸν οὐρανὸν τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ πᾶσαν τὴν στάσιν αὐτῶν τὴν γῆν καὶ πάντα ὅσα ἐστὶν ἐν αὐτῇ τὰς θαλάσσας καὶ πάντα τὰ ἐν αὐταῖς καὶ σὺ ζωοποιεῖς τὰ πάντα καὶ σοὶ προσκυνοῦσιν αἱ στρατιαὶ τῶν οὐρανῶν

text_en: You O Lord God , are he who chose Abram , and brought him forth out of the fire of the Chaldeans, and gave him the name of Abraham .
text_la: Tu ipse, Domine Deus, qui elegisti Abram, et eduxisti eum de igne Chaldæorum, et posuisti nomen ejus Abraham:
text_pt: Tu és o Senhor, o Deus, que elegeste a Abrão, e o tiraste de Ur dos caldeus, e lhe puseste por nome Abraão.
text_el: σὺ εἶ κύριος ὁ θεός σὺ ἐξελέξω ἐν Αβραμ καὶ ἐξήγαγες αὐτὸν ἐκ τῆς χώρας τῶν Χαλδαίων καὶ ἐπέθηκας αὐτῷ ὄνομα Αβρααμ

text_en: And you found his heart faithful before you: and you made a covenant with him, to give him the land of the Chanaanite , of the Hethite , and of the Amorrhite , and of the Pherezite, and of the Jebusite, and of the Gergezite, to give it to his seed: and you have fulfilled your words, because you are just .
text_la: et invenisti cor ejus fidele coram te, et percussisti cum eo fœdus ut dares ei terram Chananæi, Hethæi, et Amorrhæi, et Pherezæi, et Jebusæi, et Gergesæi, ut dares semini ejus : et implesti verba tua, quoniam justus es.
text_pt: E achaste o seu coração fiel perante ti, e fizeste com ele a aliança, de que darias à sua descendência a terra dos cananeus, dos heteus, dos amorreus, dos perizeus, dos jebuseus e dos girgaseus; e confirmaste as tuas palavras, porquanto és justo.
text_el: καὶ εὗρες τὴν καρδίαν αὐτοῦ πιστὴν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ διέθου πρὸς αὐτὸν διαθήκην δοῦναι αὐτῷ τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων καὶ Χετταίων καὶ Αμορραίων καὶ Φερεζαίων καὶ Ιεβουσαίων καὶ Γεργεσαίων καὶ τῷ σπέρματι αὐτοῦ καὶ ἔστησας τοὺς λόγους σου ὅτι δίκαιος σύ

text_en: And you saw the affliction of our fathers in Egypt : and you heard their cry by the Red Sea .
text_la: Et vidisti afflictionem patrum nostrorum in Ægypto, clamoremque eorum audisti super mare Rubrum.
text_pt: E viste a aflição de nossos pais no Egito, e ouviste o seu clamor junto ao Mar Vermelho.
text_el: καὶ εἶδες τὴν ταπείνωσιν τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ τὴν κραυγὴν αὐτῶν ἤκουσας ἐπὶ θάλασσαν ἐρυθράν

text_en: And you showed signs and wonders upon Pharao , and upon all his servants, and upon the people of his land: for you knew that they dealt proudly against them: and you made yourself a name , as it is at this day.
text_la: Et dedisti signa atque portenta in Pharaone, et in universis servis ejus, et in omni populo terræ illius : cognovisti enim quia superbe egerant contra eos : et fecisti tibi nomen, sicut et in hac die.
text_pt: E mostraste sinais e prodígios a Faraó, e a todos os seus servos, e a todo o povo da sua terra, porque soubeste que soberbamente os trataram; e assim adquiriste para ti nome, como hoje se vê.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκας σημεῖα ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ ἐν Φαραω καὶ ἐν πᾶσιν τοῖς παισὶν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ τῆς γῆς αὐτοῦ ὅτι ἔγνως ὅτι ὑπερηφάνησαν ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ ἐποίησας σεαυτῷ ὄνομα ὡς ἡ ἡμέρα αὕτη

text_en: And you divided the sea before them, and they passed through the midst of the sea on dry land: but their persecutors you threw into the depth, as a stone into mighty waters.
text_la: Et mare divisisti ante eos, et transierunt per medium maris in sicco : persecutores autem eorum projecisti in profundum, quasi lapidem in aquas validas.
text_pt: E o mar fendeste perante eles, e passaram pelo meio do mar, em seco; e lançaste os seus perseguidores nas profundezas, como uma pedra nas águas violentas.
text_el: καὶ τὴν θάλασσαν ἔρρηξας ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν καὶ παρήλθοσαν ἐν μέσῳ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐν ξηρασίᾳ καὶ τοὺς καταδιώξαντας αὐτοὺς ἔρριψας εἰς βυθὸν ὡσεὶ λίθον ἐν ὕδατι σφοδρῷ

text_en: And in a pillar of a cloud you were their leader by day, and in a pillar of fire by night, that they might see the way by which they went.
text_la: Et in columna nubis ductor eorum fuisti per diem, et in columna ignis per noctem, ut appareret eis via per quam ingrediebantur.
text_pt: E guiaste-os de dia por uma coluna de nuvem, e de noite por uma coluna de fogo, para lhes iluminar o caminho por onde haviam de ir.
text_el: καὶ ἐν στύλῳ νεφέλης ὡδήγησας αὐτοὺς ἡμέρας καὶ ἐν στύλῳ πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα τοῦ φωτίσαι αὐτοῖς τὴν ὁδόν ἐν ᾗ πορεύσονται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: You came down also to mount Sinai , and spoke with them from heaven , and you gave them right judgments, and the law of truth , ceremonies , and good precepts.
text_la: Ad montem quoque Sinai descendisti, et locutus es cum eis de cælo, et dedisti eis judicia recta, et legem veritatis, cæremonias, et præcepta bona:
text_pt: E sobre o monte Sinai desceste, e dos céus falaste com eles, e deste-lhes juízos retos e leis verdadeiras, estatutos e mandamentos bons.
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ ὄρος Σινα κατέβης καὶ ἐλάλησας πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἐξ οὐρανοῦ καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς κρίματα εὐθέα καὶ νόμους ἀληθείας προστάγματα καὶ ἐντολὰς ἀγαθάς

text_en: You made known to them your holy sabbath , and prescribed to them commandments, and ceremonies , and the law by the hand of Moses your servant.
text_la: et sabbatum sanctificatum tuum ostendisti eis : et mandata, et cæremonias, et legem præcepisti eis in manu Moysi servi tui.
text_pt: E o teu santo sábado lhes fizeste conhecer; e preceitos, estatutos e lei lhes mandaste pelo ministério de Moisés, teu servo.
text_el: καὶ τὸ σάββατόν σου τὸ ἅγιον ἐγνώρισας αὐτοῖς ἐντολὰς καὶ προστάγματα καὶ νόμον ἐνετείλω αὐτοῖς ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ δούλου σου

text_en: And you gave them bread from heaven in their hunger, and brought forth water for them out of the rock in their thirst, and you said to them that they should go in, and possess the land, upon which you had lifted up your hand to give it them.
text_la: Panem quoque de cælo dedisti eis in fame eorum, et aquam de petra eduxisti eis sitientibus, et dixisti eis ut ingrederentur et possiderent terram, super quam levasti manum tuam ut traderes eis.
text_pt: E pão dos céus lhes deste na sua fome, e água da penha lhes produziste na sua sede; e lhes disseste que entrassem para possuírem a terra pela qual alçaste a tua mão, que lhes havias de dar.
text_el: καὶ ἄρτον ἐξ οὐρανοῦ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς εἰς σιτοδείαν αὐτῶν καὶ ὕδωρ ἐκ πέτρας ἐξήνεγκας αὐτοῖς εἰς δίψαν αὐτῶν καὶ εἶπας αὐτοῖς εἰσελθεῖν κληρονομῆσαι τὴν γῆν ἐφ' ἣν ἐξέτεινας τὴν χεῖρά σου δοῦναι αὐτοῖς

text_en: But they and our fathers dealt proudly , and hardened their necks and hearkened not to your commandments.
text_la: Ipsi vero et patres nostri superbe egerunt, et induraverunt cervices suas, et non audierunt mandata tua.
text_pt: Porém eles e nossos pais se houveram soberbamente, e endureceram a sua cerviz, e não deram ouvidos aos teus mandamentos.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν ὑπερηφανεύσαντο καὶ ἐσκλήρυναν τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν τῶν ἐντολῶν σου

text_en: And they would not hear, and they remembered not your wonders which you had done for them. And they hardened their necks, and gave the head to return to their bondage, as it were by contention. But you, a forgiving God , gracious, and merciful, longsuffering, and full of compassion, did not forsake them.
text_la: Et noluerunt audire, et non sunt recordati mirabilium tuorum quæ feceras eis. Et induraverunt cervices suas, et dederunt caput ut converterentur ad servitutem suam, quasi per contentionem. Tu autem, Deus propitius, clemens, et misericors, longanimis, et multæ miserationis, non dereliquisti eos,
text_pt: E recusaram ouvir-te, e não se lembraram das tuas maravilhas, que lhes fizeste, e endureceram a sua cerviz e, na sua rebelião, levantaram um capitão, a fim de voltarem para a sua servidão; porém tu, ó Deus perdoador, clemente e misericordioso, tardio em irar-te, e grande em beneficência, tu não os desamparaste.
text_el: καὶ ἀνένευσαν τοῦ εἰσακοῦσαι καὶ οὐκ ἐμνήσθησαν τῶν θαυμασίων σου ὧν ἐποίησας μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ ἐσκλήρυναν τὸν τράχηλον αὐτῶν καὶ ἔδωκαν ἀρχὴν ἐπιστρέψαι εἰς δουλείαν αὐτῶν ἐν Αἰγύπτῳ καὶ σὺ θεὸς ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτίρμων μακρόθυμος καὶ πολυέλεος καὶ οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπες αὐτούς

text_en: Yea when they had made also to themselves a molten calf , and had said: This is your God , that brought you out of Egypt : and had committed great blasphemies:
text_la: et quidem cum fecissent sibi vitulum conflatilem, et dixissent : Iste est deus tuus, qui eduxit te de Ægypto : feceruntque blasphemias magnas:
text_pt: Ainda mesmo quando eles fizeram para si um bezerro de fundição, e disseram: Este é o teu Deus, que te tirou do Egito; e cometeram grandes blasfêmias;
text_el: ἔτι δὲ καὶ ἐποίησαν ἑαυτοῖς μόσχον χωνευτὸν καὶ εἶπαν οὗτοι οἱ θεοὶ οἱ ἐξαγαγόντες ἡμᾶς ἐξ Αἰγύπτου καὶ ἐποίησαν παροργισμοὺς μεγάλους

text_en: Yet you, in your many mercies, did not leave them in the desert : the pillar of the cloud departed not from them by day to lead them in the way, and the pillar of fire by night to show them the way by which they should go.
text_la: tu autem in misericordiis tuis multis non dimisisti eos in deserto : columna nubis non recessit ab eis per diem ut duceret eos in viam, et columna ignis per noctem ut ostenderet eis iter per quod ingrederentur.
text_pt: Todavia tu, pela multidão das tuas misericórdias, não os deixaste no deserto. A coluna de nuvem nunca se apartou deles de dia, para os guiar pelo caminho, nem a coluna de fogo de noite, para lhes iluminar; e isto pelo caminho por onde haviam de ir.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐν οἰκτιρμοῖς σου τοῖς πολλοῖς οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπες αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ τὸν στῦλον τῆς νεφέλης οὐκ ἐξέκλινας ἀπ' αὐτῶν ἡμέρας ὁδηγῆσαι αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ καὶ τὸν στῦλον τοῦ πυρὸς τὴν νύκτα φωτίζειν αὐτοῖς τὴν ὁδόν ἐν ᾗ πορεύσονται ἐν αὐτῇ

text_en: And you gave them your good Spirit to teach them, and your manna you did not withhold from their mouth, and you gave them water for their thirst.
text_la: Et spiritum tuum bonum dedisti, qui doceret eos : et manna tuum non prohibuisti ab ore eorum, et aquam dedisti eis in siti.
text_pt: E deste o teu bom espírito, para os ensinar; e o teu maná não retiraste da sua boca; e água lhes deste na sua sede.
text_el: καὶ τὸ πνεῦμά σου τὸ ἀγαθὸν ἔδωκας συνετίσαι αὐτοὺς καὶ τὸ μαννα σοῦ οὐκ ἀφυστέρησας ἀπὸ στόματος αὐτῶν καὶ ὕδωρ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς τῷ δίψει αὐτῶν

text_en: Forty years did you feed them in the desert , and nothing was wanting to them: their garments did not grow old, and their feet were not worn.
text_la: Quadraginta annis pavisti eos in deserto, nihilque eis defuit : vestimenta eorum non inveteraverunt, et pedes eorum non sunt attriti.
text_pt: De tal modo os sustentaste quarenta anos no deserto; nada lhes faltou; as suas roupas não se envelheceram, e os seus pés não se incharam.
text_el: καὶ τεσσαράκοντα ἔτη διέθρεψας αὐτοὺς ἐν τῇ ἐρήμῳ οὐχ ὑστέρησαν ἱμάτια αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπαλαιώθησαν καὶ πόδες αὐτῶν οὐ διερράγησαν

text_en: And you gave them kingdoms, and nations, and divided lots for them: and they possessed the land of Sehon, and the land of the king of Hesebon , and the land of Og king of Basan.
text_la: Et dedisti eis regna, et populos, et partitus es eis sortes : et possederunt terram Sehon, et terram regis Hesebon, et terram Og regis Basan.
text_pt: Também lhes deste reinos e povos, e os repartiste em porções; e eles possuíram a terra de Siom, a saber, a terra do rei de Hesbom, e a terra de Ogue, rei de Basã.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς βασιλείας καὶ λαοὺς καὶ διεμέρισας αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν τὴν γῆν Σηων βασιλέως Εσεβων καὶ τὴν γῆν Ωγ βασιλέως τοῦ Βασαν

text_en: And you multiplied their children as the stars of heaven , and brought them to the land concerning which you had said to their fathers, that they should go in and possess it.
text_la: Et multiplicasti filios eorum sicut stellas cæli, et adduxisti eos ad terram de qua dixeras patribus eorum ut ingrederentur et possiderent.
text_pt: E multiplicaste os seus filhos como as estrelas do céu, e trouxeste-os à terra de que tinhas falado a seus pais que nela entrariam para a possuírem.
text_el: καὶ τοὺς υἱοὺς αὐτῶν ἐπλήθυνας ὡς τοὺς ἀστέρας τοῦ οὐρανοῦ καὶ εἰσήγαγες αὐτοὺς εἰς τὴν γῆν ἣν εἶπας τοῖς πατράσιν αὐτῶν καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν αὐτήν

text_en: And the children came and possessed the land, and you humbled before them the inhabitants of the land, the Chanaanites , and gave them into their hands, with their kings, and the people of the land, that they might do with them as it pleased them.
text_la: Et venerunt filii, et possederunt terram, et humiliasti coram eis habitatores terræ Chananæos, et dedisti eos in manu eorum, et reges eorum, et populos terræ, ut facerent eis sicut placebant illis.
text_pt: Assim os filhos entraram e possuíram aquela terra; e abateste perante eles os moradores da terra, os cananeus, e lhos entregaste na mão, como também os reis e os povos da terra, para fazerem deles conforme a sua vontade.
text_el: καὶ ἐξέτριψας ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν τοὺς κατοικοῦντας τὴν γῆν τῶν Χαναναίων καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοὺς εἰς τὰς χεῖρας αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς λαοὺς τῆς γῆς ποιῆσαι αὐτοῖς ὡς ἀρεστὸν ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν

text_en: And they took strong cities and a fat land, and possessed houses full of all goods: cisterns made by others, vineyards, and oliveyards, and fruit trees in abundance: and they ate, and were filled, and became fat, and abounded with delight in your great goodness.
text_la: Ceperunt itaque urbes munitas et humum pinguem, et possederunt domos plenas cunctis bonis : cisternas ab aliis fabricatas, vineas, et oliveta, et ligna pomifera multa : et comederunt, et saturati sunt, et impinguati sunt, et abundaverunt deliciis in bonitate tua magna.
text_pt: E tomaram cidades fortificadas e terra fértil, e possuíram casas cheias de toda a fartura, cisternas cavadas, vinhas e olivais, e árvores frutíferas, em abundância; e comeram e se fartaram e engordaram e viveram em delícias, pela tua grande bondade.
text_el: καὶ κατελάβοσαν πόλεις ὑψηλὰς καὶ ἐκληρονόμησαν οἰκίας πλήρεις πάντων ἀγαθῶν λάκκους λελατομημένους ἀμπελῶνας καὶ ἐλαιῶνας καὶ πᾶν ξύλον βρώσιμον εἰς πλῆθος καὶ ἐφάγοσαν καὶ ἐνεπλήσθησαν καὶ ἐλιπάνθησαν καὶ ἐτρύφησαν ἐν ἀγαθωσύνῃ σου τῇ μεγάλῃ

text_en: But they provoked you to wrath , and departed from you, and threw your law behind their backs: and they killed your prophets , who admonished them earnestly to return to you: and they were guilty of great blasphemies.
text_la: Provocaverunt autem te ad iracundiam, et recesserunt a te, et projecerunt legem tuam post terga sua : et prophetas tuos occiderunt, qui contestabantur eos ut reverterentur ad te : feceruntque blasphemias grandes.
text_pt: Porém se obstinaram, e se rebelaram contra ti, e lançaram a tua lei para trás das suas costas, e mataram os teus profetas, que protestavam contra eles, para que voltassem para ti; assim fizeram grandes abominações.
text_el: καὶ ἤλλαξαν καὶ ἀπέστησαν ἀπὸ σοῦ καὶ ἔρριψαν τὸν νόμον σου ὀπίσω σώματος αὐτῶν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας σου ἀπέκτειναν οἳ διεμαρτύραντο ἐν αὐτοῖς ἐπιστρέψαι αὐτοὺς πρὸς σέ καὶ ἐποίησαν παροργισμοὺς μεγάλους

text_en: And you gave them into the hands of their enemies, and they afflicted them. And in the time of their tribulation they cried to you, and you heard from heaven , and according to the multitude of your tender mercies you gave them saviours, to save them from the hands of their enemies.
text_la: Et dedisti eos in manu hostium suorum, et afflixerunt eos. Et in tempore tribulationis suæ clamaverunt ad te, et tu de cælo audisti, et secundum miserationes tuas multas dedisti eis salvatores, qui salvarent eos de manu hostium suorum.
text_pt: Por isso os entregaste na mão dos seus adversários, que os angustiaram; mas no tempo de sua angústia, clamando a ti, desde os céus tu ouviste; e segundo a tua grande misericórdia lhes deste libertadores que os libertaram da mão de seus adversários.
text_el: καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ θλιβόντων αὐτούς καὶ ἔθλιψαν αὐτούς καὶ ἀνεβόησαν πρὸς σὲ ἐν καιρῷ θλίψεως αὐτῶν καὶ σὺ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ σου ἤκουσας καὶ ἐν οἰκτιρμοῖς σου τοῖς μεγάλοις ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς σωτῆρας καὶ ἔσωσας αὐτοὺς ἐκ χειρὸς θλιβόντων αὐτούς

text_en: But after they had rest, they returned to do evil in your sight: and you left them in the hand of their enemies, and they had dominion over them. Then they returned, and cried to you: and you heard from heaven , and delivered them many times in your mercies.
text_la: Cumque requievissent, reversi sunt ut facerent malum in conspectu tuo, et dereliquisti eos in manu inimicorum suorum, et possederunt eos. Conversique sunt, et clamaverunt ad te : tu autem de cælo exaudisti, et liberasti eos in misericordiis tuis, multis temporibus.
text_pt: Porém, em tendo repouso, tornavam a fazer o mal diante de ti; e tu os deixavas na mão dos seus inimigos, para que dominassem sobre eles; e convertendo-se eles, e clamando a ti, tu os ouviste desde os céus, e segundo a tua misericórdia os livraste muitas vezes.
text_el: καὶ ὡς ἀνεπαύσαντο ἐπέστρεψαν ποιῆσαι τὸ πονηρὸν ἐνώπιόν σου καὶ ἐγκατέλιπες αὐτοὺς εἰς χεῖρας ἐχθρῶν αὐτῶν καὶ κατῆρξαν ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ πάλιν ἀνεβόησαν πρὸς σέ καὶ σὺ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ εἰσήκουσας καὶ ἐρρύσω αὐτοὺς ἐν οἰκτιρμοῖς σου πολλοῖς

text_en: And you admonished them to return to your law. But they dealt proudly , and hearkened not to your commandments, but sinned against your judgments, which if a man do, he shall live in them: and they withdrew the shoulder, and hardened their neck, and would not hear.
text_la: Et contestatus es eos ut reverterentur ad legem tuam. Ipsi vero superbe egerunt, et non audierunt mandata tua, et in judiciis tuis peccaverunt, quæ faciet homo, et vivet in eis : et dederunt humerum recedentem, et cervicem suam induraverunt, nec audierunt.
text_pt: E testificaste contra eles, para que voltassem para a tua lei; porém eles se houveram soberbamente, e não deram ouvidos aos teus mandamentos, mas pecaram contra os teus juízos, pelos quais o homem que os cumprir viverá; viraram o ombro, endureceram a sua cerviz, e não quiseram ouvir.
text_el: καὶ ἐπεμαρτύρω αὐτοῖς ἐπιστρέψαι αὐτοὺς εἰς τὸν νόμον σου καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν ἀλλὰ ἐν ταῖς ἐντολαῖς σου καὶ ἐν τοῖς κρίμασί σου ἡμάρτοσαν ἃ ποιήσας αὐτὰ ἄνθρωπος ζήσεται ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἔδωκαν νῶτον ἀπειθοῦντα καὶ τράχηλον αὐτῶν ἐσκλήρυναν καὶ οὐκ ἤκουσαν

text_en: And you did forbear with them for many years, and testified against them by your spirit by the hand of your prophets : and they heard not, and you delivered them into the hand of the people of the lands.
text_la: Et protraxisti super eos annos multos, et contestatus es eos in spiritu tuo per manum prophetarum tuorum : et non audierunt, et tradidisti eos in manu populorum terrarum.
text_pt: Porém estendeste a tua benignidade sobre eles por muitos anos, e testificaste contra eles pelo teu Espírito, pelo ministério dos teus profetas; porém eles não deram ouvidos; por isso os entregaste nas mãos dos povos das terras.
text_el: καὶ εἵλκυσας ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ἔτη πολλὰ καὶ ἐπεμαρτύρω αὐτοῖς ἐν πνεύματί σου ἐν χειρὶ προφητῶν σου καὶ οὐκ ἠνωτίσαντο καὶ ἔδωκας αὐτοὺς ἐν χειρὶ λαῶν τῆς γῆς

text_en: Yet in your very many mercies you did not utterly consume them, nor forsake them: because you are a merciful and gracious God .
text_la: In misericordiis autem tuis plurimis non fecisti eos in consumptionem, nec dereliquisti eos : quoniam Deus miserationum et clemens es tu.
text_pt: Mas pela tua grande misericórdia os não destruíste nem desamparaste, porque és um Deus clemente e misericordioso.
text_el: καὶ σὺ ἐν οἰκτιρμοῖς σου τοῖς πολλοῖς οὐκ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς συντέλειαν καὶ οὐκ ἐγκατέλιπες αὐτούς ὅτι ἰσχυρὸς εἶ καὶ ἐλεήμων καὶ οἰκτίρμων

text_en: Now therefore our God , great, strong, and terrible, who keeps covenant and mercy, turn not away from your face all the labour which has come upon us, upon our kings, and our princes, and our priests , and our prophets , and our fathers, and all the people from the days of the king of Assur , until this day.
text_la: Nunc itaque Deus noster magne, fortis et terribilis, custodiens pactum et misericordiam, ne avertas a facie tua omnem laborem, qui invenit nos, reges nostros, et principes nostros, et sacerdotes nostros, et prophetas nostros, et patres nostros, et omnem populum tuum a diebus regis Assur usque in diem hanc.
text_pt: Agora, pois, nosso Deus, o grande, poderoso e terrível Deus, que guardas a aliança e a beneficência, não tenhas em pouca conta toda a aflição que nos alcançou a nós, aos nossos reis, aos nossos príncipes, aos nossos sacerdotes, aos nossos profetas, aos nossos pais e a todo o teu povo, desde os dias dos reis da Assíria até ao dia de hoje.
text_el: καὶ νῦν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν ὁ ἰσχυρὸς ὁ μέγας ὁ κραταιὸς καὶ ὁ φοβερὸς φυλάσσων τὴν διαθήκην σου καὶ τὸ ἔλεός σου μὴ ὀλιγωθήτω ἐνώπιόν σου πᾶς ὁ μόχθος ὃς εὗρεν ἡμᾶς καὶ τοὺς βασιλεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας ἡμῶν καὶ τοὺς πατέρας ἡμῶν καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ λαῷ σου ἀπὸ ἡμερῶν βασιλέων Ασσουρ καὶ ἕως τῆς ἡμέρας ταύτης

text_en: And you are just in all things that have come upon us: because you have done truth , but we have done wickedly .
text_la: Et tu justus es in omnibus quæ venerunt super nos : quia veritatem fecisti, nos autem impie egimus.
text_pt: Porém tu és justo em tudo quanto tem vindo sobre nós; porque tu tens agido fielmente, e nós temos agido impiamente.
text_el: καὶ σὺ δίκαιος ἐπὶ πᾶσι τοῖς ἐρχομένοις ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ὅτι ἀλήθειαν ἐποίησας καὶ ἡμεῖς ἐξημάρτομεν

text_en: Our kings, our princes, our priests , and our fathers have not kept your law, and have not minded your commandments, and your testimonies which you have testified among them.
text_la: Reges nostri, principes nostri, sacerdotes nostri et patres nostri non fecerunt legem tuam, et non attenderunt mandata tua, et testimonia tua quæ testificatus es in eis.
text_pt: E os nossos reis, os nossos príncipes, os nossos sacerdotes, e os nossos pais não guardaram a tua lei, e não deram ouvidos aos teus mandamentos e aos teus testemunhos, que testificaste contra eles.
text_el: καὶ οἱ βασιλεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἡμῶν καὶ οἱ πατέρες ἡμῶν οὐκ ἐποίησαν τὸν νόμον σου καὶ οὐ προσέσχον τῶν ἐντολῶν σου καὶ τὰ μαρτύριά σου ἃ διεμαρτύρω αὐτοῖς

text_en: And they have not served you in their kingdoms, and in your manifold goodness, which you gave them, and in the large and fat land, which you delivered before them, nor did they return from their most wicked devices.
text_la: Et ipsi in regnis suis, et in bonitate tua multa quam dederas eis, et in terra latissima et pingui quam tradideras in conspectu eorum, non servierunt tibi, nec reversi sunt a studiis suis pessimis.
text_pt: Porque eles nem no seu reino, nem na muita abundância de bens que lhes deste, nem na terra espaçosa e fértil que puseste diante deles, te serviram, nem se converteram de suas más obras.
text_el: καὶ αὐτοὶ ἐν βασιλείᾳ σου καὶ ἐν ἀγαθωσύνῃ σου τῇ πολλῇ ᾗ ἔδωκας αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐν τῇ γῇ τῇ πλατείᾳ καὶ λιπαρᾷ ᾗ ἔδωκας ἐνώπιον αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐδούλευσάν σοι καὶ οὐκ ἀπέστρεψαν ἀπὸ ἐπιτηδευμάτων αὐτῶν τῶν πονηρῶν

text_en: Behold we ourselves this day are bondmen: and the land, which you gave our fathers, to eat the bread thereof, and the good things thereof, and we ourselves are servants in it.
text_la: Ecce nos ipsi hodie servi sumus : et terra quam dedisti patribus nostris ut comederent panem ejus, et quæ bona sunt ejus, et nos ipsi servi sumus in ea.
text_pt: Eis que hoje somos servos; e até na terra que deste a nossos pais, para comerem o seu fruto e o seu bem, eis que somos servos nela.
text_el: ἰδού ἐσμεν σήμερον δοῦλοι καὶ ἡ γῆ ἣν ἔδωκας τοῖς πατράσιν ἡμῶν φαγεῖν τὸν καρπὸν αὐτῆς

text_en: And the fruits thereof grow up for the kings, whom you have set over us for our sins , and they have dominion over our bodies, and over our beasts, according to their will, and we are in great tribulation.
text_la: Et fruges ejus multiplicantur regibus quos posuisti super nos propter peccata nostra : et corporibus nostris dominantur, et jumentis nostris secundum voluntatem suam : et in tribulatione magna sumus.
text_pt: E ela multiplica os seus produtos para os reis, que puseste sobre nós, por causa dos nossos pecados; e conforme a sua vontade dominam sobre os nossos corpos e sobre o nosso gado; e estamos numa grande angústia.
text_el: τοῖς βασιλεῦσιν οἷς ἔδωκας ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐν ἁμαρτίαις ἡμῶν καὶ ἐπὶ τὰ σώματα ἡμῶν ἐξουσιάζουσιν καὶ ἐν κτήνεσιν ἡμῶν ὡς ἀρεστὸν αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐν θλίψει μεγάλῃ ἐσμέν

text_en: And because of all this we ourselves make a covenant, and write it, and our princes, our Levites , and our priests sign it.
text_la: Super omnibus ergo his nos ipsi percutimus fœdus, et scribimus : et signant principes nostri, Levitæ nostri, et sacerdotes nostri.
text_pt: E os que selaram foram: Neemias, o governador, filho de Hacalias, e Zedequias,
text_el: καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τούτοις ἡμεῖς διατιθέμεθα πίστιν καὶ γράφομεν καὶ ἐπισφραγίζουσιν πάντες ἄρχοντες ἡμῶν Λευῖται ἡμῶν ἱερεῖς ἡμῶν

text_en: And the subscribers were Nehemias, Athersatha the son of Hachelai, and Sedecias,
text_la: Signatores autem fuerunt Nehemias, Athersatha filius Hachelai, et Sedecias,
text_pt: Seraías, Azarias, Jeremias,
text_el: καὶ ἐπὶ τῶν σφραγιζόντων Νεεμιας υἱὸς Αχαλια καὶ Σεδεκιας

text_en: Saraias, Azarias, Jeremiah ,
text_la: Saraias, Azarias, Jeremias,
text_pt: Pasur, Amarias, Malquias,
text_el: υἱὸς Σαραια καὶ Αζαρια καὶ Ιερμια

text_en: Pheshur, Amarias, Melchias,
text_la: Pheshur, Amarias, Melchias,
text_pt: Hatus, Sebanias, Maluque,
text_el: Φασουρ Αμαρια Μελχια

text_en: Hattus, Sebenia, Melluch,
text_la: Hattus, Sebenia, Melluch,
text_pt: Harim, Meremote, Obadias,
text_el: Ατους Σεβανι Μαλουχ

text_en: Harem, Merimuth, Obdias,
text_la: Harem, Merimuth, Obdias,
text_pt: Daniel, Ginetom, Baruque,
text_el: Ιραμ Μεραμωθ Αβδια

text_en: Daniel, Genthon, Baruch,
text_la: Daniel, Genthon, Baruch,
text_pt: Mesulão, Abias, Miamim,
text_el: Δανιηλ Γαναθων Βαρουχ

text_en: Mosollam, Abia, Miamin,
text_la: Mosollam, Abia, Miamin,
text_pt: Maazias, Bilgai, Semaías; estes eram os sacerdotes.
text_el: Μεσουλαμ Αβια Μιαμιν

text_en: Maazia, Belgia, Semeia: these were priests .
text_la: Maazia, Belgai, Semeia : hi sacerdotes.
text_pt: E os levitas: Jesuá, filho de Azanias, Binui, dos filhos de Henadade, Cadmiel,
text_el: Μααζια Βελγαι Σαμαια οὗτοι ἱερεῖς

text_en: And the Levites , Josue the son of Azanias, Bennui of the sons of Henadad, Cedmihel,
text_la: Porro Levitæ, Josue filius Azaniæ, Bennui de filiis Henadad, Cedmihel,
text_pt: E seus irmãos: Sebanias, Hodias, Quelita, Pelaías, Hanã,
text_el: καὶ οἱ Λευῖται Ἰησοῦς υἱὸς Αζανια Βαναιου ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ηναδαδ Καδμιηλ

text_en: and their brethren, Sebenia, Oduia, Celita, Phalaia, Hanan,
text_la: et fratres eorum, Sebenia, Odaia, Celita, Phalaia, Hanan,
text_pt: Mica, Reobe, Hasabias,
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Σαβανια Ωδουια Καλιτα Φελεϊα Αναν

text_en: Micha, Rohob, Hasebia,
text_la: Micha, Rohob, Hasebia,
text_pt: Zacur, Serebias, Sebanias,
text_el: Μιχα Ροωβ Εσεβιας

text_en: Zachur, Serebia, Sabania,
text_la: Zachur, Serebia, Sabania,
text_pt: Hodias, Bani e Beninu.
text_el: Ζαχωρ Σαραβια Σεβανια

text_en: Odaia, Bani, Baninu.
text_la: Odaia, Bani, Baninu.
text_pt: Os chefes do povo: Parós, Paate-Moabe, Elão, Zatu, Bani,
text_el: Ωδουια υἱοὶ Βανουναι

text_en: The heads of the people, Pharos, Phahath Moab , Elam, Zethu, Bani,
text_la: Capita populi, Pharos, Phahathmoab, Ælam, Zethu, Bani,
text_pt: Buni, Azgade, Bebai,
text_el: ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ Φορος Φααθμωαβ Ηλαμ Ζαθουια υἱοὶ

text_en: Bonni, Azgad, Bebai,
text_la: Bonni, Azgad, Bebai,
text_pt: Adonias, Bigvai, Adim,
text_el: Βανι Ασγαδ Βηβαι

text_en: Adonia, Begoai, Adin,
text_la: Adonia, Begoai, Adin,
text_pt: Ater, Ezequias, Azur,
text_el: Εδανια Βαγοι Ηδιν

text_en: Ater, Hezecia, Azur,
text_la: Ater, Hezecia, Azur,
text_pt: Hodias, Hasum, Bezai,
text_el: Ατηρ Εζεκια Αζουρ

text_en: Odaia, Hasum, Besai,
text_la: Odaia, Hasum, Besai,
text_pt: Harife, Anatote, Nebai,
text_el: Οδουια Ησαμ Βησι

text_en: Hareph, Anathoth , Nebai,
text_la: Hareph, Anathoth, Nebai,
text_pt: Magpias, Mesulão, Hezir,
text_el: Αριφ Αναθωθ Νωβαι

text_en: Megphias, Mosollam, Hazir,
text_la: Megphias, Mosollam, Hazir,
text_pt: Mesezabeel, Zadoque, Jadua,
text_el: Μαγαφης Μεσουλαμ Ηζιρ

text_en: Mesizabel, Sadoc, Jeddua,
text_la: Mesizabel, Sadoc, Jeddua,
text_pt: Pelatias, Hanã, Anaías,
text_el: Μεσωζεβηλ Σαδδουκ Ιεδδουα

text_en: Pheltia, Hanan, Anaia,
text_la: Pheltia, Hanan, Anaia,
text_pt: Oséias, Hananias, Hassube,
text_el: Φαλτια Αναν Αναια

text_en: Osee, Hanania, Hasub,
text_la: Osee, Hanania, Hasub,
text_pt: Haloés, Pilha, Sobeque,
text_el: Ωσηε Ανανια Ασουβ

text_en: Alohes, Phalea, Sobec,
text_la: Alohes, Phalea, Sobec,
text_pt: Reum, Hasabná, Maaséias,
text_el: Αλωης Φαλαϊ Σωβηκ

text_en: Rehum, Hasebna, Maasia,
text_la: Rehum, Hasebna, Maasia,
text_pt: E Aías, Hanã, Anã,
text_el: Ραουμ Εσαβανα Μαασαια

text_en: Echaia, Hanan, Anan,
text_la: Echaia, Hanan, Anan,
text_pt: Maluque, Harim e Baaná.
text_el: καὶ Αϊα Αιναν Ηναν

text_en: Melluch, Haran, Baana:
text_la: Melluch, Haran, Baana.
text_pt: E o restante do povo, os sacerdotes, os levitas, os porteiros, os cantores, os servidores do templo, todos os que se tinham separado dos povos das terras para a lei de Deus, suas mulheres, seus filhos e suas filhas, todos os que tinham conhecimento e entendimento,
text_el: Μαλουχ Ηραμ Βαανα

text_en: And the rest of the people, priests , Levites , porters, and singing men , Nathinites , and all that had separated themselves from the people of the lands to the law of God , their wives, their sons, and their daughters.
text_la: Et reliqui de populo, sacerdotes, Levitæ, janitores, et cantores, Nathinæi, et omnes qui se separaverunt de populis terrarum ad legem Dei, uxores eorum, filii eorum, et filiæ eorum,
text_pt: Firmemente aderiram a seus irmãos os mais nobres dentre eles, e convieram num anátema e num juramento, de que andariam na lei de Deus, que foi dada pelo ministério de Moisés, servo de Deus; e de que guardariam e cumpririam todos os mandamentos do Senhor nosso Senhor, e os seus juízos e os seus estatutos;
text_el: καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ Λευῖται οἱ πυλωροί οἱ ᾄδοντες οἱ ναθινιμ καὶ πᾶς ὁ προσπορευόμενος ἀπὸ λαῶν τῆς γῆς πρὸς νόμον τοῦ θεοῦ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν υἱοὶ αὐτῶν θυγατέρες αὐτῶν πᾶς ὁ εἰδὼς καὶ συνίων

text_en: All that could understand, promising for their brethren, with their chief men , and they came to promise, and swear that they would walk in the law of God , which he gave in the hand of Moses the servant of God , that they would do and keep all the commandments of the Lord our God , and his judgments and his ceremonies .
text_la: omnes qui poterant sapere spondentes pro fratribus suis, optimates eorum, et qui veniebant ad pollicendum et jurandum ut ambularent in lege Dei, quam dederat in manu Moysi servi Dei : ut facerent et custodirent universa mandata Domini Dei nostri, et judicia ejus et cæremonias ejus:
text_pt: E que não daríamos as nossas filhas aos povos da terra, nem tomaríamos as filhas deles para os nossos filhos.
text_el: ἐνίσχυον ἐπὶ τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς αὐτῶν κατηράσαντο αὐτοὺς καὶ εἰσήλθοσαν ἐν ἀρᾷ καὶ ἐν ὅρκῳ τοῦ πορεύεσθαι ἐν νόμῳ τοῦ θεοῦ ὃς ἐδόθη ἐν χειρὶ Μωυσῆ δούλου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ φυλάσσεσθαι καὶ ποιεῖν πάσας τὰς ἐντολὰς κυρίου ἡμῶν καὶ κρίματα αὐτοῦ

text_en: And that we would not give our daughters to the people of the land, nor take their daughters for our sons.
text_la: et ut non daremus filias nostras populo terræ, et filias eorum non acciperemus filiis nostris.
text_pt: E que, trazendo os povos da terra no dia de sábado qualquer mercadoria, e qualquer grão para venderem, nada compraríamos deles no sábado, nem no dia santificado; e no sétimo ano deixaríamos descansar a terra, e perdoaríamos toda e qualquer cobrança.
text_el: καὶ τοῦ μὴ δοῦναι θυγατέρας ἡμῶν τοῖς λαοῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ τὰς θυγατέρας αὐτῶν οὐ λημψόμεθα τοῖς υἱοῖς ἡμῶν

text_en: And if the people of the land bring in things to sell, or any things for use, to sell them on the sabbath day , that we would not buy them on the sabbath , or on the holy day. And that we would leave the seventh year, and the exaction of every hand.
text_la: Populi quoque terræ, qui important venalia, et omnia ad usum, per diem sabbati ut vendant, non accipiemus ab eis in sabbato et in die sanctificato. Et dimittemus annum septimum, et exactionem universæ manus.
text_pt: Também sobre nós pusemos preceitos, impondo-nos cada ano a terça parte de um siclo, para o ministério da casa do nosso Deus;
text_el: καὶ λαοὶ τῆς γῆς οἱ φέροντες τοὺς ἀγορασμοὺς καὶ πᾶσαν πρᾶσιν ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου ἀποδόσθαι οὐκ ἀγορῶμεν παρ' αὐτῶν ἐν σαββάτῳ καὶ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ἁγίᾳ καὶ ἀνήσομεν τὸ ἔτος τὸ ἕβδομον καὶ ἀπαίτησιν πάσης χειρός

text_en: And we made ordinances for ourselves, to give the third part of a sicle every year for the work of the house of our God ,
text_la: Et statuemus super nos præcepta, ut demus tertiam partem sicli per annum ad opus domus Dei nostri,
text_pt: Para os pães da proposição, para a contínua oferta de alimentos, e para o contínuo holocausto dos sábados, das luas novas, para as festas solenes, para as coisas sagradas, e para os sacrifícios pelo pecado, para expiação de Israel, e para toda a obra da casa do nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ στήσομεν ἐφ' ἡμᾶς ἐντολὰς δοῦναι ἐφ' ἡμᾶς τρίτον τοῦ διδράχμου κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν εἰς δουλείαν οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: for the loaves of proposition , and for the continual sacrifice , and for a continual holocaust on the sabbaths , on the new moons, on the set feasts, and for the holy things, and for the sin offering : that atonement might be made for Israel , and for every use of the house of our God .
text_la: ad panes propositionis, et ad sacrificium sempiternum, et in holocaustum sempiternum in sabbatis, in calendis, in solemnitatibus, et in sanctificatis, et pro peccato : ut exoretur pro Israël, et in omnem usum domus Dei nostri.
text_pt: Também lançamos sortes entre os sacerdotes, levitas, e o povo, acerca da oferta da lenha que se havia de trazer à casa do nosso Deus, segundo as casas de nossos pais, a tempos determinados, de ano em ano, para se queimar sobre o altar do Senhor nosso Deus, como está escrito na lei.
text_el: εἰς ἄρτους τοῦ προσώπου καὶ θυσίαν τοῦ ἐνδελεχισμοῦ καὶ εἰς ὁλοκαύτωμα τοῦ ἐνδελεχισμοῦ τῶν σαββάτων τῶν νουμηνιῶν εἰς τὰς ἑορτὰς καὶ εἰς τὰ ἅγια καὶ τὰ περὶ ἁμαρτίας ἐξιλάσασθαι περὶ Ισραηλ καὶ εἰς ἔργα οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And we cast lots among the priests , and the Levites , and the people for the offering of wood, that it might be brought into the house of our God by the houses of our fathers at set times, from year to year: to burn upon the altar of the Lord our God , as it is written in the law of Moses :
text_la: Sortes ergo misimus super oblationem lignorum inter sacerdotes, et Levitas, et populum, ut inferrentur in domum Dei nostri per domos patrum nostrorum, per tempora, a temporibus anni usque ad annum : ut arderent super altare Domini Dei nostri, sicut scriptum est in lege Moysi:
text_pt: Que também traríamos as primícias da nossa terra, e as primícias de todos os frutos de todas as árvores, de ano em ano, à casa do Senhor.
text_el: καὶ κλήρους ἐβάλομεν περὶ κλήρου ξυλοφορίας οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ ὁ λαός ἐνέγκαι εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν εἰς οἶκον πατριῶν ἡμῶν εἰς καιροὺς ἀπὸ χρόνων ἐνιαυτὸν κατ' ἐνιαυτόν ἐκκαῦσαι ἐπὶ τὸ θυσιαστήριον κυρίου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ὡς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ

text_en: And that we would bring the firstfruits of our land, and the firstfruits of all fruit of every tree, from year to year, in the house of our Lord .
text_la: et ut afferremus primogenita terræ nostræ, et primitiva universi fructus omnis ligni, ab anno in annum, in domo Domini:
text_pt: E os primogênitos dos nossos filhos, e os do nosso gado, como está escrito na lei; e que os primogênitos do nosso gado e das nossas ovelhas traríamos à casa do nosso Deus, aos sacerdotes, que ministram na casa do nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐνέγκαι τὰ πρωτογενήματα τῆς γῆς ἡμῶν καὶ πρωτογενήματα καρποῦ παντὸς ξύλου ἐνιαυτὸν κατ' ἐνιαυτὸν εἰς οἶκον κυρίου

text_en: And the firstborn of our sons, and of our cattle, as it is written in the law, and the firstlings of our oxen, and of our sheep, to be offered in the house of our God , to the priests who minister in the house of our God .
text_la: et primitiva filiorum nostrorum et pecorum nostrorum, sicut scriptum est in lege, et primitiva boum nostrorum et ovium nostrarum, ut offerrentur in domo Dei nostri, sacerdotibus qui ministrant in domo Dei nostri:
text_pt: E que as primícias da nossa massa, as nossas ofertas alçadas, o fruto de toda a árvore, o mosto e o azeite, traríamos aos sacerdotes, às câmaras da casa do nosso Deus; e os dízimos da nossa terra aos levitas; e que os levitas receberiam os dízimos em todas as cidades, da nossa lavoura.
text_el: καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα υἱῶν ἡμῶν καὶ κτηνῶν ἡμῶν ὡς γέγραπται ἐν τῷ νόμῳ καὶ τὰ πρωτότοκα βοῶν ἡμῶν καὶ ποιμνίων ἡμῶν ἐνέγκαι εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν τοῖς λειτουργοῦσιν ἐν οἴκῳ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And that we would bring the firstfruits of our meats, and of our libations, and the fruit of every tree, of the vintage also and of oil to the priests , to the storehouse of our God , and the tithes of our ground to the Levites . The Levites also shall receive the tithes of our works out of all the cities.
text_la: et primitias ciborum nostrorum, et libaminum nostrorum, et poma omnis ligni, vindemiæ quoque et olei, afferemus sacerdotibus ad gazophylacium Dei nostri, et decimam partem terræ nostræ Levitis. Ipsi Levitæ decimas accipient ex omnibus civitatibus operum nostrorum.
text_pt: E que o sacerdote, filho de Arão, estaria com os levitas quando estes recebessem os dízimos, e que os levitas trariam os dízimos dos dízimos à casa do nosso Deus, às câmaras da casa do tesouro.
text_el: καὶ τὴν ἀπαρχὴν σίτων ἡμῶν καὶ τὸν καρπὸν παντὸς ξύλου οἴνου καὶ ἐλαίου οἴσομεν τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν εἰς γαζοφυλάκιον οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ δεκάτην γῆς ἡμῶν τοῖς Λευίταις καὶ αὐτοὶ οἱ Λευῖται δεκατοῦντες ἐν πάσαις πόλεσιν δουλείας ἡμῶν

text_en: And the priest the son of Aaron shall be with the Levites in the tithes of the Levites , and the Levites shall offer the tithe of their tithes in the house of our God , to the storeroom into the treasure house.
text_la: Erit autem sacerdos filius Aaron cum Levitis in decimis Levitarum, et Levitæ offerent decimam partem decimæ suæ in domo Dei nostri ad gazophylacium in domum thesauri.
text_pt: Porque àquelas câmaras os filhos de Israel e os filhos de Levi devem trazer ofertas alçadas do grão, do mosto e do azeite; porquanto ali estão os vasos do santuário, como também os sacerdotes que ministram, os porteiros e os cantores; e que assim não desampararíamos a casa do nosso Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἔσται ὁ ἱερεὺς υἱὸς Ααρων μετὰ τοῦ Λευίτου ἐν τῇ δεκάτῃ τοῦ Λευίτου καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἀνοίσουσιν τὴν δεκάτην τῆς δεκάτης εἰς οἶκον θεοῦ ἡμῶν εἰς τὰ γαζοφυλάκια εἰς οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: For the children of Israel and the children of Levi shall carry to the treasury the firstfruits of corn, of wine, and of oil: and the sanctified vessels shall be there, and the priests , and the singing men , and the porters, and ministers, and we will not forsake the house of our God .
text_la: Ad gazophylacium enim deportabunt filii Israël, et filii Levi, primitias frumenti, vini, et olei : et ibi erunt vasa sanctificata, et sacerdotes, et cantores, et janitores, et ministri : et non dimittemus domum Dei nostri.
text_el: ὅτι εἰς τοὺς θησαυροὺς εἰσοίσουσιν οἱ υἱοὶ Ισραηλ καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ Λευι τὰς ἀπαρχὰς τοῦ σίτου καὶ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου καὶ ἐκεῖ σκεύη τὰ ἅγια καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς οἱ λειτουργοὶ καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ οὐκ ἐγκαταλείψομεν τὸν οἶκον τοῦ θεοῦ ἡμῶν

text_en: And the princes of the people dwelt at Jerusalem : but the rest of the people cast lots, to take one part in ten to dwell in Jerusalem the holy city, and nine parts in the other cities.
text_la: Habitaverunt autem principes populi in Jerusalem : reliqua vero plebs misit sortem, ut tollerent unam partem de decem qui habitaturi essent in Jerusalem civitate sancta, novem vero partes in civitatibus.
text_pt: E os líderes do povo habitaram em Jerusalém, porém o restante do povo lançou sortes, para tirar um de dez, que habitasse na santa cidade de Jerusalém, e as nove partes nas outras cidades.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισαν οἱ ἄρχοντες τοῦ λαοῦ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ οἱ κατάλοιποι τοῦ λαοῦ ἐβάλοσαν κλήρους ἐνέγκαι ἕνα ἀπὸ τῶν δέκα καθίσαι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ πόλει τῇ ἁγίᾳ καὶ ἐννέα μέρη ἐν ταῖς πόλεσιν

text_en: And the people blessed all the men that willingly offered themselves to dwell in Jerusalem .
text_la: Benedixit autem populus omnibus viris qui se sponte obtulerant ut habitarent in Jerusalem.
text_pt: E o povo bendisse a todos os homens que voluntariamente se ofereciam para habitar em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ εὐλόγησεν ὁ λαὸς τοὺς πάντας ἄνδρας τοὺς ἑκουσιαζομένους καθίσαι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: These therefore are the chief men of the province, who dwelt in Jerusalem , and in the cities of Juda . And every one dwelt in his possession, in their cities: Israel , the priests , the Levites , the Nathinites , and the children of the servants of Solomon .
text_la: Hi sunt itaque principes provinciæ qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, et in civitatibus Juda. Habitavit autem unusquisque in possessione sua, in urbibus suis, Israël, sacerdotes, Levitæ, Nathinæi, et filii servorum Salomonis.
text_pt: E estes são os chefes da província, que habitaram em Jerusalém; porém nas cidades de Judá habitou cada um na sua possessão, nas suas cidades, Israel, os sacerdotes, os levitas, os servidores do templo, e os filhos dos servos de Salomão.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἄρχοντες τῆς χώρας οἳ ἐκάθισαν ἐν Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἐν πόλεσιν Ιουδα ἐκάθισαν ἀνὴρ ἐν κατασχέσει αὐτοῦ ἐν πόλεσιν αὐτῶν Ισραηλ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ ναθιναῖοι καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ δούλων Σαλωμων

text_en: And in Jerusalem there dwelt some of the children of Juda , and some of the children of Benjamin : of the children of Juda , Athaias the son of Aziam, the son of Zacharias, the son of Amarias, the son of Saphatias, the son of Malaleel: of the sons of Phares,
text_la: Et in Jerusalem habitaverunt de filiis Juda, et de filiis Benjamin : de filiis Juda, Athaias filius Aziam, filii Zachariæ, filii Amariæ, filii Saphatiæ, filii Melaleel : de filiis Phares,
text_pt: Habitaram, pois, em Jerusalém alguns dos filhos de Judá e dos filhos de Benjamim. Dos filhos de Judá, Ataías, filho de Uzias, filho de Zacarias, filho de Amarias, filho de Sefatias, filho de Maalaleel, dos filhos de Perez;
text_el: καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἐκάθισαν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιουδα καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Βενιαμιν ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιουδα Αθαια υἱὸς Αζαια υἱὸς Ζαχαρια υἱὸς Αμαρια υἱὸς Σαφατια υἱὸς Μαλεληλ καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Φαρες

text_en: Maasia the son of Baruch, the son of Cholhoza, the son of Hazia, the son of Adaia, the son of Joiarib, the son of Zacharias, the son of the Silonite:
text_la: Maasia filius Baruch, filius Cholhoza, filius Hazia, filius Adaia, filius Jojarib, filius Zachariæ, filius Silonitis:
text_pt: E Maaséias, filho de Baruque, filho de Col-Hoze, filho de Hazaías, filho de Adaías, filho de Joiaribe, filho de Zacarias, filho de Siloni.
text_el: καὶ Μαασια υἱὸς Βαρουχ υἱὸς Χαλαζα υἱὸς Οζια υἱὸς Αδαια υἱὸς Ιωριβ υἱὸς Θηζια υἱὸς τοῦ Σηλωνι

text_en: All these the sons of Phares, who dwelt in Jerusalem , were four hundred sixty-eight valiant men .
text_la: omnes hi filii Phares, qui habitaverunt in Jerusalem, quadringenti sexaginta octo viri fortes.
text_pt: Todos os filhos de Perez, que habitaram em Jerusalém, foram quatrocentos e sessenta e oito homens valentes.
text_el: πάντες υἱοὶ Φαρες οἱ καθήμενοι ἐν Ιερουσαλημ τετρακόσιοι ἑξήκοντα ὀκτὼ ἄνδρες δυνάμεως

text_en: And these are the children of Benjamin : Sellum the son of Mosollam, the son of Joed, the son of Phadaia, the son of Colaia, the son of Masia, the son of Etheel, the son of Isaia.
text_la: Hi sunt autem filii Benjamin : Sellum filius Mosollam, filius Joëd, filius Phadaia, filius Colaia, filius Masia, filius Etheel, filius Isaia,
text_pt: E estes são os filhos de Benjamim: Salu, filho de Mesulão, filho de Joede, filho de Pedaías, filho de Colaías, filho de Maaséias, filho de Itiel, filho de Jesaías.
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν Σηλω υἱὸς Μεσουλαμ υἱὸς Ιωαδ υἱὸς Φαδαια υἱὸς Κωλια υἱὸς Μασαια υἱὸς Αιθιηλ υἱὸς Ιεσια

text_en: And after him Gebbai, Sellai, nine hundred twenty-eight.
text_la: et post eum Gebbai, Sellai, nongenti viginti octo,
text_pt: E depois dele Gabai e Salai, ao todo novecentos e vinte e oito.
text_el: καὶ ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ Γηβι Σηλι ἐννακόσιοι εἴκοσι ὀκτώ

text_en: And Joel the son of Zechri their ruler, and Judas the son of Senua was second over the city.
text_la: et Joël filius Zechri præpositus eorum, et Judas filius Senua super civitatem secundus.
text_pt: E Joel, filho de Zicri, superintendente sobre eles; e Judá, filho de Senua, o segundo sobre a cidade.
text_el: καὶ Ιωηλ υἱὸς Ζεχρι ἐπίσκοπος ἐπ' αὐτούς καὶ Ιουδας υἱὸς Ασανα ἐπὶ τῆς πόλεως δεύτερος

text_en: And of the priests Idaia the son of Joarib, Jachin,
text_la: Et de sacerdotibus, Idaia filius Joarib, Jachin,
text_pt: Dos sacerdotes: Jedaías, filho de Joiaribe, Jaquim,
text_el: ἀπὸ τῶν ἱερέων καὶ Ιαδια υἱὸς Ιωριβ Ιαχιν

text_en: Saraia the son of Helcias, the son of Mosollam, the son of Sadoc, the son of Meraioth, the son of Achitob the prince of the house of God ,
text_la: Saraia filius Helciæ, filius Mosollam, filius Sadoc, filius Meraioth, filius Achitob princeps domus Dei,
text_pt: Seraías, filho de Hilquias, filho de Mesulão, filho de Zadoque, filho de Meraiote, filho de Aitube, líder da casa de Deus,
