text_el: Σαραια υἱὸς Ελκια υἱὸς Μεσουλαμ υἱὸς Σαδδουκ υἱὸς Μαριωθ υἱὸς Αϊτωβ ἀπέναντι οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: and their brethren that do the works of the temple : eight hundred twenty-two. And Adaia the son of Jeroham, the son of Phelelia, the son of Amsi, the son of Zacharias, the son of Pheshur, the son of Melchias,
text_la: et fratres eorum facientes opera templi : octingenti viginti duo. Et Adaia filius Jeroham, filius Phelelia, filius Amsi, filius Zachariæ, filius Pheshur, filius Melchiæ,
text_pt: E seus irmãos, que faziam a obra na casa, oitocentos e vinte e dois; e Adaías, filho de Jeroão, filho de Pelalias, filho de Anzi, filho de Zacarias, filho de Pasur, filho de Malquias,
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ποιοῦντες τὸ ἔργον τοῦ οἴκου Αμασι υἱὸς Ζαχαρια υἱὸς Φασσουρ υἱὸς Μελχια

text_en: and his brethren the chiefs of the fathers: two hundred forty-two. And Amassai the son of Azreel, the son of Ahazi, the son of Mosollamoth, the son of Emmer,
text_la: et fratres ejus principes patrum : ducenti quadraginta duo. Et Amassai filius Azreel, filius Ahazi, filius Mosollamoth, filius Emmer,
text_pt: E seus irmãos, chefes dos pais, duzentos e quarenta e dois; e Amassai, filho de Azareel, filho de Azai, filho de Mesilemote, filho de Imer,
text_el: ἄρχοντες πατριῶν διακόσιοι τεσσαράκοντα δύο καὶ Αμεσσαι υἱὸς Εσδριηλ

text_en: and their brethren who were very mighty, a hundred twenty-eight: and their ruler Zabdiel son of the mighty.
text_la: et fratres eorum potentes nimis : centum viginti octo, et præpositus eorum Zabdiel filius potentium.
text_pt: E os irmãos deles, homens valentes, cento e vinte e oito, e superintendente sobre eles Zabdiel, filho de Gedolim.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ δυνατοὶ παρατάξεως ἑκατὸν εἴκοσι ὀκτώ καὶ ἐπίσκοπος ἐπ' αὐτῶν Βαδιηλ

text_en: And of the Levites Semeia the son of Hasub, the son of Azaricam, the son of Hasabia, the son of Boni,
text_la: Et de Levitis, Semeia filius Hasub, filius Azaricam, filius Hasabia, filius Boni,
text_pt: E dos levitas: Semaías, filho de Hassube, filho de Azricão, filho de Hasabias, filho de Buni;
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευιτῶν Σαμαια υἱὸς Ασουβ υἱὸς Εζρι

text_en: and Sabathai and Jozabed, who were over all the outward business of the house of God , of the princes of the Levites ,
text_la: et Sabathai et Jozabed, super omnia opera quæ erant forinsecus in domo Dei, a principibus Levitarum.
text_pt: E Sabetai, e Jozabade, dos chefes dos levitas, presidiam sobre a obra de fora da casa de Deus.

text_en: and Mathania the son of Micha, the son of Zebedei, the son of Asaph, was the principal man to praise, and to give glory in prayer , and Becbecia, the second, one of his brethren, and Abda the son of Samua, the son of Galal, the son of Idithun.
text_la: Et Mathania filius Micha, filius Zebedei, filius Asaph, princeps ad laudandum et ad confitendum in oratione, et Becbecia secundus de fratribus ejus, et Abda filius Samua, filius Galal, filius Idithun:
text_pt: E Matanias, filho de Mica, filho de Zabdi, filho de Asafe, o chefe, que iniciava as ações de graças na oração, e Bacbuquias, o segundo de seus irmãos; depois Abda, filho de Samua, filho de Galal, filho de Jedutum.
text_el: καὶ Μαθανια υἱὸς Μιχα καὶ Ωβηδ υἱὸς Σαμουι

text_en: All the Levites in the holy city were two hundred eighty-four.
text_la: omnes Levitæ in civitate sancta ducenti octoginta quatuor.
text_pt: Todos os levitas na santa cidade, foram duzentos e oitenta e quatro.
text_el: διακόσιοι ὀγδοήκοντα τέσσαρες

text_en: And the porters, Accub, Telmon, and their brethren, who kept the doors: a hundred seventy-two.
text_la: Et janitores, Accub, Telmon, et fratres eorum, qui custodiebant ostia : centum septuaginta duo.
text_pt: E os porteiros, Acube, Talmom, com seus irmãos, os guardas das portas, cento e setenta e dois.
text_el: καὶ οἱ πυλωροὶ Ακουβ Τελαμιν καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἑκατὸν ἑβδομήκοντα δύο

text_en: And the rest of Israel , the priests and the Levites were in all the cities of Juda , every man in his possession.
text_la: Et reliqui ex Israël sacerdotes et Levitæ in universis civitatibus Juda, unusquisque in possessione sua.
text_pt: E o restante de Israel, dos sacerdotes e levitas, habitou em todas as cidades de Judá, cada um na sua herança.

text_en: And the Nathinites , that dwelt in Ophel, and Siaha, and Gaspha of the Nathinites .
text_la: Et Nathinæi, qui habitabant in Ophel, et Siaha, et Gaspha de Nathinæis.
text_pt: E os servidores do templo, habitaram em Ofel; e Zia e Gispa presidiam sobre os servidores do templo.

text_en: And the overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem , was Azzi the son of Bani, the son of Hasabia, the son of Mathania, the son of Micha. Of the sons of Asaph, were the singing men in the ministry of the house of God .
text_la: Et episcopus Levitarum in Jerusalem, Azzi filius Bani, filius Hasabiæ, filius Mathaniæ, filius Michæ. De filiis Asaph, cantores in ministerio domus Dei.
text_pt: E o superintendente dos levitas em Jerusalém foi Uzi, filho de Bani, filho de Hasabias, filho de Matanias, filho de Mica; dos filhos de Asafe, os cantores, ao serviço da casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἐπίσκοπος Λευιτῶν υἱὸς Βανι Οζι υἱὸς Ασαβια υἱὸς Μιχα ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ασαφ τῶν ᾀδόντων ἀπέναντι ἔργου οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: For the king's commandment was concerning them, and an order among the singing men day by day.
text_la: Præceptum quippe regis super eos erat, et ordo in cantoribus per dies singulos,
text_pt: Porque havia um mandado do rei acerca deles, e uma certa regra para os cantores, cada qual no seu dia.
text_el: ὅτι ἐντολὴ τοῦ βασιλέως ἐπ' αὐτούς

text_en: And Phathahia the son of Mesezebel of the children of Zara the son of Juda was at the hand of the king, in all matters concerning the people,
text_la: et Phathahia filius Mesezebel, de filiis Zara filii Juda in manu regis, juxta omne verbum populi,
text_pt: E Petaías, filho de Mesezabeel, dos filhos de Zerá, filho de Judá, estava à mão do rei, em todos os negócios do povo.
text_el: καὶ Παθαια υἱὸς Βασηζα πρὸς χεῖρα τοῦ βασιλέως εἰς πᾶν ῥῆμα τῷ λαῷ

text_en: and in the houses through all their countries. Of the children of Juda some dwelt at Cariath-Arbe, and in the villages thereof: and at Dibon , and in the villages thereof: and at Cabseel, and in the villages thereof.
text_la: et in domibus per omnes regiones eorum. De filiis Juda habitaverunt in Cariatharbe et in filiabus ejus : et in Dibon, et in filiabus ejus : et in Cabseel, et in viculis ejus:
text_pt: E quanto às aldeias, com as suas terras, alguns dos filhos de Judá habitaram em Quiriate-Arba e nos lugares da sua jurisdição, e em Dibom, e nos lugares da sua jurisdição, e em Jecabzeel e nas suas aldeias,
text_el: καὶ πρὸς τὰς ἐπαύλεις ἐν ἀγρῷ αὐτῶν καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιουδα ἐκάθισαν ἐν Καριαθαρβοκ

text_en: And at Jesue, and at Molada, and at Bethphaleth,
text_la: et in Jesue, et in Molada, et in Bethphaleth,
text_pt: E em Jesuá, e em Molada, e em Bete-Pelete,
text_el: καὶ ἐν Ιησου

text_en: and at Hasersuel, and at Bersabee , and in the villages thereof,
text_la: et in Hasersual, et in Bersabee, et in filiabus ejus,
text_pt: E em Hazar-Sual, e em Berseba e nos lugares da sua jurisdição,
text_el: καὶ ἐν Βεηρσαβεε

text_en: and at Siceleg, and at Mochona, and in the villages thereof,
text_la: et in Siceleg, et in Mochona, et in filiabus ejus,
text_pt: E em Ziclague, em Mecona e nos lugares da sua jurisdição,

text_en: and at Remmon, and at Saraa, and at Jerimuth,
text_la: et in Remmon, et in Saraa, et in Jerimuth,
text_pt: E em En-Rimom, em Zorá e em Jarmute,

text_en: Zanoa, Odollam , and in their villages , at Lachis and its dependencies, and at Azeca and the villages thereof. And they dwelt from Bersabee unto the valley of Ennom.
text_la: Zanoa, Odollam, et in villis earum, Lachis et regionibus ejus, et Azeca, et filiabus ejus. Et manserunt in Bersabee usque ad vallem Ennom.
text_pt: Em Zanoa, Adulão e nas suas aldeias, em Laquis e nas suas terras, em Azaca e nos lugares da sua jurisdição. Acamparam-se desde Berseba até ao vale de Hinom.
text_el: καὶ ἐπαύλεις αὐτῶν Λαχις καὶ ἀγροὶ αὐτῆς καὶ παρενεβάλοσαν ἐν Βεηρσαβεε

text_en: And the children of Benjamin , from Geba, at Mechmas, and at Hai, and at Bethel , and in the villages thereof,
text_la: Filii autem Benjamin, a Geba, Mechmas, et Hai, et Bethel, et filiabus ejus
text_pt: E os filhos de Benjamim habitaram desde Geba, em Micmás, Aia, Betel e nos lugares da sua jurisdição,
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ Βενιαμιν ἀπὸ Γαβα Μαχαμας

text_en: at Anathoth , Nob, Anania,
text_la: Anathoth, Nob, Anania,
text_pt: E em Anatote, em Nobe, em Ananias,

text_en: Asor, Rama, Gethaim,
text_la: Asor, Rama, Gethaim,
text_pt: Em Hazor, em Ramá, em Gitaim,

text_en: Hadid, Seboim, and Neballat, Lod,
text_la: Hadid, Seboim, et Neballat, Lod,
text_pt: Em Hadide, em Zeboim, em Nebalate,

text_en: and Ono the valley of craftsmen.
text_la: et Ono valle artificum.
text_pt: Em Lode e em Ono, no vale dos artífices,

text_en: And of the Levites were portions of Juda and Benjamin .
text_la: Et de Levitis portiones Judæ et Benjamin.
text_pt: E alguns dos levitas habitaram nas divisões de Judá e de Benjamim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν Λευιτῶν μερίδες Ιουδα τῷ Βενιαμιν

text_en: Now these are the priests and the Levites , that went up with Zorobabel the son of Salathiel, and Josue: Saraia, Jeremiah , Esdras ,
text_la: Hi sunt autem sacerdotes et Levitæ, qui ascenderunt cum Zorobabel filio Salathiel, et Josue : Saraia, Jeremias, Esdras,
text_pt: Estes são sacerdotes e levitas que subiram com Zorobabel, filho de Sealtiel, e com Jesuá: Seraías, Jeremias, Esdras,
text_el: καὶ οὗτοι οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται οἱ ἀναβαίνοντες μετὰ Ζοροβαβελ υἱοῦ Σαλαθιηλ καὶ Ἰησοῦ Σαραια Ιερμια Εσδρα

text_en: Amaria, Melluch, Hattus,
text_la: Amaria, Melluch, Hattus,
text_pt: Amarias, Maluque, Hatus,
text_el: Αμαρια Μαλουχ

text_en: Sebenias, Rheum, Merimuth,
text_la: Sebenias, Rheum, Merimuth,
text_pt: Secanias, Reum, Meremote,
text_el: Σεχενια

text_en: Addo, Genthon, Abia,
text_la: Addo, Genthon, Abia,
text_pt: Ido, Ginetoi, Abias,

text_en: Miamin, Madia , Belga,
text_la: Miamin, Madia, Belga,
text_pt: Miamim, Maadias, Bilga,

text_en: Semeia, and Joiarib, Idaia, Sellum Amoc, Helcias,
text_la: Semeia, et Jojarib, Idaia, Sellum, Amoc, Helcias,
text_pt: Semaías, Joiaribe, Jedaías,

text_en: Idaia. These were the chief of the priests , and of their brethren in the days of Josue.
text_la: Idaia. Isti principes sacerdotum, et fratres eorum in diebus Josue.
text_pt: Salu, Amoque, Hilquias, Jedaías; estes foram os chefes dos sacerdotes e de seus irmãos, nos dias de Jesuá.
text_el: οὗτοι ἄρχοντες τῶν ἱερέων καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν ἐν ἡμέραις Ἰησοῦ

text_en: And the Levites , Jesua, Bennui, Cedmihel, Sarebia, Juda , Mathanias, they and their brethren were over the hymns:
text_la: Porro Levitæ, Jesua, Bennui, Cedmihel, Sarebia, Juda, Mathanias, super hymnos ipsi et fratres eorum:
text_pt: E os levitas: Jesuá, Binui, Cadmiel, Serebias, Judá, Matanias; este e seus irmãos dirigiam os louvores.
text_el: καὶ οἱ Λευῖται Ιησου Βανουι Καδμιηλ Σαραβια Ιουδα Μαχανια ἐπὶ τῶν χειρῶν αὐτὸς καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ

text_en: And Becbecia, and Hanni, and their brethren every one in his office.
text_la: et Becbecia atque Hanni, et fratres eorum, unusquisque in officio suo.
text_pt: E Bacbuquias e Uni, seus irmãos, estavam defronte deles, nas guardas.
text_el: εἰς τὰς ἐφημερίας

text_en: And Josue begot Joacim, and Joacim begot Eliasib, and Eliasib begot Joiada,
text_la: Josue autem genuit Joacim, et Joacim genuit Eliasib, et Eliasib genuit Jojada,
text_pt: E Jesuá gerou a Joiaquim, e Joiaquim gerou a Eliasibe, e Eliasibe gerou a Joiada,
text_el: καὶ Ἰησοῦς ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωακιμ καὶ Ιωακιμ ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ελιασιβ καὶ Ελιασιβ τὸν Ιωδαε

text_en: and Joiada begot Jonathan and Jonathan begot Jeddoa.
text_la: et Jojada genuit Jonathan, et Jonathan genuit Jeddoa.
text_pt: E Joiada gerou a Jônatas, e Jônatas gerou a Jadua.
text_el: καὶ Ιωδαε ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιωναθαν καὶ Ιωναθαν ἐγέννησεν τὸν Ιαδου

text_en: And in the days of Joacim the priests and heads of the families were: Of Saraia, Maraia: of Jeremiah , Hanania:
text_la: In diebus autem Joacim erant sacerdotes et principes familiarum : Saraiæ, Maraia : Jeremiæ, Hanania:
text_pt: E nos dias de Joiaquim foram sacerdotes, chefes dos pais: de Seraías, Meraías; de Jeremias, Hananias;
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Ιωακιμ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν τῷ Σαραια Μαραια τῷ Ιερμια Ανανια

text_en: Of Esdras , Mosollam: and of Amaria, Johanan:
text_la: Esdræ, Mosollam : Amariæ, Johanan:
text_pt: De Esdras, Mesulão; de Amarias, Joanã;
text_el: τῷ Εσδρα Μεσουλαμ τῷ Αμαρια Ιωαναν

text_en: Of Milicho, Jonathan : of Sebenia, Joseph:
text_la: Milicho, Jonathan : Sebeniæ, Joseph:
text_pt: De Maluqui, Jônatas; de Sebanias, José;
text_el: τῷ Μαλουχ Ιωναθαν τῷ Σεχενια Ιωσηφ

text_en: Of Haram, Edna: of Maraioth, Helci:
text_la: Haram, Edna : Maraioth, Helci:
text_pt: De Harim, Adna; de Meraiote, Helcai;
text_el: τῷ Αρεμ Αδνας τῷ Μαριωθ Ελκαι

text_en: Of Adaia, Zacharia: of Genthon, Mosollam:
text_la: Adaiæ, Zacharia : Genthon, Mosollam:
text_pt: De Ido, Zacarias; de Ginetom, Mesulão.
text_el: τῷ Αδδαι Ζαχαριας τῷ Γαναθων Μοσολλαμ

text_en: Of Abia, Zechri: of Miamin and Moadia, Phelti:
text_la: Abiæ, Zechri : Miamin et Moadiæ, Phelti:
text_pt: De Abias, Zicri; de Miamim e de Moadias, Piltai;
text_el: τῷ Αβια Ζεχρι τῷ Βενιαμιν ἐν καιροῖς τῷ Φελητι

text_en: Of Belga, Sammua of Semaia, Jonathan :
text_la: Belgæ, Sammua : Semaiæ, Jonathan:
text_pt: De Bilga, Samua; de Semaías, Jônatas;
text_el: τῷ Βαλγα Σαμουε τῷ Σεμεια Ιωναθαν

text_en: Of Joiarib, Mathanai: of Jodaia, Azzi:
text_la: Jojarib, Mathanai : Jodaiæ, Azzi:
text_pt: E de Joiaribe, Matenai; de Jedaías, Uzi;
text_el: τῷ Ιωιαριβ Μαθθαναι τῷ Ιδια Οζι

text_en: Of Sellai, Celai: of Amoc, Heber:
text_la: Sellai, Celai : Amoc, Heber:
text_pt: De Salai, Calai; de Amoque, Éber;
text_el: τῷ Σαλλαι Καλλαι τῷ Αμουκ Αβεδ

text_en: Of Helcias, Hasebia: of Idaia, Nathanael.
text_la: Helciæ, Hasebia : Idaiæ, Nathanaël.
text_pt: De Hilquias, Hasabias; de Jedaías, Natanael.
text_el: τῷ Ελκια Ασαβιας τῷ Ιεδεϊου Ναθαναηλ

text_en: The Levites the chiefs of the families in the days of Eliasib, and Joiada, and Johanan, and Jeddoa, were recorded, and the priests in the reign of Darius the Persian.
text_la: Levitæ in diebus Eliasib, et Jojada, et Johanan, et Jeddoa, scripti principes familiarum, et sacerdotes in regno Darii Persæ.
text_pt: Dos levitas, nos dias de Eliasibe, foram inscritos como chefes de pais, Joiada, Joanã e Jadua; como também os sacerdotes, até ao reinado de Dario, o persa.
text_el: οἱ Λευῖται ἐν ἡμέραις Ελιασιβ Ιωαδα καὶ Ιωαναν καὶ Ιδουα γεγραμμένοι ἄρχοντες πατριῶν καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς ἐν βασιλείᾳ Δαρείου τοῦ Πέρσου

text_en: The sons of Levi , heads of the families were written in the book of Chronicles, even unto the days of Jonathan the son of Eliasib.
text_la: Filii Levi principes familiarum, scripti in libro verborum dierum, et usque ad dies Jonathan, filii Eliasib.
text_pt: Os filhos de Levi foram inscritos, como chefes de pais, no livro das crônicas, até aos dias de Joanã, filho de Eliasibe.
text_el: υἱοὶ Λευι ἄρχοντες τῶν πατριῶν γεγραμμένοι ἐπὶ βιβλίῳ λόγων τῶν ἡμερῶν καὶ ἕως ἡμερῶν Ιωαναν υἱοῦ Ελισουβ

text_en: Now the chief of the Levites were Hasebia, Serebia, and Josue the son of Cedmihel: and their brethren by their courses, to praise and to give thanks according to the commandment of David the man of God , and to wait equally in order.
text_la: Et principes Levitarum, Hasebia, Serebia, et Josue filius Cedmihel : et fratres eorum per vices suas, ut laudarent et confiterentur juxta præceptum David viri Dei, et observarent æque per ordinem.
text_pt: Foram, pois, os chefes dos levitas: Hasabias, Serabias, e Jesuá, filho de Cadmiel; e seus irmãos estavam defronte deles, para louvarem e darem graças, segundo o mandado de Davi, homem de Deus; guarda contra guarda.
text_el: καὶ ἄρχοντες τῶν Λευιτῶν Ασαβια καὶ Σαραβια καὶ Ιησου καὶ υἱοὶ Καδμιηλ καὶ οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτῶν κατεναντίον αὐτῶν εἰς ὑμνεῖν καὶ αἰνεῖν ἐν ἐντολῇ Δαυιδ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ ἐφημερία πρὸς ἐφημερίαν

text_en: Mathania, and Becbecia, Obedia, and Mosollam, Telmon, Accub, were keepers of the gates and of the entrances before the gates.
text_la: Mathania, et Becbecia, Obedia, Mosollam, Telmon, Accub, custodes portarum et vestibulorum ante portas.
text_pt: Matanias, Bacbuquias, Obadias, Mesulão, Talmom e Acube, eram porteiros, que faziam a guarda às tesourarias das portas.
text_el: ἐν τῷ συναγαγεῖν με τοὺς πυλωροὺς

text_en: These were in the days of Joacim the son of Josue, the son of Josedec, and in the days of Nehemias the governor, and of Esdras the priest and scribe .
text_la: Hi in diebus Joacim filii Josue, filii Josedec, et in diebus Nehemiæ ducis, et Esdræ sacerdotis scribæque.
text_pt: Estes viveram nos dias de Jeoiaquim, filho de Jesuá, o filho de Jozadaque; como também nos dias de Neemias, o governador, e do sacerdote Esdras, o escriba.
text_el: ἐν ἡμέραις Ιωακιμ υἱοῦ Ἰησοῦ υἱοῦ Ιωσεδεκ καὶ ἐν ἡμέραις Νεεμια καὶ Εσδρας ὁ ἱερεὺς ὁ γραμματεύς

text_en: And at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem they sought the Levites out of all their places, to bring them to Jerusalem , and to keep the dedication , and to rejoice with thanksgiving, and with singing, and with cymbals, and psalteries and harps.
text_la: In dedicatione autem muri Jerusalem, requisierunt Levitas de omnibus locis suis ut adducerent eos in Jerusalem, et facerent dedicationem et lætitiam in actione gratiarum, et cantico, et in cymbalis, psalteriis, et citharis.
text_pt: E na dedicação dos muros de Jerusalém buscaram os levitas de todos os seus lugares, para trazê-los, a fim de fazerem a dedicação com alegria, com louvores e com canto, saltérios, címbalos e com harpas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ἐγκαινίοις τείχους Ιερουσαλημ ἐζήτησαν τοὺς Λευίτας ἐν τοῖς τόποις αὐτῶν τοῦ ἐνέγκαι αὐτοὺς εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ποιῆσαι ἐγκαίνια καὶ εὐφροσύνην ἐν θωδαθα καὶ ἐν ᾠδαῖς κυμβαλίζοντες καὶ ψαλτήρια καὶ κινύραι

text_en: And the sons of the singing men were gathered together out of the plain country about Jerusalem , and out of the villages of Nethuphati,
text_la: Congregati sunt autem filii cantorum de campestribus circa Jerusalem, et de villis Nethuphathi,
text_pt: E assim ajuntaram os filhos dos cantores, tanto da campina dos arredores de Jerusalém, como das aldeias de Netofati;
text_el: καὶ συνήχθησαν οἱ υἱοὶ τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ ἀπὸ τῆς περιχώρου κυκλόθεν εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ ἀπὸ ἐπαύλεων

text_en: and from the house of Galgal, and from the countries of Geba and Azmaveth: for the singing men had built themselves villages round about Jerusalem .
text_la: et de domo Galgal, et de regionibus Geba et Azmaveth : quoniam villas ædificaverunt sibi cantores in circuitu Jerusalem.
text_pt: Como também da casa de Gilgal, e dos campos de Geba, e Azmavete; porque os cantores edificaram para si aldeias nos arredores de Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ ἀγρῶν ὅτι ἐπαύλεις ᾠκοδόμησαν ἑαυτοῖς οἱ ᾄδοντες ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And the priests and the Levites were purified, and they purified the people, and the gates, and the wall.
text_la: Et mundati sunt sacerdotes et Levitæ, et mundaverunt populum, et portas, et murum.
text_pt: E purificaram-se os sacerdotes e os levitas; e logo purificaram o povo, as portas e o muro.
text_el: καὶ ἐκαθαρίσθησαν οἱ ἱερεῖς καὶ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ ἐκαθάρισαν τὸν λαὸν καὶ τοὺς πυλωροὺς καὶ τὸ τεῖχος

text_en: And I made the princes of Juda go up upon the wall, and I appointed two great choirs to give praise. And they went on the right hand upon the wall toward the dung gate.
text_la: Ascendere autem feci principes Juda super murum, et statui duos magnos choros laudantium. Et ierunt ad dexteram super murum ad portam sterquilinii.
text_pt: Então fiz subir os príncipes de Judá sobre o muro, e ordenei dois grandes coros em procissão, um à mão direita sobre o muro do lado da porta do monturo.
text_el: καὶ ἀνήνεγκα τοὺς ἄρχοντας Ιουδα ἐπάνω τοῦ τείχους καὶ ἔστησα δύο περὶ αἰνέσεως μεγάλους καὶ διῆλθον ἐκ δεξιῶν ἐπάνω τοῦ τείχους τῆς κοπρίας

text_en: And after them went Osaias, and half of the princes of Juda ,
text_la: Et ivit post eos Osaias, et media pars principum Juda,
text_pt: E após ele ia Hosaías, e a metade dos príncipes de Judá.
text_el: καὶ ἐπορεύθη ὀπίσω αὐτῶν Ωσαια καὶ ἥμισυ ἀρχόντων Ιουδα

text_en: and Azarias, Esdras , and Mosollam,
text_la: et Azarias, Esdras, et Mosollam,
text_pt: E Azarias, Esdras e Mesulão,
text_el: καὶ Αζαριας Εσδρας καὶ Μεσουλαμ

text_en: Judas, and Benjamin, and Semeia, and Jeremiah .
text_la: Judas, et Benjamin, et Semeia, et Jeremias.
text_pt: Judá, Benjamim, Semaías e Jeremias.
text_el: Ιουδα καὶ Βενιαμιν καὶ Σαμαια καὶ Ιερμια

text_en: And of the sons of the priests with trumpets, Zacharias the son of Jonathan , the son of Semeia, the son of Mathania, the son of Michaia, the son of Zechur, the son of Asaph,
text_la: Et de filiis sacerdotum in tubis, Zacharias filius Jonathan, filius Semeiæ, filius Mathaniæ, filius Michaiæ, filius Zechur, filius Asaph,
text_pt: E dos filhos dos sacerdotes, com trombetas: Zacarias, filho de Jônatas, filho de Semaías, filho de Matanias, filho de Micaías, filho de Zacur, filho de Asafe.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν τῶν ἱερέων ἐν σάλπιγξιν Ζαχαριας υἱὸς Ιωναθαν υἱὸς Σαμαια υἱὸς Μαθανια υἱὸς Μιχαια υἱὸς Ζακχουρ υἱὸς Ασαφ

text_en: and his brethren Semeia, and Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanael, and Judas, and Hanani, with the musical instruments of David the man of God : and Esdras the scribe before them at the fountain gate.
text_la: et fratres ejus Semeia, et Azareel, Malalai, Galalai, Maai, Nathanaël, et Judas, et Hanani, in vasis cantici David viri Dei : et Esdras scriba ante eos in porta fontis.
text_pt: E seus irmãos, Semaías, e Azareel, Milalai, Gilalai, Maai, Natanael, Judá e Hanani, com os instrumentos musicais de Davi, homem de Deus; e Esdras, o escriba, ia adiante deles.
text_el: καὶ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ Σαμαια καὶ Οζιηλ αἰνεῖν ἐν ᾠδαῖς Δαυιδ ἀνθρώπου τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ Εσδρας ὁ γραμματεὺς ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν

text_en: And they went up over against them by the stairs of the city of David, at the going up of the wall of the house of David , and to the water gate eastward:
text_la: Et contra eos ascenderunt in gradibus civitatis David in ascensu muri super domum David, et usque ad portam aquarum ad orientem.
text_pt: Indo assim para a porta da fonte, defronte deles, subiram as escadas da cidade de Davi, onde começa a subida do muro, desde cima da casa de Davi, até à porta das águas, do lado do oriente.
text_el: ἐπὶ πύλης τοῦ αιν κατέναντι αὐτῶν ἀνέβησαν ἐπὶ κλίμακας πόλεως Δαυιδ ἐν ἀναβάσει τοῦ τείχους ἐπάνωθεν τοῦ οἴκου Δαυιδ καὶ ἕως πύλης τοῦ ὕδατος κατὰ ἀνατολάς

text_en: And the second choir of them that gave thanks went on the opposite side, and I after them, and the half of the people upon the wall, and upon the tower of the furnaces, even to the broad wall,
text_la: Et chorus secundus gratias referentium ibat ex adverso, et ego post eum, et media pars populi super murum, et super turrim furnorum, et usque ad murum latissimum,
text_pt: E o segundo coro ia em frente, e eu após ele; e a metade do povo ia sobre o muro, desde a torre dos fornos, até à muralha larga;
text_el: καὶ περὶ αἰνέσεως ἡ δευτέρα ἐπορεύετο συναντῶσα αὐτοῖς καὶ ἐγὼ ὀπίσω αὐτῆς καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τοῦ λαοῦ ἐπάνω τοῦ τείχους ὑπεράνω τοῦ πύργου τῶν θεννουριμ καὶ ἕως τοῦ τείχους τοῦ πλατέος

text_en: and above the gate of Ephraim, and above the old gate, and above the fish gate and the tower of Hananeel, and the tower of Emath, and even to the flock gate: and they stood still in the watch gate.
text_la: et super portam Ephraim, et super portam antiquam, et super portam piscium et turrim Hananeel, et turrim Emath, et usque ad portam gregis : et steterunt in porta custodiæ,
text_pt: E desde a porta de Efraim, passaram por cima da porta velha, e da porta do peixe, e pela torre de Hananeel e a torre de Meá, até à porta do gado; e pararam à porta da prisão.
text_el: καὶ ὑπεράνω τῆς πύλης Εφραιμ καὶ ἐπὶ πύλην τῆς ισανα καὶ ἐπὶ πύλην τὴν ἰχθυηρὰν καὶ πύργῳ Ανανεηλ καὶ ἕως πύλης τῆς προβατικῆς καὶ ἔστησαν ἐν πύλῃ τῆς φυλακῆς

text_en: And the two choirs of them that gave praise stood still at the house of God , and I and the half of the magistrates with me.
text_la: steteruntque duo chori laudantium in domo Dei, et ego, et dimidia pars magistratuum mecum.
text_pt: Então ambos os coros pararam na casa de Deus; como também eu, e a metade dos magistrados comigo.
text_el: καὶ ἔστησαν αἱ δύο τῆς αἰνέσεως ἐν οἴκῳ τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ ἐγὼ καὶ τὸ ἥμισυ τῶν στρατηγῶν μετ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: And the priests , Eliachim, Maasia, Miamin, Michea, Elioenai, Zacharia, Hanania with trumpets,
text_la: Et sacerdotes, Eliachim, Maasia, Miamin, Michea, Elioënai, Zacharia, Hanania in tubis,
text_pt: E os sacerdotes Eliaquim, Maaséias, Miniamim, Micaías, Elioenai, Zacarias e Hananias, com trombetas.
text_el: καὶ οἱ ἱερεῖς Ελιακιμ Μαασιας Βενιαμιν Μιχαιας Ελιωηναι Ζαχαριας Ανανιας ἐν σάλπιγξιν

text_en: and Maasia, and Semeia, and Eleazar , and Azzi, and Johanan, and Melchia, and Elam, and Ezer. And the singers sung loud, and Jezraia was their overseer:
text_la: et Maasia, et Semeia, et Eleazar, et Azzi, et Johanan, et Melchia, et Ælam, et Ezer. Et clare cecinerunt cantores, et Jezraia præpositus:
text_pt: Como também, Maaséias, Semaías, Eleazar, Uzi, Joanã, Malquias, Elão e Ezer; e faziam-se ouvir os cantores, juntamente com Jezraías, o seu superintendente.
text_el: καὶ Μαασιας καὶ Σεμειας καὶ Ελεαζαρ καὶ Οζι καὶ Ιωαναν καὶ Μελχιας καὶ Αιλαμ καὶ Εζουρ καὶ ἠκούσθησαν οἱ ᾄδοντες καὶ ἐπεσκέπησαν

text_en: And they sacrificed on that day great sacrifices , and they rejoiced: for God had made them joyful with great joy : their wives also and their children rejoiced, and the joy of Jerusalem was heard afar off.
text_la: et immolaverunt in die illa victimas magnas, et lætati sunt : Deus enim lætificaverat eos lætitia magna : sed et uxores eorum et liberi gavisi sunt, et audita est lætitia Jerusalem procul.
text_pt: E ofereceram, no mesmo dia, grandes sacrifícios e se alegraram; porque Deus os alegrara com grande alegria; e até as mulheres e os meninos se alegraram, de modo que a alegria de Jerusalém se ouviu até de longe.
text_el: καὶ ἔθυσαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ θυσιάσματα μεγάλα καὶ ηὐφράνθησαν ὅτι ὁ θεὸς ηὔφρανεν αὐτοὺς μεγάλως καὶ αἱ γυναῖκες αὐτῶν καὶ τὰ τέκνα αὐτῶν ηὐφράνθησαν καὶ ἠκούσθη ἡ εὐφροσύνη ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ἀπὸ μακρόθεν

text_en: They appointed also in that day men over the storehouses of the treasure, for the libations, and for the firstfruits , and for the tithes , that the rulers of the city might bring them in by them in honour of thanksgiving, for the priests and Levites : for Juda was joyful in the priests and Levites that assisted.
text_la: Recensuerunt quoque in die illa viros super gazophylacia thesauri ad libamina, et ad primitias, et ad decimas, ut introferrent per eos principes civitatis in decore gratiarum actionis, sacerdotes et Levitas : quia lætificatus est Juda in sacerdotibus et Levitis adstantibus.
text_pt: Também no mesmo dia se nomearam homens sobre as câmaras, dos tesouros, das ofertas alçadas, das primícias, dos dízimos, para ajuntarem nelas, dos campos das cidades, as partes da lei para os sacerdotes e para os levitas; porque Judá estava alegre por causa dos sacerdotes e dos levitas que assistiam ali.
text_el: καὶ κατέστησαν ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἄνδρας ἐπὶ τῶν γαζοφυλακίων τοῖς θησαυροῖς ταῖς ἀπαρχαῖς καὶ ταῖς δεκάταις καὶ τοῖς συνηγμένοις ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄρχουσιν τῶν πόλεων μερίδας τοῖς ἱερεῦσι καὶ τοῖς Λευίταις ὅτι εὐφροσύνη ἦν ἐν Ιουδα ἐπὶ τοὺς ἱερεῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς Λευίτας τοὺς ἑστῶτας

text_en: And they kept the watch of their God , and the observance of expiation, and the singing men , and the porters, according to the commandment of David , and of Solomon his son.
text_la: Et custodierunt observationem Dei sui, et observationem expiationis, et cantores, et janitores juxta præceptum David, et Salomonis filii ejus,
text_pt: E observava os preceitos do seu Deus, e os da purificação; como também os cantores e porteiros, conforme ao mandado de Davi e de seu filho Salomão.
text_el: καὶ ἐφύλαξαν φυλακὰς θεοῦ αὐτῶν καὶ φυλακὰς τοῦ καθαρισμοῦ καὶ τοὺς ᾄδοντας καὶ τοὺς πυλωροὺς ὡς ἐντολαὶ Δαυιδ καὶ Σαλωμων υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ

text_en: For in the days of David and Asaph from the beginning there were chief singers appointed, to praise with canticles, and give thanks to God .
text_la: quia in diebus David et Asaph ab exordio erant principes constituti cantorum in carmine laudantium et confitentium Deo.
text_pt: Porque já nos dias de Davi e Asafe, desde a antiguidade, havia chefes dos cantores, e dos cânticos de louvores e de ação de graças a Deus.
text_el: ὅτι ἐν ἡμέραις Δαυιδ Ασαφ ἀπ' ἀρχῆς πρῶτος τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ ὕμνον καὶ αἴνεσιν τῷ θεῷ

text_en: And all Israel , in the days of Zorobabel, and in the days of Nehemias gave portions to the singing men , and to the porters, day by day, and they sanctified the Levites , and the Levites sanctified the sons of Aaron .
text_la: Et omnis Israël in diebus Zorobabel et in diebus Nehemiæ, dabant partes cantoribus et janitoribus per dies singulos, et sanctificabant Levitas, et Levitæ sanctificabant filios Aaron.
text_pt: Por isso todo o Israel, já nos dias de Zorobabel e nos dias de Neemias, dava aos cantores e aos porteiros as porções de cada dia; e santificavam as porções aos levitas, e os levitas as santificavam aos filhos de Arão.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ισραηλ ἐν ἡμέραις Ζοροβαβελ διδόντες μερίδας τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ τῶν πυλωρῶν λόγον ἡμέρας ἐν ἡμέρᾳ αὐτοῦ καὶ ἁγιάζοντες τοῖς Λευίταις καὶ οἱ Λευῖται ἁγιάζοντες τοῖς υἱοῖς Ααρων

text_en: And on that day they read in the book of Moses in the hearing of the people: and therein was found written, that the Ammonites and the Moabites should not come in to the church of God for ever:
text_la: In die autem illo, lectum est in volumine Moysi, audiente populo : et inventum est scriptum in eo, quod non debeant introire Ammonites et Moabites in ecclesiam Dei usque in æternum:
text_pt: Naquele dia leu-se no livro de Moisés, aos ouvidos do povo; e achou-se escrito nele que os amonitas e os moabitas não entrassem jamais na congregação de Deus,
text_el: ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ἐκείνῃ ἀνεγνώσθη ἐν βιβλίῳ Μωυσῆ ἐν ὠσὶν τοῦ λαοῦ καὶ εὑρέθη γεγραμμένον ἐν αὐτῷ ὅπως μὴ εἰσέλθωσιν Αμμανῖται καὶ Μωαβῖται ἐν ἐκκλησίᾳ θεοῦ ἕως αἰῶνος

text_en: Because they met not the children of Israel with bread and water: and they hired against them Balaam , to curse them, and our God turned the curse into blessing .
text_la: eo quod non occurrerint filiis Israël cum pane et aqua, et conduxerint adversum eos Balaam ad maledicendum eis : et convertit Deus noster maledictionem in benedictionem.
text_pt: Porquanto não tinham saído ao encontro dos filhos de Israel com pão e água; antes contra eles assalariaram a Balaão para os amaldiçoar; porém o nosso Deus converteu a maldição em bênção.
text_el: ὅτι οὐ συνήντησαν τοῖς υἱοῖς Ισραηλ ἐν ἄρτῳ καὶ ἐν ὕδατι καὶ ἐμισθώσαντο ἐπ' αὐτὸν τὸν Βαλααμ καταράσασθαι καὶ ἔστρεψεν ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν τὴν κατάραν εἰς εὐλογίαν

text_en: And it came to pass, when they had heard the law, that they separated every stranger from Israel .
text_la: Factum est autem, cum audissent legem, separaverunt omnem alienigenam ab Israël.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, ouvindo eles esta lei, apartaram de Israel todo o elemento misto.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἤκουσαν τὸν νόμον καὶ ἐχωρίσθησαν πᾶς ἐπίμικτος ἐν Ισραηλ

text_en: And over this thing was Eliasib the priest , who was set over the treasury of the house of our God , and was near akin to Tobias.
text_la: Et super hoc erat Eliasib sacerdos, qui fuerat præpositus in gazophylacio domus Dei nostri, et proximus Tobiæ.
text_pt: Ora, antes disto, Eliasibe, sacerdote, que presidia sobre a câmara da casa do nosso Deus, se tinha aparentado com Tobias;
text_el: καὶ πρὸ τούτου Ελιασιβ ὁ ἱερεὺς οἰκῶν ἐν γαζοφυλακίῳ οἴκου θεοῦ ἡμῶν ἐγγίων Τωβια

text_en: And he made him a great storeroom, where before him they laid up gifts, and frankincense, and vessels, and the tithes of the corn, of the wine, and of the oil, the portions of the Levites , and of the singing men , and of the porters, and the firstfruits of the priests .
text_la: Fecit ergo sibi gazophylacium grande, et ibi erant ante eum reponentes munera, et thus, et vasa, et decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, partes Levitarum, et cantorum, et janitorum, et primitias sacerdotales.
text_pt: E fizera-lhe uma câmara grande, onde dantes se depositavam as ofertas de alimentos, o incenso, os utensílios, os dízimos do grão, do mosto e do azeite, que se ordenaram para os levitas, cantores e porteiros, como também a oferta alçada para os sacerdotes.
text_el: καὶ ἐποίησεν αὐτῷ γαζοφυλάκιον μέγα καὶ ἐκεῖ ἦσαν πρότερον διδόντες τὴν μανααν καὶ τὸν λίβανον καὶ τὰ σκεύη καὶ τὴν δεκάτην τοῦ σίτου καὶ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου ἐντολὴν τῶν Λευιτῶν καὶ τῶν ᾀδόντων καὶ τῶν πυλωρῶν καὶ ἀπαρχὰς τῶν ἱερέων

text_en: But in all this time I was not in Jerusalem , because in the two and thirtieth year of Artaxerxes king of Babylon , I went to the king, and after certain days I asked the king:
text_la: In omnibus autem his non fui in Jerusalem, quia anno trigesimo secundo Artaxerxis regis Babylonis veni ad regem, et in fine dierum rogavi regem.
text_pt: Mas durante tudo isto não estava eu em Jerusalém, porque no ano trinta e dois de Artaxerxes, rei de babilônia, fui ter com o rei; mas após alguns dias tornei a alcançar licença do rei.
text_el: καὶ ἐν παντὶ τούτῳ οὐκ ἤμην ἐν Ιερουσαλημ ὅτι ἐν ἔτει τριακοστῷ καὶ δευτέρῳ τοῦ Αρθασασθα βασιλέως Βαβυλῶνος ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν βασιλέα καὶ μετὰ τέλος ἡμερῶν ᾐτησάμην παρὰ τοῦ βασιλέως

text_en: And I came to Jerusalem , and I understood the evil that Eliasib had done for Tobias, to make him a storehouse in the courts of the house of God .
text_la: Et veni in Jerusalem, et intellexi malum quod fecerat Eliasib Tobiæ, ut faceret ei thesaurum in vestibulis domus Dei.
text_pt: E voltando a Jerusalém, compreendi o mal que Eliasibe fizera para Tobias, fazendo-lhe uma câmara nos pátios da casa de Deus.
text_el: καὶ ἦλθον εἰς Ιερουσαλημ καὶ συνῆκα ἐν τῇ πονηρίᾳ ᾗ ἐποίησεν Ελισουβ τῷ Τωβια ποιῆσαι αὐτῷ γαζοφυλάκιον ἐν αὐλῇ οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: And it seemed to me exceeding evil . And I cast forth the vessels of the house of Tobias out of the storehouse.
text_la: Et malum mihi visum est valde. Et projeci vasa domus Tobiæ foras de gazophylacio:
text_pt: O que muito me desagradou; de sorte que lancei todos os móveis da casa de Tobias fora da câmara.
text_el: καὶ πονηρόν μοι ἐφάνη σφόδρα καὶ ἔρριψα πάντα τὰ σκεύη οἴκου Τωβια ἔξω ἀπὸ τοῦ γαζοφυλακίου

text_en: And I commanded and they cleansed again the vessels of the house of God , the sacrifice , and the frankincense.
text_la: præcepique et emundaverunt gazophylacia : et retuli ibi vasa domus Dei, sacrificium, et thus.
text_pt: E, ordenando-o eu, purificaram as câmaras; e tornei a trazer para ali os utensílios da casa de Deus, com as ofertas de alimentos e o incenso.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα καὶ ἐκαθάρισαν τὰ γαζοφυλάκια καὶ ἐπέστρεψα ἐκεῖ σκεύη οἴκου τοῦ θεοῦ τὴν μαναα καὶ τὸν λίβανον

text_en: And I perceived that the portions of the Levites had not been given them: and that the Levites , and the singing men , and they that ministered were fled away every man to his own country:
text_la: Et cognovi quod partes Levitarum non fuissent datæ, et fugisset unusquisque in regionem suam de Levitis, et cantoribus, et de his qui ministrabant:
text_pt: Também entendi que os quinhões dos levitas não se lhes davam, de maneira que os levitas e os cantores, que faziam a obra, tinham fugido cada um para a sua terra.
text_el: καὶ ἔγνων ὅτι μερίδες τῶν Λευιτῶν οὐκ ἐδόθησαν καὶ ἐφύγοσαν ἀνὴρ εἰς ἀγρὸν αὐτοῦ οἱ Λευῖται καὶ οἱ ᾄδοντες ποιοῦντες τὸ ἔργον

text_en: And I pleaded the matter against the magistrates, and said: Why have we forsaken the house of God ? And I gathered them together, and I made them to stand in their places.
text_la: et egi causam adversus magistratus, et dixi : Quare dereliquimus domum Dei? et congregavi eos, et feci stare in stationibus suis.
text_pt: Então contendi com os magistrados, e disse: Por que se desamparou a casa de Deus? Porém eu os ajuntei, e os restaurei no seu posto.
text_el: καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην τοῖς στρατηγοῖς καὶ εἶπα διὰ τί ἐγκατελείφθη ὁ οἶκος τοῦ θεοῦ καὶ συνήγαγον αὐτοὺς καὶ ἔστησα αὐτοὺς ἐπὶ τῇ στάσει αὐτῶν

text_en: And all Juda brought the tithe of the corn, and the wine, and the oil into the storehouses.
text_la: Et omnis Juda apportabat decimam frumenti, vini, et olei, in horrea.
text_pt: Então todo o Judá trouxe os dízimos do grão, do mosto e do azeite aos celeiros.
text_el: καὶ πᾶς Ιουδα ἤνεγκαν δεκάτην τοῦ πυροῦ καὶ τοῦ οἴνου καὶ τοῦ ἐλαίου εἰς τοὺς θησαυροὺς

text_en: And we set over the storehouses Selemias the priest , and Sadoc the scribe , and of the Levites Phadaia, and next to them Hanan the son of Zachur, the son of Mathania: for they were approved as faithful , and to them were committed the portions of their brethren.
text_la: Et constituimus super horrea Selemiam sacerdotem, et Sadoc scribam, et Phadaiam de Levitis, et juxta eos Hanan filium Zachur, filium Mathaniæ : quoniam fideles comprobati sunt, et ipsis creditæ sunt partes fratrum suorum.
text_pt: E por tesoureiros pus sobre os celeiros a Selemias, o sacerdote, e a Zadoque, o escrivão e a Pedaías, dentre os levitas; e com eles Hanã, filho de Zacur, o filho de Matanias; porque foram achados fiéis; e se lhes encarregou a eles a distribuição para seus irmãos.
text_el: ἐπὶ χεῖρα Σελεμια τοῦ ἱερέως καὶ Σαδδουκ τοῦ γραμματέως καὶ Φαδαια ἀπὸ τῶν Λευιτῶν καὶ ἐπὶ χεῖρα αὐτῶν Αναν υἱὸς Ζακχουρ υἱὸς Μαθανια ὅτι πιστοὶ ἐλογίσθησαν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς μερίζειν τοῖς ἀδελφοῖς αὐτῶν

text_en: Remember me, O my God , for this thing, and wipe not out my kindnesses, which I have done relating to the house of my God and his ceremonies .
text_la: Memento mei, Deus meus, pro hoc, et ne deleas miserationes meas quas feci in domo Dei mei, et in cæremoniis ejus.
text_pt: Por isto, Deus meu, lembra-te de mim e não risques as beneficências que eu fiz à casa de meu Deus e às suas observâncias.
text_el: μνήσθητί μου ὁ θεός ἐν ταύτῃ καὶ μὴ ἐξαλειφθήτω ἔλεός μου ὃ ἐποίησα ἐν οἴκῳ κυρίου τοῦ θεοῦ

text_en: In those days I saw in Juda some treading the presses on the sabbath , and carrying sheaves, and lading asses with wine, and grapes, and figs, and all manner of burthens, and bringing them into Jerusalem on the sabbath day . And I charged them that they should sell on a day on which it was lawful to sell.
text_la: In diebus illis vidi in Juda calcantes torcularia in sabbato, portantes acervos, et onerantes super asinos vinum, et uvas, et ficus, et omne onus, et inferentes in Jerusalem, die sabbati. Et contestatus sum ut in die qua vendere liceret, venderent.
text_pt: Naqueles dias vi em Judá os que pisavam lagares ao sábado e traziam feixes que carregavam sobre os jumentos; como também vinho, uvas e figos, e toda a espécie de cargas, que traziam a Jerusalém no dia de sábado; e protestei contra eles no dia em que vendiam mantimentos.
text_el: ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις εἶδον ἐν Ιουδα πατοῦντας ληνοὺς ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ καὶ φέροντας δράγματα καὶ ἐπιγεμίζοντας ἐπὶ τοὺς ὄνους καὶ οἶνον καὶ σταφυλὴν καὶ σῦκα καὶ πᾶν βάσταγμα καὶ φέροντας εἰς Ιερουσαλημ ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου καὶ ἐπεμαρτυράμην ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πράσεως αὐτῶν

text_en: Some Tyrians also dwelt there, who brought fish, and all manner of wares: and they sold them on the sabbaths to the children of Juda in Jerusalem .
text_la: Et Tyrii habitaverunt in ea, inferentes pisces, et omnia venalia : et vendebant in sabbatis filiis Juda in Jerusalem.
text_pt: Também habitavam em Jerusalém tírios que traziam peixe e toda a mercadoria, que vendiam no sábado aos filhos de Judá, e em Jerusalém.
text_el: καὶ ἐκάθισαν ἐν αὐτῇ φέροντες ἰχθὺν καὶ πᾶσαν πρᾶσιν πωλοῦντες ἐν τῷ σαββάτῳ τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιουδα καὶ ἐν Ιερουσαλημ

text_en: And I rebuked the chief men of Juda , and said to them: What is this evil thing that you are doing, profaning the sabbath day :
text_la: Et objurgavi optimates Juda, et dixi eis : Quæ est hæc res mala quam vos facitis, et profanatis diem sabbati?
text_pt: E contendi com os nobres de Judá, e lhes disse: Que mal é este que fazeis, profanando o dia de sábado?
text_el: καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην τοῖς υἱοῖς Ιουδα τοῖς ἐλευθέροις καὶ εἶπα αὐτοῖς τίς ὁ λόγος οὗτος ὁ πονηρός ὃν ὑμεῖς ποιεῖτε καὶ βεβηλοῦτε τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ σαββάτου

text_en: Did not our fathers do these things, and our God brought all this evil upon us, and upon this city? And you bring more wrath upon Israel by violating the sabbath .
text_la: numquid non hæc fecerunt patres nostri, et adduxit Deus noster super nos omne malum hoc, et super civitatem hanc? et vos additis iracundiam super Israël violando sabbatum.
text_pt: Porventura não fizeram vossos pais assim, e não trouxe o nosso Deus todo este mal sobre nós e sobre esta cidade? E vós ainda mais acrescentais o ardor de sua ira sobre Israel, profanando o sábado.
text_el: οὐχὶ οὕτως ἐποίησαν οἱ πατέρες ὑμῶν καὶ ἤνεγκεν ἐπ' αὐτοὺς ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν καὶ ἐφ' ἡμᾶς πάντα τὰ κακὰ ταῦτα καὶ ἐπὶ τὴν πόλιν ταύτην καὶ ὑμεῖς προστίθετε ὀργὴν ἐπὶ Ισραηλ βεβηλῶσαι τὸ σάββατον

text_en: And it came to pass, that when the gates of Jerusalem were at rest on the sabbath day , I spoke: and they shut the gates, and I commanded that they should not open them till after the sabbath : and I set some of my servants at the gates, that none should bring in burthens on the sabbath day .
text_la: Factum est autem, cum quievissent portæ Jerusalem in die sabbati, dixi : et clauserunt januas, et præcepi ut non aperirent eas usque post sabbatum : et de pueris meis constitui super portas, ut nullus inferret onus in die sabbati.
text_pt: Sucedeu, pois, que, dando já sombra nas portas de Jerusalém antes do sábado, ordenei que as portas fossem fechadas; e mandei que não as abrissem até passado o sábado; e pus às portas alguns de meus servos, para que nenhuma carga entrasse no dia de sábado.
text_el: καὶ ἐγένετο ἡνίκα κατέστησαν πύλαι Ιερουσαλημ πρὸ τοῦ σαββάτου καὶ εἶπα καὶ ἔκλεισαν τὰς πύλας καὶ εἶπα ὥστε μὴ ἀνοιγῆναι αὐτὰς ἕως ὀπίσω τοῦ σαββάτου καὶ ἐκ τῶν παιδαρίων μου ἔστησα ἐπὶ τὰς πύλας ὥστε μὴ αἴρειν βαστάγματα ἐν ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ σαββάτου

text_en: So the merchants, and they that sold all kinds of wares, stayed without Jerusalem , once or twice.
text_la: Et manserunt negotiatores, et vendentes universa venalia, foris Jerusalem semel et bis.
text_pt: Então os negociantes e os vendedores de toda a mercadoria passaram a noite fora de Jerusalém, uma ou duas vezes.
text_el: καὶ ηὐλίσθησαν πάντες καὶ ἐποίησαν πρᾶσιν ἔξω Ιερουσαλημ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς

text_en: And I charged them, and I said to them: Why stay you before the wall? If you do so another time, I will lay hands on you. And from that time they came no more on the sabbath .
text_la: Et contestatus sum eos, et dixi eis : Quare manetis ex adverso muri? si secundo hoc feceritis, manum mittam in vos. Itaque ex tempore illo non venerunt in sabbato.
text_pt: Protestei, pois, contra eles, e lhes disse: Por que passais a noite defronte do muro? Se outra vez o fizerdes, hei de lançar mão de vós. Daquele tempo em diante não vieram no sábado.
text_el: καὶ διεμαρτυράμην ἐν αὐτοῖς καὶ εἶπα πρὸς αὐτούς διὰ τί ὑμεῖς αὐλίζεσθε ἀπέναντι τοῦ τείχους ἐὰν δευτερώσητε ἐκτενῶ τὴν χεῖρά μου ἐν ὑμῖν ἀπὸ τοῦ καιροῦ ἐκείνου οὐκ ἤλθοσαν ἐν σαββάτῳ

text_en: I spoke also to the Levites that they should be purified, and should come to keep the gates, and to sanctify the sabbath day : for this also remember me, O my God , and spare me according to the multitude of your tender mercies.
text_la: Dixi quoque Levitis ut mundarentur, et venirent ad custodiendas portas, et sanctificandam diem sabbati : et pro hoc ergo memento mei, Deus meus, et parce mihi secundum multitudinem miserationum tuarum.
text_pt: Também disse aos levitas que se purificassem, e viessem guardar as portas, para santificar o sábado. Nisto também, Deus meu, lembra-te de mim e perdoa-me segundo a abundância da tua benignidade.
text_el: καὶ εἶπα τοῖς Λευίταις οἳ ἦσαν καθαριζόμενοι καὶ ἐρχόμενοι φυλάσσοντες τὰς πύλας ἁγιάζειν τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ σαββάτου πρὸς ταῦτα μνήσθητί μου ὁ θεός καὶ φεῖσαί μου κατὰ τὸ πλῆθος τοῦ ἐλέους σου

text_en: In those days also I saw Jews that married wives, women of Azotus , and of Ammon , and of Moab .
text_la: Sed et in diebus illis vidi Judæos ducentes uxores Azotidas, Ammonitidas, et Moabitidas.
text_pt: Vi também naqueles dias judeus que tinham casado com mulheres asdoditas, amonitas e moabitas.
text_el: καὶ ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις ἐκείναις εἶδον τοὺς Ιουδαίους οἳ ἐκάθισαν γυναῖκας Ἀζωτίας Αμμανίτιδας Μωαβίτιδας

text_en: And their children spoke half in the speech of Azotus , and could not speak the Jews' language , but they spoke according to the language of this and that people.
text_la: Et filii eorum ex media parte loquebantur azotice, et nesciebant loqui judaice, et loquebantur juxta linguam populi et populi.
text_pt: E seus filhos falavam meio asdodita, e não podiam falar judaico, senão segundo a língua de cada povo.
text_el: καὶ οἱ υἱοὶ αὐτῶν ἥμισυ λαλοῦντες Ἀζωτιστὶ καὶ οὔκ εἰσιν ἐπιγινώσκοντες λαλεῖν Ιουδαϊστί

text_en: And I chid them, and laid my curse upon them. And I beat some of them, and shaved off their hair, and made them swear by God that they would not give their daughters to their sons, nor take their daughters for their sons, nor for themselves, saying:
text_la: Et objurgavi eos, et maledixi. Et cecidi ex eis viros, et decalvavi eos, et adjuravi in Deo ut non darent filias suas filiis eorum, et non acciperent de filiabus eorum filiis suis et sibimetipsis, dicens:
text_pt: E contendi com eles, e os amaldiçoei e espanquei alguns deles, e lhes arranquei os cabelos, e os fiz jurar por Deus, dizendo: Não dareis mais vossas filhas a seus filhos, e não tomareis mais suas filhas, nem para vossos filhos nem para vós mesmos.
text_el: καὶ ἐμαχεσάμην μετ' αὐτῶν καὶ κατηρασάμην αὐτοὺς καὶ ἐπάταξα ἐν αὐτοῖς ἄνδρας καὶ ἐμαδάρωσα αὐτοὺς καὶ ὥρκισα αὐτοὺς ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἐὰν δῶτε τὰς θυγατέρας ὑμῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς αὐτῶν καὶ ἐὰν λάβητε ἀπὸ τῶν θυγατέρων αὐτῶν τοῖς υἱοῖς ὑμῶν

text_en: Did not Solomon king of Israel sin in this kind of thing: and surely among many nations, there was not a king like him, and he was beloved of his God , and God made him king over all Israel : and yet women of other countries brought even him to sin .
text_la: Numquid non in hujuscemodi re peccavit Salomon rex Israël? et certe in gentibus multis non erat rex similis ei, et dilectus Deo suo erat, et posuit eum Deus regem super omnem Israël : et ipsum ergo duxerunt ad peccatum mulieres alienigenæ.
text_pt: Porventura não pecou nisto Salomão, rei de Israel, não havendo entre muitas nações rei semelhante a ele, e sendo ele amado de seu Deus, e pondo-o Deus rei sobre todo o Israel? E contudo as mulheres estrangeiras o fizeram pecar.
text_el: οὐχ οὕτως ἥμαρτεν Σαλωμων βασιλεὺς Ισραηλ καὶ ἐν ἔθνεσιν πολλοῖς οὐκ ἦν βασιλεὺς ὅμοιος αὐτῷ καὶ ἀγαπώμενος τῷ θεῷ ἦν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτὸν ὁ θεὸς εἰς βασιλέα ἐπὶ πάντα Ισραηλ καὶ τοῦτον ἐξέκλιναν αἱ γυναῖκες αἱ ἀλλότριαι

text_en: And shall we also be disobedient and do all this great evil to transgress against our God , and marry strange women :
text_la: Numquid et nos inobedientes faciemus omne malum grande hoc ut prævaricemur in Deo nostro, et ducamus uxores peregrinas?
text_pt: E dar-vos-íamos nós ouvidos, para fazermos todo este grande mal, prevaricando contra o nosso Deus, casando com mulheres estrangeiras?
text_el: καὶ ὑμῶν μὴ ἀκουσόμεθα ποιῆσαι τὴν πᾶσαν πονηρίαν ταύτην ἀσυνθετῆσαι ἐν τῷ θεῷ ἡμῶν καθίσαι γυναῖκας ἀλλοτρίας

text_en: And one of the sons of Joiada the son of Eliasib the high priest , was son in law to Sanaballat the Horonite, and I drove him from me.
text_la: De filiis autem Jojada filii Eliasib sacerdotis magni, gener erat Sanaballat Horonites, quem fugavi a me.
text_pt: Também um dos filhos de Joiada, filho de Eliasibe, o sumo sacerdote, era genro de Sambalate, o horonita, por isso o afugentei de mim.
text_el: καὶ ἀπὸ υἱῶν Ιωαδα τοῦ Ελισουβ τοῦ ἱερέως τοῦ μεγάλου νυμφίου τοῦ Σαναβαλλατ τοῦ Ωρωνίτου καὶ ἐξέβρασα αὐτὸν ἀπ' ἐμοῦ

text_en: Remember them, O Lord my God , that defile the priesthood , and the law of priests and Levites .
text_la: Recordare, Domine Deus meus, adversum eos qui polluunt sacerdotium, jusque sacerdotale et Leviticum.
text_pt: Lembra-te deles, Deus meu, pois contaminaram o sacerdócio, como também a aliança do sacerdócio e dos levitas.
text_el: μνήσθητι αὐτοῖς ὁ θεός ἐπὶ ἀγχιστείᾳ τῆς ἱερατείας καὶ διαθήκης τῆς ἱερατείας καὶ τοὺς Λευίτας

text_en: So I separated from them all strangers, and I appointed the courses of the priests and the Levites , every man in his ministry:
text_la: Igitur mundavi eos ab omnibus alienigenis, et constitui ordines sacerdotum et Levitarum, unumquemque in ministerio suo:
text_pt: Assim os limpei de todo o estrangeiro, e designei os cargos dos sacerdotes e dos levitas, cada um na sua obra.
text_el: καὶ ἐκαθάρισα αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ πάσης ἀλλοτριώσεως καὶ ἔστησα ἐφημερίας τοῖς ἱερεῦσιν καὶ τοῖς Λευίταις ἀνὴρ ὡς τὸ ἔργον αὐτοῦ

text_en: And for the offering of wood at times appointed, and for the firstfruits : remember me, O my God , unto good . Amen .
text_la: et in oblatione lignorum in temporibus constitutis, et in primitivis : memento mei, Deus meus, in bonum. Amen.
text_pt: Como também para com as ofertas de lenha em tempos determinados, e para com as primícias; lembra-te de mim, Deus meu, para bem.
text_el: καὶ τὸ δῶρον τῶν ξυλοφόρων ἐν καιροῖς ἀπὸ χρόνων καὶ ἐν τοῖς βακχουρίοις μνήσθητί μου ὁ θεὸς ἡμῶν εἰς ἀγαθωσύνην
